<style>

#macro-dashboard .macro-language {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 6px;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-language a {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 28px;
  padding: 1px 9px;
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  border: 1px solid #8a8a8a;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-language a[aria-current] {
  background: #f1f2f3;
  border-color: #222;
  font-weight: 600;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-language a:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #365f9d;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-language a { min-height: 44px; }
}

#macro-dashboard {
  font-size: .85em;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: inherit;
}

#macro-dashboard *,
#macro-dashboard *::before,
#macro-dashboard *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .35em 1.15em;
  margin: 0 0 1.25em;
  font-size: .85em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #ccc;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav a:hover {
  border-bottom-color: currentColor;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-update-note {
  margin: -.45em 0 1.25em;
  color: #555;
  font-size: .85em;
  line-height: 1.45;
  text-align: left;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-section {
  margin: 0 0 1.6em;
  scroll-margin-top: 1em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-section > .macro-heading {
  margin: 0 0 .65em;
  font-size: 1.2em;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-section-intro {
  margin: 0 0 .75em;
  font-size: .85em;
  line-height: 1.4;
  text-align: left;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-panel {
  margin: 0 0 .85em;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 170px;
  column-gap: 16px;
  row-gap: 0;
  align-items: start;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-chart {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  height: var(--macro-chart-height, 312px);
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-figure {
  min-width: 0;
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 2;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-plot-title {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 14px 0 60px;
  font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 20px;
  text-align: left;
  -webkit-user-select: text;
  user-select: text;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-canvas {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-presidents {
  margin: 0 14px .25em 52px;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border: 1px solid #000;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: #fff;
  color: #222;
  font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.15;
  text-align: left;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-presidents.has-two-columns {
  width: max-content;
  max-width: calc(100% - 66px);
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-presidents.is-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 3;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  border: 1px solid #000;
  width: max-content;
  max-width: calc(100% - var(--macro-margin-left, 60px) - var(--macro-margin-right, 14px));
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-presidents-title {
  margin: 0 0 3px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-presidents-items {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 3px 8px;
  align-items: center;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-presidents-items.is-two-column {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, max-content);
  grid-auto-flow: column;
  grid-template-rows: repeat(4, auto);
  gap: 4px 10px;
  align-items: center;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-president-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-president-swatch {
  display: inline-block;
  flex: 0 0 10px;
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #000;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: .75em;
  min-width: 0;
  padding-top: var(--macro-plot-top, 14px);
  font-size: .85em;
  text-align: left;
  grid-column: 2;
  grid-row: 2;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar p,
#macro-dashboard .macro-info,
#macro-dashboard .macro-info p,
#macro-dashboard .macro-source,
#macro-dashboard .macro-key-label {
  text-align: left;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar button,
#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar summary {
  display: inline-block;
  margin: 0;
  padding: .4em .65em;
  border: 1px solid #bbb;
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-shadow: none;
  background: #fff;
  color: #333;
  font: inherit;
  line-height: 1.4;
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: normal;
  cursor: pointer;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar button:hover,
#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar summary:hover {
  background: #f3f3f3;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar button:disabled {
  opacity: .5;
  cursor: wait;
}

#macro-dashboard :focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #555;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-about {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-about summary {
  list-style: none;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-about summary::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-about summary::after {
  content: " ▾";
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-about[open] summary::after {
  content: " ▴";
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-info {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 10;
  top: calc(100% + 8px);
  right: 0;
  width: min(340px, calc(100vw - 48px));
  max-height: min(72vh, 520px);
  overflow: auto;
  padding: 1em;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px #0002;
  color: #333;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-info p {
  margin: 0 0 .75em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-info p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-info .macro-series {
  padding-bottom: .65em;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-info .macro-original {
  display: inline;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-latest {
  display: grid;
  gap: .25em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-latest-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .75em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-latest-value {
  white-space: nowrap;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-indicators {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 4px 6px;
  border: 1px solid #000;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-key-title {
  margin: .1em 0 .35em;
  font-weight: 700;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-keys {
  display: grid;
  gap: .4em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-key {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .5em;
  min-width: 0;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-key-sample {
  display: inline-block;
  flex: 0 0 26px;
  width: 26px;
  height: 0;
  border-top: 1.6px solid #111;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-key-label {
  min-width: 0;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-key-sample.is-bar,
#macro-dashboard .macro-key-sample[data-kind="bar"] {
  height: 9px;
  border: 1px solid #111;
  background: #111;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-source {
  margin: .1em 0 0;
  color: #555;
  font-size: .95em;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-source a {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-status {
  margin: .4em 0;
  color: #555;
  font-size: .85em;
}

#macro-dashboard [hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #macro-dashboard {
    font-size: .8em;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
    gap: .35em .85em;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 0;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-chart {
    height: var(--macro-chart-height-mobile, 340px);
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-plot-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 16px;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-presidents-title {
    font-size: 8px;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-president-item {
    font-size: 7px;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar {
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: .55em .75em;
    padding-top: 0;
      grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 3;
    margin-top: 6px;
}

  #macro-dashboard .macro-info {
    top: calc(100% + 8px);
    right: auto;
    left: 0;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-source,
  #macro-dashboard .macro-indicators {
    flex-basis: 100%;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-keys {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
    gap: .35em .8em;
  }
}

/* Compact contents: append after the original dashboard styles. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-contents {
  margin: 0 0 1.25em;
  padding: 12px 16px 14px;
  border: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: #fafafa;
  text-align: left;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-contents-label {
  margin: 0 0 .5em;
  color: #666;
  font-size: .75em;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  line-height: 1.3;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: .35em 1.5em;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: .9em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav a {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.5em minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: start;
  gap: .45em;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: .45em 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 2px;
  color: inherit;
  line-height: 1.3;
  text-decoration: none;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav-number {
  padding-top: .06em;
  color: #777;
  font-size: .85em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav-copy {
  min-width: 0;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav-copy strong {
  display: block;
  color: #222;
  font-size: 1em;
  font-weight: 600;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav-copy > span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: .2em;
  color: #666;
  font-size: .83em;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav a:hover .macro-nav-copy strong {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: .16em;
}

#macro-dashboard .macro-nav a:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #555;
  outline-offset: 4px;
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    column-gap: 1.25em;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 440px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-contents {
    padding: 10px 12px;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: .1em;
  }

  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav a {
    padding: .4em 0;
  }
}

/* Subtitles share the chart-title inset on desktop and mobile. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-plot-subtitle {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  padding: 0 14px 0 60px;
  font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: #555;
  text-align: left;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-inset-indicators {
  z-index: 3;
  border: 1px solid #000;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  color: #222;
  font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
  text-align: left;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-inset-indicators .macro-key {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-inset-indicators .macro-key-label {
  white-space: nowrap;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

/* The shared header row lets every control begin at the plot's data edge. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-plot-header {
  grid-column: 1;
  grid-row: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 12px 0 16px;
}

/* Inset legend boxes appear only after their geometry has been calculated. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar > .macro-indicators {
  display: none;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-plot-header {
    padding: 10px 0 14px;
  }
}

/* Mobile keeps the desktop visual language with readable legends and controls. */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar {
    font-size: 12px;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 8px;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar button,
  #macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar summary {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 44px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-about {
    min-width: 0;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-about[open] {
    flex: 1 0 100%;
    width: 100%;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-about .macro-info {
    position: static;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    max-height: 60vh;
    margin-top: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.45;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-source {
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.45;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
}


/* One compact layout for all figures; the renderer aligns both heading insets. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-section {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  scroll-margin-top: 12px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-section > .macro-heading {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-section-intro {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-panel {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  scroll-margin-top: 12px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-layout {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 160px;
  column-gap: 12px;
  row-gap: 0;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-plot-header {
  padding: 4px 0 3px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-plot-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 18px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-plot-subtitle {
  margin: 3px 0 0;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-chart {
  height: var(--macro-chart-height, 312px);
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar {
  gap: 8px;
  padding-top: var(--macro-plot-top, 8px);
  font-size: 12px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-source {
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-status[hidden] {
  margin: 0;
}

/* Read section groups across rows: 01–03, 04–06, then 07–09. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-contents {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-contents-label {
  display: list-item;
  margin: 0;
  list-style-position: inside;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-contents[open] > .macro-contents-label {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  grid-auto-flow: row;
  align-items: start;
  gap: 8px 14px;
  columns: auto;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-toc-section {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto auto;
  align-content: start;
  width: auto;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  gap: 2px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-heading {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: first baseline;
  gap: 4px;
  min-height: 2.6em;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-toc-heading strong {
  color: #222;
  font-weight: 600;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-toc-heading .macro-nav-number {
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  justify-self: center;
  align-self: first baseline;
  text-align: center;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-toc-plots {
  align-self: start;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-toc-plots > li {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-plot {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 47px minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 3px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 1px 0;
  border: 0;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-toc-roman {
  color: #666;
  font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
  justify-self: start;
  text-align: left;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-plot:hover > span:last-child,
#macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-heading:hover strong {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 2px;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-plot > span:last-child {
  font-size: 9.5px !important;
}
  
/* Sharing the heading track aligns the first chart in every section of a row,
   including when a longer section heading wraps onto an additional line. */
@supports (grid-template-rows: subgrid) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
    row-gap: 6px;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-toc-section {
    grid-row: span 2;
    grid-template-rows: subgrid;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-heading {
    min-height: 0;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 840px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
@media (max-width: 560px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-nav .macro-toc-heading {
    min-height: 0;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-contents {
    padding: 8px 10px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #macro-dashboard .macro-layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 0;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-plot-header {
    padding: 4px 0 3px;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-plot-title {
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 16px;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-chart {
    height: var(--macro-chart-height-mobile, 340px);
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar {
    margin-top: 4px;
    padding-top: 0;
    gap: 6px 8px;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar button,
  #macro-dashboard .macro-sidebar summary {
    min-height: 44px;
    padding: 7px 9px;
  }
  #macro-dashboard .macro-contents-label {
    min-height: 36px;
    padding: 4px 0;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 20px;
  }
}


/* Independent native disclosures preserve the existing section hierarchy. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-section-group {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-section-summary {
  display: list-item;
  list-style-position: inside;
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  padding: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-section-summary > .macro-heading {
  display: inline;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.2em;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.25;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-section-group:not([open]) > .macro-section-summary {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}
#macro-dashboard .macro-section-body {
  min-width: 0;
}


/* Municipal figures retain the same heading, sidebar and compact controls. */
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-panel .macro-layout,#macro-dashboard .macro-pyramid-panel .macro-layout {grid-template-columns:minmax(0,520px) 160px;max-width:692px;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-chart {width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:var(--macro-map-min-height,220px);touch-action:pan-y;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-chart svg {display:block;width:100%;height:auto;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-chart [data-municipality] {cursor:pointer;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-control {display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;max-width:100%;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-control select {width:160px;max-width:100%;padding:5px 6px;border:1px solid #bbb;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:#333;font:inherit;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-panel .macro-plot-title,#macro-dashboard .macro-map-panel .macro-plot-subtitle {padding-left:12px;padding-right:12px;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-detail,#macro-dashboard .macro-map-coverage {margin:3px 12px 0;font-family:"Times New Roman",Times,serif;font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-detail {min-height:2.7em;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-reference {margin:0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;}
#macro-dashboard .macro-map-announcement {position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0;}
@media(max-width:600px){
  #macro-dashboard .macro-map-panel .macro-layout,#macro-dashboard .macro-pyramid-panel .macro-layout {grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);max-width:none;}
  #macro-dashboard .macro-map-control {flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
  #macro-dashboard .macro-map-control select {min-height:44px;width:180px;font-size:16px;padding:6px;}
  #macro-dashboard .macro-map-panel .macro-plot-title,#macro-dashboard .macro-map-panel .macro-plot-subtitle {padding-left:8px;padding-right:8px;}
  #macro-dashboard .macro-map-detail,#macro-dashboard .macro-map-coverage {margin-left:8px;margin-right:8px;}
  #macro-dashboard .macro-map-reference {flex-basis:100%;}
}

    <div id="panel-fig1g" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="V. Consumption, investment and net exports">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig1g" class="macro-plot-title">V. Consumption, investment and net exports</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig1g" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Household and government consumption, fixed investment (left); net exports proxy (right). Indices: 2019 = 100.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig1g" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig1g" aria-busy="true" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig1g"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig1g" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig1g" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig1g" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Households</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>PIB trimestral – dados dessazonalizados – consumo das famílias</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22110" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22110</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Government</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>PIB trimestral – dados dessazonalizados – consumo do governo</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22111" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22111</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Gross fixed capital formation</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>PIB trimestral – dados dessazonalizados – formação bruta de capital fixo</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22113" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22113</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Net exports (2019-weighted proxy)</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Exportações líquidas de bens e serviços – indicador calculado com pesos de 2019</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22114" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22114</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22115" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22115</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p>Consumption and investment are seasonally adjusted quarterly volume indices from the national accounts, distributed through the SGS.</p>
            <p>Each consumption and investment series is divided by its own average across the four quarters of 2019 and multiplied by 100.</p>
            <p>Net exports are a calculated volume-balance proxy. The export and import volume indices are separately divided by their own 2019 averages, then weighted by average quarterly current-price exports and imports in 2019, subtracted, and rebased to average 2019 = 100.</p>
            <p>The fixed 2019 weights are BRL 260,890.25 million for exports and BRL 272,794.50 million for imports, from IBGE SIDRA table 1846. The reference balance is −BRL 11,904.25 million per quarter.</p>
            <p>Net exports index = 100 × [260,890.25 × (export volume / its 2019 average) − 272,794.50 × (import volume / its 2019 average)] / (260,890.25 − 272,794.50).</p>
            <p>The 2019 reference balance is negative: a higher net-exports index represents a lower constructed balance; a negative index represents a positive constructed balance.</p>
            <p>All four series have an average of 100 in 2019. The indices compare changes over time, not absolute sizes or GDP shares. They are not additive and do not sum to GDP; the net-exports indicator is not an official chained-volume aggregate or the current-account balance.</p>
            <p>Investment is gross fixed capital formation (GFCF), including public and private investment in fixed assets; it excludes changes in inventories.</p>
            <p>Native quarterly dates and observations are retained. Export and import inputs are already seasonally adjusted; no further adjustment, interpolation or smoothing is applied.</p>
            <p>Consumption and investment use the left axis; net exports use the right axis. Both axes are indices with average 2019 = 100, and the reference value of 100 is aligned at the same height. The two axis scales differ.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig1g" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig1g" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig1g" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.bcb.gov.br/en/statistics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Brazilian Central Bank (BCB)</a> – <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/localizarseries/localizarSeries.do?method=prepararTelaLocalizarSeries" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><em lang="pt-BR">Sistema Gerenciador de Séries Temporais (SGS)</em></a>, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22110" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22110</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22111" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22111</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22113" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22113</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22114" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22114</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22115" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22115</strong></a>; 2019 weights: <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/1846" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE SIDRA 1846</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig1g" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

<div id="panel-fig1savinginvestment" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig1savinginvestment">
      <div class="macro-layout"><div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig1savinginvestment" class="macro-plot-title">VI. Investment and gross saving rates</h3>

              <p>Annual municipal gross domestic product valued at current prices. Source: IBGE GDP of Municipalities, reference 2010, SIDRA table 5938, variable 37.               <p>The colourbar is centred on the national median of available municipal indicator values. <div id="panel-fig1laborincome" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig1laborincome">
      <div class="macro-layout"><div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig1laborincome" class="macro-plot-title">XI. Average and total real labour earnings</h3>
        <p id="subtitle-fig1laborincome" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Brazil; overlapping three-month estimates. Each series: Jan–Mar 2012 = 100.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-fig1laborincome" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig1laborincome" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig1laborincome" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig1laborincome" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden><div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig1laborincome" class="macro-presidents-items"></div></div>
        </div></div><aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig1laborincome" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Rendimento médio mensal real das pessoas de 14 anos ou mais de idade ocupadas na semana de referência com rendimento de trabalho, habitualmente recebido em todos os trabalhos</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Massa de rendimento mensal real das pessoas de 14 anos ou mais de idade ocupadas na semana de referência com rendimento de trabalho, habitualmente recebido em todos os trabalhos</em></span></p><p>Brazil, people aged 14 or older who were employed in the reference week and had labour earnings. Both series cover usual monthly earnings from all jobs.</p><p>Average real earnings are per employed person with labour earnings (SIDRA 6390, variable 5933). Total real labour earnings are the aggregate earnings mass for that population (SIDRA 6392, variable 6293), published in millions of BRL.</p><p>For each line, index = 100 × the published real value / its own Jan–Mar 2012 value. Both indices start at 100 in the same reference window; the curves compare changes, not absolute income levels or additive shares.</p><p>The average can change with employment composition. The total reflects both average earnings and the number of people with earnings. These are labour earnings, not household disposable income.</p><p>The observations are overlapping three-month estimates, not individual monthly estimates. The date on the axis is the final month of the window. No seasonal adjustment, extra deflation, interpolation or smoothing is applied.</p><p>In each release, IBGE expresses the full real-value histories at the price level of the last published rolling quarter. The data included in this page use Jul–Sep 2026 prices; hover values identify the price window of the displayed data.</p><p>The page includes data through Jul–Sep 2026 and checks the official IBGE APIs monthly. Both histories must cover the same complete reference windows. If an update is unavailable or incomplete, the data already shown remain displayed.</p><p>The source may revise the historical values and rebase their common price reference on later releases. A successful refresh replaces the full pair and recalculates both indices from Jan–Mar 2012; it does not append a differently priced tail.</p><p>Presidential backgrounds identify the president in the final month; rolling windows can overlap administrations. The shading does not establish a causal effect.</p><p>Data prepared on 5 November 2026.</p><p data-integration-income-state>Data included in this page. Price reference: Jul–Sep 2026.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig1laborincome" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite"></div></div></details>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/6390" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PNAD Continuous, SIDRA 6390</a>; <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/6392" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">6392</a>.<br>IBGE SIDRA 6390, v5933 · IBGE SIDRA 6392, v6293.</p></aside></div>
      <p id="status-fig1laborincome" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p></div>

            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Nominal minimum wage</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Salário mínimo</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1619" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1619</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Real minimum wage — December 2024 prices</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Salário mínimo deflacionado pelo IPCA</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1619" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1619</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=433" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>433</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>The nominal line is the statutory monthly minimum wage published in SGS 1619, in current BRL.</p>
            <p>The real line is calculated from the same nominal series using the monthly IPCA percentage changes in SGS 433. Monthly rates are compounded into a price index; they are not added.</p>
            <p>Real wage at month t = nominal wage at t × compounded IPCA index in December 2024 / compounded IPCA index at t.</p>
            <p>The price reference is December 2024. Nominal and real values therefore coincide in that month. The two lines show BRL per month, with the real line expressed in December 2024 purchasing power.</p>
            <p>The graph starts in January 1996. Observations dated after the current month are excluded, including any pre-published future minimum-wage observations.</p>
            <p>The real line ends at the latest month for which both a nominal wage and a published IPCA observation exist. No inflation values are forecast or carried forward.</p>
            <p>Native monthly observations are retained without additional seasonal adjustment or smoothing.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig1h" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>

        </aside>

  <section id="section-monetary-fiscal" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-monetary-fiscal">
    <details id="group-monetary-fiscal" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-monetary-fiscal" class="macro-heading">Monetary and fiscal policy</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
        <span id="section-monetary-policy" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span id="section-fiscal-policy" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <div id="panel-fig2a" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XIV. IPCA, Selic, real return and inflation target">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig2a" class="macro-plot-title">XIV. IPCA, Selic, real return and inflation target</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Selic is Brazil’s benchmark interest rate, which influences other interest rates across the economy. Real return: compounded Selic adjusted for IPCA over the preceding 12 months.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig2a" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig2a" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig2a" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig2a" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig2a" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>IPCA — 12-month change</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>IPCA – variação acumulada em 12 meses</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=13522" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>13522</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Selic — annualized, 252-day basis</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de juros – Selic anualizada base 252</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1178" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1178</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Real Selic — realized 12-month return</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Selic acumulada em 12 meses, descontada pelo IPCA no mesmo período</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=4390" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>4390</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=13522" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>13522</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Inflation target</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Meta para a inflação</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=13521" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>13521</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
              <p>Selic is sampled at the first daily observation of each month.</p>
<p>The inflation target retains its native annual observations; IPCA is the published 12-month rate.</p>
<p>Calculated indicator: 100 × [product of (1 + monthly Selic / 100) over 12 consecutive months / (1 + published 12-month IPCA / 100) − 1].</p>
<p>Monthly Selic returns are compounded, not added. The inflation denominator is the published 12-month IPCA (SGS 13522).</p>
<p>This is a retrospective realized return on the Selic benchmark, before taxes and fees; it is neither an expected real policy rate nor an estimate of the neutral interest rate.</p>
<p>Only matching reference months are used. The line ends at the latest month with a complete 12-month Selic window and a published IPCA observation; no inflation is projected.</p>
<p>Missing months are not interpolated or carried forward.</p>
<p>The Selic line is a contemporaneous annualized rate sampled at the first observation of each month; the real-return line compounds the realized monthly Selic returns over the preceding 12 months and adjusts them for inflation over that same period. The four lines share the percentage scale, with their horizons identified separately.</p>
<p>The vertical scale includes negative realized real returns and expands if new observations exceed the initial limits. Each series retains its own latest published date.</p>
              <p>New observations and revisions are checked through the official SGS API using the dashboard’s monthly update cycle. The last available observations remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig2a" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig2a" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators">
            <p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p>
            <div id="keys-fig2a" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.bcb.gov.br/en/statistics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Brazilian Central Bank (BCB)</a> – SGS, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=13522" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>13522</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1178" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1178</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=4390" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>4390</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=13521" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>13521</strong></a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig2a" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig2b" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XV. IPCA components (12-month inflation rate)">
      <div class="macro-layout">

            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Food at home</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>IPCA – alimentação no domicílio</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=27864" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>27864</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Industrial goods</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>IPCA – bens industriais</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=27863" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>27863</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Services</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>IPCA – serviços</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=10844" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>10844</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>Monthly price changes are compounded over 12 consecutive months before the display-period cutoff.</p>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.bcb.gov.br/en/statistics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Brazilian Central Bank (BCB)</a> – <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/localizarseries/localizarSeries.do?method=prepararTelaLocalizarSeries" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><em lang="pt-BR">Sistema Gerenciador de Séries Temporais (SGS)</em></a>, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=4449" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>4449</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=27864" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>27864</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=27863" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>27863</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=10844" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>10844</strong></a>.</p>

    <div id="panel-fig2cores" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XVI. IPCA and core inflation (12 months)">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig2cores" class="macro-plot-title">XVI. IPCA and core inflation (12 months)</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Headline IPCA and five individual core measures: EX0, EX3, DP, MS and P55.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig2cores" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig2cores" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig2cores" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig2cores" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig2cores" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>IPCA</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>IPCA – variação acumulada em 12 meses</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=13522" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>13522</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>EX0</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>IPCA – núcleo por exclusão EX0</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=11427" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>11427</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>EX3</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>IPCA – núcleo por exclusão EX3</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=27839" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>27839</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>DP</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>IPCA – núcleo de dupla ponderação</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=16122" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>16122</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>MS</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>IPCA – núcleo de médias aparadas com suavização</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=4466" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>4466</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>P55</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>IPCA – núcleo percentil 55</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=28750" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>28750</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
              <p>The headline line is the published 12-month IPCA (SGS 13522).</p>
<p>Each official monthly core is compounded separately over 12 consecutive months: 100 × [product of (1 + monthly change / 100) − 1].</p>
<p>EX0 (11427) excludes administered prices and food at home, retaining services and industrial goods.</p>
<p>EX3 (27839) combines the selected services and industrial-goods core components under the BCB exclusion methodology.</p>
<p>DP (16122), double weighting, adjusts the original IPCA item weights to reduce the influence of more volatile items.</p>
<p>MS (4466) is a trimmed-mean measure that smooths selected infrequently adjusted prices before trimming extreme price changes.</p>
<p>P55 (28750) is based on the 55th percentile of the weighted distribution of monthly price changes.</p>
<p>All five individual measures are displayed using the BCB methodology consolidated in Technical Note 57 (December 2025). They are alternative analytical measures, not additive components of IPCA.</p>
<p>Each line requires its own complete 12-month window. Missing months are not interpolated or carried forward.</p>
              <p>New observations and revisions are checked through the official SGS API using the dashboard’s monthly update cycle. The last available observations remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig2cores" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig2cores" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators">

            <div id="keys-fig2cores" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.bcb.gov.br/en/statistics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Brazilian Central Bank (BCB)</a> – SGS, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=13522" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>13522</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=11427" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>11427</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=27839" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>27839</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=16122" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>16122</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=4466" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>4466</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=28750" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>28750</strong></a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>

    </div>

<div id="panel-fig2revenueexpense" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig2revenueexpense">
      <div class="macro-layout"><div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig2revenueexpense" class="macro-plot-title">XVII. Central government net revenue and primary expenditure</h3>
        <p id="subtitle-fig2revenueexpense" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Brazil, Central Government; rolling 12-month flows as a percentage of nominal GDP.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-fig2revenueexpense" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig2revenueexpense" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig2revenueexpense" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig2revenueexpense" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden><div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig2revenueexpense" class="macro-presidents-items"></div></div>
        </div></div><aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig2revenueexpense" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Receita líquida do Governo Central</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Despesa total do Governo Central (primária)</em></span></p><p>Central Government covers the Treasury, Social Security and the Central Bank. Net revenue deducts revenue-sharing transfers. Primary expenditure excludes interest.</p><p>Each curve divides the sum of 12 monthly flows by nominal GDP over the same months (SGS 4380), then multiplies by 100.</p><p>The hatched gap is the primary balance. Green marks a surplus and red a deficit. Presidential shading identifies the final month of each window.</p><p>The chart uses the September 2026 RTN release. Data prepared on 5 November 2026.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig2revenueexpense" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite"></div></div></details>
          <button id="download-fig2revenueexpense" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig2revenueexpense" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.tesourotransparente.gov.br/publicacoes/boletim-resultado-do-tesouro-nacional-rtn/2026/9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">RTN table 1.1</a>, lines 3 (net revenue) and 4 (primary expenditure). <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarvalores/consultarValoresSeries.do?method=consultarValores&series=4380" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">BCB–SGS 4380</a> (nominal GDP).<br>RTN table 1.1, lines 3 and 4.</p></aside></div>
      <p id="status-fig2revenueexpense" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p></div>

    <div id="panel-fig2spheres" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XVIII. Primary borrowing requirements by government level">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig2spheres" class="macro-plot-title">XVIII. Primary borrowing requirements by government level</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Twelve-month flows as a share of national GDP. Positive: deficit; negative: surplus.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig2spheres" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig2spheres" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig2spheres" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig2spheres" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig2spheres" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Federal government and BCB</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>NFSP – resultado primário – Governo Federal e Banco Central</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=5783" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>5783</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>State governments</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>NFSP – resultado primário – governos estaduais</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=5787" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>5787</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Municipal governments</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>NFSP – resultado primário – governos municipais</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=5788" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>5788</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
              <p>Each line is the published 12-month primary borrowing requirement for the specified government level, expressed as a percentage of national GDP.</p>
<p>BCB NFSP sign convention: positive values indicate deficits; negative values indicate surpluses. Signs are not inverted.</p>
<p>The Federal government and BCB series includes the federal social security system, under the BCB institutional coverage.</p>
<p>The three lines do not exhaust the consolidated public sector because public enterprises are not included in this selection. They must not be treated as a complete stacked decomposition of the consolidated result.</p>
<p>These percentages use national GDP, not the GDP of each state or municipality. The lines aggregate each level nationally; they do not compare individual states or municipalities.</p>
<p>The source already supplies 12-month flows; no further rolling sum or seasonal adjustment is applied.</p>
              <p>New observations and revisions are checked through the official SGS API using the dashboard’s monthly update cycle. The last available observations remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig2spheres" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig2spheres" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators">

            <div id="keys-fig2spheres" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.bcb.gov.br/en/statistics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Brazilian Central Bank (BCB)</a> – SGS, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=5783" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>5783</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=5787" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>5787</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=5788" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>5788</strong></a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig2spheres" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig2interest" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XIX. Public sector nominal interest (% of GDP)">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig2interest" class="macro-plot-title">XIX. Public sector nominal interest (% of GDP)</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Consolidated public sector nominal interest, excluding exchange-rate effects; published 12-month flow as a share of GDP (SGS 5760).</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig2interest" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig2interest" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig2interest" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig2interest" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig2interest" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Nominal interest</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>NFSP sem desvalorização cambial – juros nominais – setor público consolidado</em></span><br>SGS inputs: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=5760" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>5760</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
              <p>SGS 5760 is already published as a 12-month accumulated flow divided by GDP. It is not accumulated again.</p>
<p>Nominal interest is measured on an accrual basis and includes real interest and monetary correction, under the BCB fiscal methodology.</p>
<p>For the same reference month and institutional coverage, nominal borrowing requirements equal primary borrowing requirements plus nominal interest, apart from rounding.</p>
<p>The interest flow is not the Selic rate and does not represent a debt stock. Values are published excluding exchange-rate effects as defined in the BCB NFSP methodology.</p>
<p>Available observations begin in November 2002. Earlier values are not imputed.</p>
<p>The vertical scale initially spans 3–10% of GDP, with one-percentage-point intervals. The bounds expand automatically if newly published observations fall outside that range.</p>
              <p>New observations and revisions are checked through the official SGS API using the dashboard’s monthly update cycle. The last available observations remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig2interest" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig2interest" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators">
            <p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p>
            <div id="keys-fig2interest" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.bcb.gov.br/en/statistics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Brazilian Central Bank (BCB)</a> – SGS, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=5760" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>5760</strong></a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig2interest" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig2d" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XX. Public debt (% of GDP)">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig2d" class="macro-plot-title">XX. Public debt (% of GDP)</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Net public sector debt and gross general government debt have different institutional coverage.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig2d" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig2d" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig2d" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig2d" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig2d" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Net public sector debt</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Dívida Líquida do Setor Público (% PIB) – Total – setor público consolidado</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=4513" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>4513</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Gross general government debt</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Dívida bruta do governo geral (% PIB) – metodologia utilizada a partir de 2008</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=13762" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>13762</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>Both lines are debt stocks expressed as a percentage of GDP, plotted on the same data-fitted vertical scale. They are not accumulated 12-month flows.</p>
            <p>Net public sector debt covers the consolidated public sector, while gross general government debt covers general government under the BCB methodology. Their institutional coverage differs; the gap between the lines is not simply government assets.</p>
            <p>Gross general government debt uses the methodology adopted from 2008, with observations available from December 2006. No earlier values are imputed.</p>
            <p>The vertical limits adapt to both series using a small padding and rounded bounds; the y-axis ticks are spaced ten percentage points apart.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig2d" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig2d" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig2d" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.bcb.gov.br/en/statistics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Brazilian Central Bank (BCB)</a> – <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/localizarseries/localizarSeries.do?method=prepararTelaLocalizarSeries" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><em lang="pt-BR">Sistema Gerenciador de Séries Temporais (SGS)</em></a>, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=4513" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>4513</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=13762" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>13762</strong></a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig2d" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig2swap" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXI. Currency swaps — 12-month cash result (BRL)">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig2swap" class="macro-plot-title">XXI. Currency swaps — 12-month cash result (BRL)</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">BCB cash result from currency swaps, summed over the preceding 12 months. Positive = gain; negative = loss for the BCB.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas">
          <div id="chart-fig2swap" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig2swap" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig2swap" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
            <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig2swap" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
          </div></div></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig2swap" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>12-month cash result</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Swap cambial - Resultado caixa</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=29522" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>29522</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>SGS 29522 is a monthly cash flow, published in millions of current BRL. It is not an accumulated series.</p>
<p>Calculated indicator: sum of the current month and the preceding 11 consecutive monthly observations, divided by 1,000 to display BRL billions.</p>
<p>A positive value is a net cash gain for the BCB; a negative value is a net cash loss. Zero is a valid observation, and the horizontal zero line separates gains from losses.</p>
<p>Cash settlement and accrual recognition can fall in different months. This plot uses the cash series only; it does not use the accrual series SGS 29523.</p>
<p>The source begins in January 2008. The first complete 12-month sum is December 2008. Missing months are not filled or interpolated, and a window spanning a missing month is not plotted.</p>
<p>Currency swaps supply exchange-rate hedging. This cash result alone is not the overall result of the BCB, the value of international reserves or a measure of the effectiveness of monetary policy.</p>
<p>The vertical limits fit the observed 12-month results with small padding. Legends use the available space without widening the vertical scale.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig2swap" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
          </div></details>
          <button id="download-fig2swap" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig2swap" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=29522" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">BCB–SGS 29522</a>; <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.29522/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API</a>. Monthly BRL millions → 12-month sum in BRL billions.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-fig2swap" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

<div id="panel-fig2selicrepos" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig2selicrepos">
      <div class="macro-layout"><div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig2selicrepos" class="macro-plot-title">XXII. Selic repurchase agreements in broad money (BRL)</h3>
        <p id="subtitle-fig2selicrepos" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Month-end stock in BRL billions. Real values are in the latest common month prices (IPCA).</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-fig2selicrepos" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig2selicrepos" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig2selicrepos" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig2selicrepos" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden><div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig2selicrepos" class="macro-presidents-items"></div></div>
        </div></div><aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig2selicrepos" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Meios de pagamento amplos - Operações compromissadas/Selic (saldo em final de período)</em></span></p><p>SGS 1839 measures the month-end balance of Selic-registered repurchase agreements held by the money-holding public. The BCB publishes it as a component of broad money (M3).</p><p>Current prices use the published balance. Values in BRL thousands are divided by one million to display BRL billions.</p><p>The real series multiplies each balance by the compounded monthly IPCA factors (SGS 433) from the following month through the latest month common to both series. The subtitle identifies that price reference.</p><p>The chart starts in January 2000. The BCB’s historical revision of broad monetary aggregates starts in December 2001.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig2selicrepos" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite"></div></div></details>
          <button id="download-fig2selicrepos" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig2selicrepos" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: BCB–SGS <a href="https://dadosabertos.bcb.gov.br/dataset/1839-sgs" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1839</a> (repo stock) and <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.433/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">433</a> (IPCA).</p></aside></div>
      <p id="status-fig2selicrepos" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p></div>

      </div>
    </details>
