  <section id="section-labor-market" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-labor-market">
    <details id="group-labor-market" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-labor-market" class="macro-heading">Labor market</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
    <div id="panel-fig6c" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXIII. Labor force, employment and unemployment">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig6c" class="macro-plot-title">XXIII. Labor force, employment and unemployment</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">PNAD Continuous Survey, moving-quarter estimates; millions of people.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig6c" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig6c" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig6c" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig6c" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig6c" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Labor force — left axis</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>População na força de trabalho – PNADC</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24378" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24378</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Employed people — left axis</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Pessoas ocupadas – PNADC</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24379" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24379</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Unemployed people — right axis</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Pessoas desocupadas – PNADC</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24380" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24380</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>The three series are estimates from the IBGE Continuous National Household Sample Survey (PNAD Continuous Survey), distributed through the SGS, for people aged 14 or older.</p>
            <p>Labor force and employed people use the left axis, fixed from 80 to 110 million people. Unemployed people use the right axis, fixed from 0 to 30 million people.</p>
            <p>The published SGS unit is thousands of people. Each value is divided by 1,000 to display millions of people; it is not divided by one million.</p>
            <p>Each date denotes the moving three-month reference period ending in that month. These are not counts for an isolated month. No additional moving average, seasonal adjustment or interpolation is applied.</p>
            <p>Labor force equals employed plus unemployed people, apart from rounding in the published series. The first observation is the moving quarter ending in March 2012; the x axis begins in January 2012.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig6c" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig6c" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig6c" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.ibge.gov.br/estatisticas/sociais/trabalho/9173-pnad-continua.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE – PNAD Continuous Survey</a> – <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/localizarseries/localizarSeries.do?method=prepararTelaLocalizarSeries" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><em lang="pt-BR">Sistema Gerenciador de Séries Temporais (SGS)</em></a>, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24378" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24378</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24379" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24379</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=24380" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>24380</strong></a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig6c" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig6b" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXIV. Unemployment rate (moving quarter)">

            <p class="macro-series"><strong>18–24 years</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - 18 a 24 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_1824&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_1824</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>25–39 years</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - 25 a 39 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_2539&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_2539</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>40–59 years</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Informalidade - 40 a 59 anos</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_4059&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADCT_TXINFORMUF_4059</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: quarterly.</p>

  <section id="section-industry-retail" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-industry-retail">
    <details id="group-industry-retail" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-industry-retail" class="macro-heading">Industry, retail, services and consumer confidence</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
    <div id="panel-fig4a" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXXI. Industrial production, retail trade and services">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig4a" class="macro-plot-title">XXXI. Industrial production, retail trade and services</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig4a" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Seasonally adjusted monthly indices, 2022 = 100; services available from January 2011.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig4a" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig4a" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig4a" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig4a" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig4a" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig4a" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Industrial production</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Produção industrial – indústria geral – com ajuste sazonal</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=28503" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>28503</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Retail trade</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Índice de volume de vendas no varejo – Brasil – com ajuste sazonal</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=28473" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>28473</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Services</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>PMS - Índice de volume de serviços com ajuste sazonal (2022=100)</em></span><br>IBGE SIDRA: <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/5906" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>5906</strong></a>, variable 7168; volume category 56726.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
<p>All three series are seasonally adjusted native indices with 2022 = 100. No additional rebasing, seasonal adjustment or smoothing is applied.</p>
<p>Industrial production and retail trade retain the existing BCB–SGS series 28503 and 28473. Services come directly from IBGE's Monthly Survey of Services (PMS), SIDRA table 5906, variable 7168, type of index 56726 (volume).</p>
<p>PMS covers the market non-financial services within the survey's scope, excluding health and education. It is not the services-sector value added from national accounts.</p>
<p>The PMS series begins in January 2011. Its native monthly dates are retained; no earlier services observations are created.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig4a" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig4a" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
        <div class="macro-indicators">
          <p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p>
          <div id="keys-fig4a" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div>
        </div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE, via <a href="https://www.bcb.gov.br/en/statistics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">BCB–SGS</a> (28503, 28473), and <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/5906" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 5906 — PMS services volume</a> (variable 7168, volume category 56726).</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig4a" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig4categories" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXXII. Industrial production by economic category">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig4categories" class="macro-plot-title">XXXII. Industrial production by economic category</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Four categories of physical production; monthly seasonally adjusted indices, 2022 = 100.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig4categories" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig4categories" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig4categories" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig4categories" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig4categories" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Capital goods</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Bens de capital</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8887" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PIM-PF / SIDRA 8887</a>, variable 12607.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Intermediate goods</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Bens intermediários</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8887" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PIM-PF / SIDRA 8887</a>, variable 12607.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Consumer durables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Bens de consumo duráveis</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8887" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PIM-PF / SIDRA 8887</a>, variable 12607.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Semi/non-durables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Bens de consumo semiduráveis e não duráveis</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8887" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PIM-PF / SIDRA 8887</a>, variable 12607.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
              <p>These are native monthly seasonally adjusted volume indices on the published 2022 = 100 scale. No additional rebasing, seasonal adjustment, smoothing or interpolation is applied.</p>
<p>The published seasonally adjusted observations in 2022 need not average exactly 100. Their original values and scale are retained.</p>
<p>The lines compare each category’s trajectory over time. Index levels are not sector sizes, market shares or contributions to aggregate growth.</p>
<p>Each series retains its available history and latest source observation. Missing months are not filled or carried forward.</p>
<p>Physical production is measured by the IBGE PIM-PF. Capital-goods production is a domestic output category and is not total fixed investment.</p>
<p>The four individual categories are capital goods, intermediate goods, consumer durables, and semi-durable/non-durable consumer goods.</p>
              <p>Official APIs are checked through the dashboard’s monthly update cycle. The last available data remain displayed during temporary source outages.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig4categories" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig4categories" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators">
            <p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p>
            <div id="keys-fig4categories" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8887" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">PIM-PF, SIDRA 8887</a>, variable 12607.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig4categories" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig4capacity" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXXIII. Manufacturing capacity utilisation">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig4capacity" class="macro-plot-title">XXXIII. Manufacturing capacity utilisation</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Share of manufacturing capacity in use; seasonally adjusted percentage, CNI via BCB–SGS.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig4capacity" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig4capacity" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig4capacity" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig4capacity" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig4capacity" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Capacity utilisation</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Utilização da capacidade instalada da indústria de transformação</em></span><br>CNI, via BCB–SGS <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=28554" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">28554</a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
              <p>The series measures the percentage of installed manufacturing capacity in use. It is a capacity-utilisation level, not an index rebased to 100.</p>
<p>Monthly seasonally adjusted observations are supplied by CNI and distributed through BCB–SGS 28554. No additional adjustment, rebasing or smoothing is applied.</p>
<p>The SGS catalogue uses the generic unit label “Index”; the percentage interpretation was checked against the current CNI publication and historical workbook, including the July–August 2026 readings.</p>
<p>The currently published seasonally adjusted history is used throughout. Historical observations can be revised when the producer updates seasonal adjustment; older releases may show different historical values.</p>
<p>A higher percentage indicates greater utilisation of the surveyed manufacturing capacity. This is not productivity or the economy-wide output gap.</p>
<p>The source history starts in January 2003; earlier observations are not imputed.</p>
              <p>Official APIs are checked through the dashboard’s monthly update cycle. The last available data remain displayed during temporary source outages.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig4capacity" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig4capacity" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators">
            <p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p>
            <div id="keys-fig4capacity" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.portaldaindustria.com.br/estatisticas/indicadores-industriais/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">CNI — Industrial Indicators</a>, via <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=28554" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">BCB–SGS 28554</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig4capacity" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

<div id="panel-fig6industriallabor" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig6industriallabor">
      <div class="macro-layout"><div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig6industriallabor" class="macro-plot-title">XXXIV. Industrial hours, employment, sales and payroll</h3>
        <p id="subtitle-fig6industriallabor" class="macro-plot-subtitle">CNI monthly indices, 2006 average = 100. Hours, employment and real sales are seasonally adjusted. Real payroll starts in 2006.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-fig6industriallabor" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig6industriallabor" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig6industriallabor" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig6industriallabor" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden><div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig6industriallabor" class="macro-presidents-items"></div></div>
        </div></div><aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig6industriallabor" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Indicadores Industriais - horas trabalhadas - indústria - índice dessazonalizado (média 2006 = 100)</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Indicadores Industriais - pessoal empregado - indústria - índice dessazonalizado (média 2006 = 100)</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Indicadores Industriais - faturamento real - indústria - índice dessazonalizado (média 2006 = 100)</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Indicadores Industriais - massa salarial - real - indústria - índice (média 2006 = 100)</em></span></p><p>CNI’s Industrial Indicators survey covers manufacturing. Hours measure time actually worked by production staff, excluding paid time off.</p><p>Employment tracks the number of people employed in the surveyed establishments. Hours, employment and real sales are seasonally adjusted and start in January 1992.</p><p>Sales are deflated using sector-specific FGV IPA-OG price indices. Real payroll measures aggregate payroll deflated by the IBGE INPC. It retains its seasonal pattern and starts in January 2006.</p><p>All four indices use the published 2006 average as 100.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig6industriallabor" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite"></div></div></details>
          <button id="download-fig6industriallabor" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig6industriallabor" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: CNI via Ipeadata. <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;CNI12_HTRABD12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">CNI12_HTRABD12</a>, <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;CNI12_PEEMPD12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">CNI12_PEEMPD12</a>, <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;CNI12_VENRED12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">CNI12_VENRED12</a>, <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;CNI12_REMR12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">CNI12_REMR12</a>.</p></aside></div>
      <p id="status-fig6industriallabor" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p></div>

    <div id="panel-fig4retail" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXXV. Retail sales volume by segment">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig4retail" class="macro-plot-title">XXXV. Retail sales volume by segment</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Food, clothing, furniture/appliances and vehicles; monthly seasonally adjusted indices, 2022 = 100.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig4retail" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig4retail" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig4retail" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig4retail" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig4retail" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Food retail</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Hipermercados, supermercados, produtos alimentícios, bebidas e fumo</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8882" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMC / SIDRA 8882</a>, variable 7170.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Clothing</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Tecidos, vestuário e calçados</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8882" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMC / SIDRA 8882</a>, variable 7170.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Furniture/appliances</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Móveis e eletrodomésticos</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8882" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMC / SIDRA 8882</a>, variable 7170.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Vehicles</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Veículos, motocicletas, partes e peças</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8883" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMC / SIDRA 8883</a>, variable 7170.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
              <p>These are native monthly seasonally adjusted volume indices on the published 2022 = 100 scale. No additional rebasing, seasonal adjustment, smoothing or interpolation is applied.</p>
<p>The published seasonally adjusted observations in 2022 need not average exactly 100. Their original values and scale are retained.</p>
<p>The lines compare each category’s trajectory over time. Index levels are not sector sizes, market shares or contributions to aggregate growth.</p>
<p>Each series retains its available history and latest source observation. Missing months are not filled or carried forward.</p>
<p>Food retail covers hypermarkets, supermarkets, food products, beverages and tobacco. Clothing covers textiles, apparel and footwear.</p>
<p>Vehicles, motorcycles, parts and accessories are taken from the expanded-retail survey (SIDRA 8883). They are compared as an individual segment, not included in the restricted-retail aggregate shown in the overview.</p>
<p>The four segments are a selection of PMC activities, not a complete decomposition of retail trade.</p>
              <p>Official APIs are checked through the dashboard’s monthly update cycle. The last available data remain displayed during temporary source outages.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig4retail" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig4retail" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators">
            <p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p>
            <div id="keys-fig4retail" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — PMC, <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8882" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 8882</a> and <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8883" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">8883</a>, variable 7170.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig4retail" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig4services" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXXVI. Services volume by activity">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig4services" class="macro-plot-title">XXXVI. Services volume by activity</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Five PMS activity groups; monthly seasonally adjusted volume indices, 2022 = 100.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig4services" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig4services" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig4services" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig4services" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig4services" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Families</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>1. Serviços prestados às famílias</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8688" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMS / SIDRA 8688</a>, variable 7168.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Information</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>2. Serviços de informação e comunicação</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8688" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMS / SIDRA 8688</a>, variable 7168.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Professional</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>3. Serviços profissionais, administrativos e complementares</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8688" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMS / SIDRA 8688</a>, variable 7168.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Transport</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>4. Transportes, serviços auxiliares aos transportes e correio</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8688" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMS / SIDRA 8688</a>, variable 7168.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Other</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>5. Outros serviços</em></span><br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/8688" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / PMS / SIDRA 8688</a>, variable 7168.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
              <p>These are native monthly seasonally adjusted volume indices on the published 2022 = 100 scale. No additional rebasing, seasonal adjustment, smoothing or interpolation is applied.</p>
<p>The published seasonally adjusted observations in 2022 need not average exactly 100. Their original values and scale are retained.</p>
<p>The lines compare each category’s trajectory over time. Index levels are not sector sizes, market shares or contributions to aggregate growth.</p>
<p>Each series retains its available history and latest source observation. Missing months are not filled or carried forward.</p>
<p>The five activity groups are services to households; information and communication; professional, administrative and complementary services; transport, auxiliary transport services and postal activities; and other services.</p>
<p>PMS measures market non-financial services within its survey scope, excluding health and education. It is not the whole services-sector value added in the national accounts.</p>
<p>All five activity groups are shown individually; no unweighted average across the groups is calculated. The official aggregate uses its own survey weights.</p>
<p>The PMS history starts in January 2011; earlier observations are not imputed.</p>
              <p>Official APIs are checked through the dashboard’s monthly update cycle. The last available data remain displayed during temporary source outages.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>

    <div id="panel-fig4b" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XXXVII. Consumer confidence indicators">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig4b" class="macro-plot-title">XXXVII. Consumer confidence indicators</h3>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">

        </div>

            aria-labelledby="title-crop-production-area-yield" aria-describedby="subtitle-crop-production-area-yield" aria-busy="true"></div>

            <summary>About the data</summary>

Each series uses its own 2002 value as the denominator. Coffee starts in 2002, when IBGE began reporting production as processed beans.</p><p>Official SIDRA data are checked each monthly cycle from the 20th. The last valid series remain available during a source outage.</p><p>Presidential bands before 1985 follow the <a href="https://www.gov.br/arquivonacional/pt-br/servicos/publicacoes/OspresidenteseaRepblica_DeodoroDilma.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">National Archives chronology</a>.</p><p>Data snapshot prepared on 11 November 2026.</p><p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-crop-production-area-yield" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div></div>

          </div>
          
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/5457" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE, PAM · SIDRA 5457</a> · <a href="https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/5457/n1/1/v/216,214,112/p/all/c782/40124,40122,40139,40112" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">National series API</a><br>SIDRA 5457 · variables 214, 216 and 112.</p>

Conab crop years and the IBGE calendar-year PAM are displayed in separate panels.</p><p>Presidential bands before 1985 follow the <a href="https://www.gov.br/arquivonacional/pt-br/servicos/publicacoes/OspresidenteseaRepblica_DeodoroDilma.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">National Archives chronology</a>.</p><p>Data snapshot prepared on 11 November 2026.</p><p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-soybean-and-maize-harvests" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div></div>

  <section id="section-credit-bndes" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-credit-bndes">
    <details id="group-credit-bndes" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-credit-bndes" class="macro-heading">Credit and household finances</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
    <p class="macro-section-intro">BNDES is Brazil’s federal development bank.</p>
    <div id="panel-fig3a" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XLII. Credit and BNDES lending (% of GDP)">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig3a" class="macro-plot-title">XLII. Credit and BNDES lending (% of GDP)</h3>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig3a" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig3a" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig3a" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig3a" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig3a" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Total credit / GDP</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Saldo da carteira de crédito em relação ao PIB</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=20622" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>20622</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>BNDES total lending / GDP</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Desembolsos do sistema BNDES – Total</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=7415" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>7415</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=4380" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>4380</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>BNDES (Brazilian Development Bank) is Brazil’s federal public development bank.</p>
            <p>The BNDES indicator is the sum of 12 observations of SGS 7415, divided by the 12-month sum of nominal GDP (SGS 4380), multiplied by 100.</p>
            <p>SGS 7415 reports year-to-date disbursements. Its 12-observation sum adds overlapping year-to-date amounts; this indicator is not total disbursements during the previous 12 months.</p>
            <p>The sector chart below retains the monthly-flow calculation described in its own notes.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig3a" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig3a" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
        <div class="macro-indicators">
          <p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p>
          <div id="keys-fig3a" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div>
        </div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.bcb.gov.br/en/statistics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Brazilian Central Bank (BCB)</a> – <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/localizarseries/localizarSeries.do?method=prepararTelaLocalizarSeries" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><em lang="pt-BR">Sistema Gerenciador de Séries Temporais (SGS)</em></a>, codes <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=20622" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>20622</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=7415" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>7415</strong></a>, <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=4380" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>4380</strong></a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig3a" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig3b" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XLIII. BNDES lending by sector (current BRL)">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig3b" class="macro-plot-title">XLIII. BNDES lending by sector (current BRL)</h3>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig3b" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig3b" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig3b" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>

        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig3b" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">

            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Commerce &amp; services</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Desembolsos do sistema BNDES – Comércio e serviços</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=7417" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>7417</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>

            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Agriculture</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Desembolsos do sistema BNDES – Agropecuária</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=7418" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>7418</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Mining</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Desembolsos do sistema BNDES – Indústria extrativa</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=7419" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>7419</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>BNDES (Brazilian Development Bank) is Brazil’s federal public development bank.</p>
            <p>Nominal disbursements, converted from cumulative year-to-date observations into monthly flows and then summed over 12 consecutive months.</p>
            <p>Values are in current BRL trillions; the display cutoff is applied before the rolling sum.</p>

            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Households</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa média de juros das operações de crédito – pessoas físicas – total</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=20716" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>20716</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Companies</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa média de juros das operações de crédito – pessoas jurídicas – total</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=20715" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>20715</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>Average interest rates on new credit operations, weighted by amounts granted. The series cover both earmarked and non-earmarked credit.</p>
            <p>The rates are annual percentages observed monthly, as published by the BCB; they are not monthly interest rates and are not annualized again.</p>
            <p>These indicators refer to credit across Brazil’s financial system, not specifically to BNDES.</p>

    <div id="panel-fig3e" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="XLV. Household debt and debt-service burden">
      <div class="macro-layout">

          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Debt is measured against 12-month income; debt service against monthly income.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig3e" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig3e" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig3e" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig3e" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig3e" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Debt / 12-month income</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Endividamento das famílias com o Sistema Financeiro Nacional em relação à renda acumulada dos últimos doze meses</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=29037" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>29037</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Debt service / monthly income</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Comprometimento de renda das famílias com o serviço da dívida com o Sistema Financeiro Nacional – com ajuste sazonal</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=29034" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>29034</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p>Household indebtedness is the outstanding debt stock with the national financial system divided by household income accumulated over the previous twelve months.</p>
            <p>The debt-service burden relates expected interest and amortization payments to monthly household income, published as a seasonally adjusted three-month moving average.</p>
            <p>Both series are percentages, but their income denominators differ. They are plotted on one common scale without additional moving averages.</p>
            <p>The indicators cover households’ debt with the national financial system, not specifically BNDES loans.</p>

          <p id="subtitle-fig3c" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Loans with instalments over 90 days past due; % of each borrower group&#x27;s credit portfolio.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig3c" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig3c" aria-busy="true" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig3c"></div>

            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig3c" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
<p class="macro-series"><strong>Total</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Inadimplência da carteira de crédito – Total</em></span><br>All borrowers.<br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=21082" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>21082</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly. Unit: %.</p>
<p class="macro-series"><strong>Companies (PJ)</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Inadimplência da carteira de crédito – Pessoas jurídicas – Total</em></span><br>Non-financial corporations.<br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=21083" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>21083</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly. Unit: %.</p>
<p class="macro-series"><strong>Households (PF)</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Inadimplência da carteira de crédito – Pessoas físicas – Total</em></span><br>Households.<br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=21084" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>21084</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly. Unit: %.</p>
<p>The BCB measures the share of the credit portfolio with at least one instalment more than 90 days past due. Both earmarked and non-earmarked credit are included.</p>
<p>Total covers all borrowers. The BCB English catalogue identifies the PJ series as non-financial corporations and the PF series as households.</p>
<p>Each rate uses its own group’s credit portfolio as the denominator. These are percentages of loan balances, not percentages of people or companies.</p>
<p>Total is the aggregate published by the BCB; no simple average of the two borrower-group rates is calculated.</p>
<p>The native monthly percentages are shown directly, without annualization, a 12-month sum, smoothing, rebasing or interpolation. The available history starts in March 2011.</p>
<p>The official SGS API is checked through the dashboard’s monthly update cycle. The last available observations remain displayed during temporary source outages.</p>

        </aside>

<div id="panel-fig3provisions" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig3provisions">
      <div class="macro-layout"><div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig3provisions" class="macro-plot-title">XLVII. Credit loss provisions by institutional control</h3>
        <p id="subtitle-fig3provisions" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Monthly provisions as a share of the credit portfolio, by control of the financial institution.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-fig3provisions" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig3provisions" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig3provisions" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig3provisions" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden><div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig3provisions" class="macro-presidents-items"></div></div>
        </div></div><aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig3provisions" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Percentual do total de provisões em relação à carteira de crédito do Sistema Financeiro Nacional</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Percentual do total de provisões em relação à carteira de crédito das instituições financeiras sob controle público</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Percentual do total de provisões em relação à carteira de crédito das instituições financeiras sob controle privado</em></span></p><p>Each percentage divides total credit loss provisions by the corresponding credit portfolio. Provisions are amounts recognised to cover credit losses.</p><p>Total is the BCB’s published aggregate for the National Financial System (SFN). Public and private refer to who controls the financial institution. Each group uses its own credit portfolio as the denominator.</p><p>The chart displays the published monthly percentages from June 1988. The adjacent delinquency chart measures overdue balances by borrower group.</p><p>From January 2025, the BCB’s accounting framework under CMN Resolution 4,966 uses expected credit losses. The change in provisioning methodology affects comparisons across that date. See the BCB’s March 2025 monetary and credit statistics release.</p>

            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Imports</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Importação de bens – Balanço de Pagamentos – mensal</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22709" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22709</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Trade balance</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Balança comercial – Balanço de Pagamentos – mensal – saldo</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=22707" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>22707</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>

<div id="panel-fig5termstrade" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig5termstrade">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig5termstrade" class="macro-plot-title">LI. External trade: relative prices and volumes</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig5termstrade" class="macro-plot-subtitle">A: export prices relative to import prices. B: export and import volumes (quantum). Monthly indices: 2019 = 100.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas">
          <div id="chart-fig5termstrade" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig5termstrade" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig5termstrade" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
            <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig5termstrade" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
          </div></div></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig5termstrade" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Terms of trade</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Termos de troca - índice (média 2018 = 100)</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;FUNCEX12_TTR12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>FUNCEX12_TTR12</strong></a>. Monthly; index.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Export quantum</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Exportações -  quantum - índice (média 2018 = 100)</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;FUNCEX12_XQT12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>FUNCEX12_XQT12</strong></a>. Monthly; index.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Import quantum</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Importações -  quantum - índice (média 2018 = 100)</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;FUNCEX12_MDQT12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>FUNCEX12_MDQT12</strong></a>. Monthly; index.</p><p>Terms of trade measure export prices relative to import prices. The published Funcex terms-of-trade series is retained rather than reconstructed from rounded component-price indices.</p><p>Quantum is a trade-volume index that removes price changes from export or import values. It does not measure aggregate tonnes.</p><p>Each series is divided by its own arithmetic mean across all twelve months of 2019 and multiplied by 100. The base year is complete for all three series.</p><p>For terms of trade, 110 means export prices relative to import prices are 10% above the 2019 mean. It does not imply a trade surplus or equal nominal exports and imports.</p><p>For each quantum series, 100 is its own average volume in 2019. Equal export and import index levels do not imply equal physical quantities or equal trade values.</p><p>Native monthly observations are retained without additional seasonal adjustment, smoothing or interpolation. The display starts in January 1990 and ends at the latest month common to all three series.</p><p>The import metadata state that customs-clearance values are used from 1997 onward. This historical source convention is retained without splicing providers.</p><p>The upper and lower panels use their own vertical scales to keep changes in relative prices and volumes visible. The 100 lines refer to each series&#x27;s 2019 mean.</p><p>The official Ipeadata API is checked on the dashboard&#x27;s monthly update cycle. All three complete histories and their 2019 reference months must pass validation before the displayed group is updated. During a temporary source failure, the last complete group remains available.</p><p>Data prepared on 5 November 2026. All three source metadata records were updated on 23 October 2026; the latest common observation available on that date was August 2026. The original published base is average 2018 = 100; the displayed base is average 2019 = 100.</p><p>Presidential backgrounds identify calendar periods and do not establish causal effects.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig5termstrade" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
          </div></details>
          <button id="download-fig5termstrade" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: Funcex via <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata / Ipea</a>. Monthly indices; 2019 = 100.<br>FUNCEX12_TTR12 · FUNCEX12_XQT12 · FUNCEX12_MDQT12.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-fig5termstrade" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

  <section id="section-inequality-poverty" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-inequality-poverty">
    <details id="group-inequality-poverty" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-inequality-poverty" class="macro-heading">Inequality and poverty</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">

    <div id="panel-fig7a" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="LV. Income inequality: Gini index">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig7a" class="macro-plot-title">LV. Income inequality: Gini index</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig7a" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Annual estimates; PNAD and PNAD Continuous series linked by Ipea.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig7a" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig7a" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig7a" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig7a" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig7a" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig7a" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Gini index</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Coeficiente de Gini da renda domiciliar per capita de todas as fontes</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_GINI&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADS_GINI</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p>Annual estimates for Brazil, based on per capita household income from all sources.</p>
            <p>Ipea links the former PNAD through 2011 to PNAD Continuous from 2012, using indicator-specific factors calculated in the 2012 overlap. The earlier observations are adjusted estimates.</p>
            <p>The original annual frequency is retained. Years without a survey, including 2000 and 2010, have no observations. Lines connect the available annual observations; no missing-year values are created.</p>
            <p>The source reports Gini on a 0–100 scale. Values are divided by 100 to display the conventional 0–1 scale; lower values indicate less inequality.</p>
            <p>Methodology: <a href="https://www.ipea.gov.br/portal/images/noticias/PDF/251125_nota_tecnica.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Souza and Hecksher (2025), Ipea</a>.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>

    <div id="panel-fig7b" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="LVI. Income concentration: Palma ratio">

          <p id="subtitle-fig7b" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Income share of the richest 10% divided by the income share of the poorest 40%.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">

            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Palma ratio</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Razão de Palma da renda domiciliar per capita de todas as fontes</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PALMA&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADS_PALMA</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p>Annual estimates for Brazil, based on per capita household income from all sources.</p>
            <p>Ipea links the former PNAD through 2011 to PNAD Continuous from 2012, using indicator-specific factors calculated in the 2012 overlap. The earlier observations are adjusted estimates.</p>
            <p>The original annual frequency is retained. Years without a survey, including 2000 and 2010, have no observations. Lines connect the available annual observations; no missing-year values are created.</p>
            <p>The Palma ratio compares the two groups’ shares of total income. Higher values indicate greater income concentration.</p>
            <p>Methodology: <a href="https://www.ipea.gov.br/portal/images/noticias/PDF/251125_nota_tecnica.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Souza and Hecksher (2025), Ipea</a>.</p>

          <p id="subtitle-fig7c" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Poverty: Int$8.30/day; extreme poverty: Int$3.00/day, per person in 2021 PPP international dollars.</p>

          <details id="info-fig7c" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Poverty</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Proporção de pessoas abaixo da linha de pobreza de PPC$8,30</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PERCPOBRE830&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADS_PERCPOBRE830</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Extreme poverty</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Proporção de pessoas abaixo da linha de pobreza de PPC$3,00</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;PNADS_PERCPOBRE300&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>PNADS_PERCPOBRE300</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p>
            <p>Annual estimates for Brazil, based on per capita household income from all sources.</p>
            <p>Ipea links the former PNAD through 2011 to PNAD Continuous from 2012, using indicator-specific factors calculated in the 2012 overlap. The earlier observations are adjusted estimates.</p>
            <p>The original annual frequency is retained. Years without a survey, including 2000 and 2010, have no observations. Lines connect the available annual observations; no missing-year values are created.</p>
            <p>Poverty and extreme poverty are the percentages of the total population with per capita household income below the respective line.</p>
            <p>Both thresholds use 2021 purchasing power parities (PPP). In average 2024 prices, the thresholds correspond to BRL 738 and BRL 267 per person per month, respectively.</p>
            <p>The extreme-poverty population is included in the poverty population; the two series are not added together.</p>
            <p>Methodology: <a href="https://www.ipea.gov.br/portal/images/noticias/PDF/251125_nota_tecnica.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Souza and Hecksher (2025), Ipea</a>.</p>

    <div id="panel-fig7e" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="LIX. Bolsa Família transfers: nominal and real (BRL)">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig7e" class="macro-plot-title">LIX. Bolsa Família transfers: nominal and real (BRL)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig7e" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Brazil’s cash transfer programme; monthly totals in BRL billions. Constant prices: <span data-price-base>latest common month</span> (IPCA).</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig7e" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig7e" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig7e" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig7e" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig7e" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig7e" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info">
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Current prices</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Programa Bolsa Família (PBF) - valor total mensal dos benefícios</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;VAL_PBF12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>VAL_PBF12</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>IPCA-adjusted</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Programa Bolsa Família (PBF) - valor total mensal dos benefícios</em></span><br>Ipeadata: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;VAL_PBF12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>VAL_PBF12</strong></a>.<br>Frequency: monthly.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>IPCA price adjustment</strong><br>Monthly consumer price inflation, BCB–SGS <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=433" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>433</strong></a>.</p>
            <p>Bolsa Família is Brazil’s cash transfer programme for low-income families. The administrative series includes the Auxílio Brasil period and subsequent return to the Bolsa Família name.</p>
            <p>The source is MDS administrative records obtained from the federal Transparency Portal. Suspended benefits are excluded.</p>
            <p>Current-price transfers are the published monthly totals. The source unit is BRL thousands, divided by one million to display BRL billions.</p>
            <p>The constant-price series uses the compounded monthly IPCA changes from BCB–SGS 433. Each amount is multiplied by the ratio of the price index in the reference month to the index in the observation month.</p>
            <p>Price reference: <span data-price-base>latest common month</span>, the latest month jointly available in the transfers and IPCA series. The reference updates automatically when both sources contain a newer month.</p>
            <p>Only months with complete IPCA coverage are converted to constant prices. The original monthly frequency is retained.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p>
              <div id="latest-fig7e" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: MDS / Transparency Portal, via <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;VAL_PBF12&#x27;)" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">VAL_PBF12</a>. Price adjustment: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=433" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">BCB–SGS 433 (IPCA)</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>

    </div>

          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>

        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-pbf" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Quantidade de parcelas pagas do Bolsa Família</em></span></p>
              <p>Number of payment records across all twelve 2025 payroll months (competência 202501–202512). Each record is one benefit payment. A recipient can appear in several months, and retroactive instalments can appear separately. This is not the number of unique families or people.</p><p>Source: CGU Transparency Portal, Novo Bolsa Família payment files. The year is defined by payroll month (competência), including retroactive instalments paid in those months, even where their benefit reference month is earlier. All three municipal maps use exactly the same payment records and January–December period.</p><p>Municipalities are matched using the official Treasury SIAFI-to-IBGE correspondence. These transaction-based CGU records differ from the MDS/Ipeadata count of families in a single month; the two definitions are not automatically substituted for each other.</p>
              <p>The colourbar is centred on the national median of available municipal indicator values. Each municipality contributes one observation; with an even number of observations, the median is the average of the two central values. The reference, minimum and maximum remain fixed when a state is selected.</p>
              <p>Green indicates lower values and red higher values. Log(1 + value) colour spacing is centred on the national municipal median.</p>
              <p>The maps use the same 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from IBGE’s 2022 reference. Source territories outside this boundary reference are counted separately; missing values appear in very light grey.</p>
              <p>Fixed full-year reference: 2025, using all twelve official monthly payment files.</p>
              <p>This annual dataset remains available and is distinct from the December-only series.</p>
              <p><strong>Reference and data preparation</strong></p>
              <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: January–December 2025. Data prepared on 31 October 2026.</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-pbf">State

          </label>

          <p class="macro-map-reference">Green: lower values · red: higher values.<br>Centre: national municipal median.</p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: CGU — <a href="https://portaldatransparencia.gov.br/download-de-dados/novo-bolsa-familia" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Transparency Portal, monthly 2025 payment files</a>.<br>CGU Novo Bolsa Família payroll CSV, count of payment rows by MÊS COMPETÊNCIA.</p>
        </aside>
