          <details id="info-map-pbf-average" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Valor total das parcelas pagas do Bolsa Família</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Quantidade de parcelas pagas do Bolsa Família</em></span></p>
              <p>Total municipal payments in BRL in the twelve 2025 payroll months divided by the number of payment records in the same twelve months. This is a payment-weighted annual mean, calculated before rounding. It is not annual income per unique family and not a simple mean of the twelve monthly means. Zero denominators are treated as missing.</p><p>Source: CGU Transparency Portal, Novo Bolsa Família payment files. The year is defined by payroll month (competência), including retroactive instalments paid in those months, even where their benefit reference month is earlier. All three municipal maps use exactly the same payment records and January–December period.</p><p>Municipalities are matched using the official Treasury SIAFI-to-IBGE correspondence. These transaction-based CGU records differ from the MDS/Ipeadata count of families in a single month; the two definitions are not automatically substituted for each other.</p>
              <p>The colourbar is centred on the national median of available municipal indicator values. Each municipality contributes one observation; with an even number of observations, the median is the average of the two central values. The reference, minimum and maximum remain fixed when a state is selected.</p>
              <p>Green indicates lower values and red higher values. Linear colour spacing is centred on the national municipal median.</p>
              <p>The maps use the same 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from IBGE’s 2022 reference. Source territories outside this boundary reference are counted separately; missing values appear in very light grey.</p>
              <p>Fixed full-year reference: 2025, using all twelve official monthly payment files.</p>
              <p>This annual dataset remains available and is distinct from the December-only series.</p>
              <p><strong>Reference and data preparation</strong></p>
              <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: January–December 2025. Data prepared on 31 October 2026.</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-pbf-average">State
            <select id="state-map-pbf-average" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select>
          </label>
          <button id="download-map-pbf-average" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Green: lower values · red: higher values.<br>Centre: national municipal median.</p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: CGU — <a href="https://portaldatransparencia.gov.br/download-de-dados/novo-bolsa-familia" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Transparency Portal, monthly 2025 payment files</a>.<br>CGU Novo Bolsa Família payroll CSV, VALOR PARCELA and count of payment rows.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-map-pbf-average" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

  
      </div>
    </details>
  </section>
  <section id="section-education" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-education">
    <details id="group-education" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-education" class="macro-heading">Education</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
    <div id="panel-fig8a" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="LXIII. Education completion by level">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig8a" class="macro-plot-title">LXIII. Education completion by level</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig8a" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Share completing each level among its reference-age cohort; observations through 2024.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig8a" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig8a" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig8a" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig8a" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
              <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div>
              <div id="president-items-fig8a" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig8a" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de conclusão dos anos iniciais do ensino fundamental</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de conclusão dos anos finais do ensino fundamental</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de conclusão do ensino médio</em></span></p>
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Primary</strong><br>Completion rate, primary education, both sexes (%)<br><a href="https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/data/indicators?indicator=CR.1&amp;geoUnit=BRA&amp;start=1995&amp;footnotes=true&amp;indicatorMetadata=true" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">UNESCO UIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Lower secondary</strong><br>Completion rate, lower secondary education, both sexes (%)<br><a href="https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/data/indicators?indicator=CR.2&amp;geoUnit=BRA&amp;start=1995&amp;footnotes=true&amp;indicatorMetadata=true" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">UNESCO UIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Upper secondary</strong><br>Completion rate, upper secondary education, both sexes (%)<br><a href="https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/data/indicators?indicator=CR.3&amp;geoUnit=BRA&amp;start=1995&amp;footnotes=true&amp;indicatorMetadata=true" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">UNESCO UIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p>For each level, UIS measures the share who completed its final grade among people aged three to five years above the intended age for that grade.</p><p>Primary, lower secondary and upper secondary therefore use different reference-age groups. The curves are not parts of one total and should not be added.</p><p>These are completion percentages, not annual graduation rates or average years of study. They are not directly comparable to the adult mean in the next chart.</p><p>Only published observations are shown. Lines connect available observations; missing-year values are not created.</p>
              <p>Automatic API checks use the same monthly cycle as the rest of the dashboard, beginning on the 20th in America/Fortaleza. New observations appear when the source releases them.</p>
              <p>Lines connect published observations; missing years are not estimated. The last available data remain displayed during temporary source outages.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig8a" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fig8a" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig8a" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/data/indicators?indicator=CR.1&amp;geoUnit=BRA&amp;start=1995&amp;footnotes=true&amp;indicatorMetadata=true" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS)</a>.<br>CR.1 · CR.2 · CR.3.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-fig8a" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

<div id="panel-fig8ideb" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig8ideb">
      <div class="macro-layout"><div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig8ideb" class="macro-plot-title">LXIV. Basic education development index (Ideb)</h3>
        <p id="subtitle-fig8ideb" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Brazil, public and private schools combined, 2005–2025.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-fig8ideb" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig8ideb" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig8ideb" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig8ideb" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden><div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig8ideb" class="macro-presidents-items"></div></div>
        </div></div><aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig8ideb" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Ideb — Anos iniciais do ensino fundamental</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Ideb — Anos finais do ensino fundamental</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Ideb — Ensino médio</em></span></p><p>Biennial results from Inep. Ideb combines standardised achievement on Saeb tests in Portuguese and mathematics with school promotion rates from the School Census.</p><p>All curves represent the national aggregate of public and private schools. Upper secondary follows Inep’s series for traditional upper-secondary education in regular classes.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig8ideb" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite"></div></div></details>

    <div id="panel-fig8b" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="LXV. Mean years of schooling (PNAD, age 25+)">

        <div class="macro-plot-header">

          <p id="subtitle-fig8b" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Average years of study among all adults aged 25+, regardless of employment; through 2025.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig8b" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig8b" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig8b" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig8b" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>

            </div>

        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig8b" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Número médio de anos de estudo das pessoas de 25 anos ou mais — total</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Número médio de anos de estudo das pessoas de 25 anos ou mais — homens</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Número médio de anos de estudo das pessoas de 25 anos ou mais — mulheres</em></span></p>
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Total</strong><br>Mean years of schooling, people aged 25 or older — Total<br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/7126" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / SIDRA, table 7126</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Men</strong><br>Mean years of schooling, people aged 25 or older — Men<br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/7126" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / SIDRA, table 7126</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Women</strong><br>Mean years of schooling, people aged 25 or older — Women<br><a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/7126" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / SIDRA, table 7126</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p>IBGE publishes the mean number of years of study for people aged 25 or older, for the total population and separately for men and women. The population includes people outside formal employment.</p><p>The unit is years per person. No conversion from schooling categories is made by this dashboard; the curves retain the published IBGE means.</p><p>The source has no observations for 2020 or 2021. Lines connect published observations; missing years are not estimated.</p><p>This adult population measure differs from both the level-specific completion cohorts above and the formal job links below. Differences between these charts are not schooling premiums.</p>
              <p>Automatic API checks use the same monthly cycle as the rest of the dashboard, beginning on the 20th in America/Fortaleza. New observations appear when the source releases them.</p>
              <p>Lines connect published observations; missing years are not estimated. The last available data remain displayed during temporary source outages.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig8b" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
            </div>
          </details>

              <p>Mean years of schooling among people aged 25 or more, both sexes and all races/colours. The age selection is 25+ even though the general source variable also supports younger age groups.</p><p>Source: IBGE Population Census, SIDRA table 10062, variable 13285, age category 58=108866.     <div id="panel-map-school-attendance-15-17" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-school-attendance-15-17">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-school-attendance-15-17" class="macro-plot-title">LXVII. Gross school attendance rate by municipality (ages 15–17)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-school-attendance-15-17" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Residents aged 15–17 attending school at any education level; % of the same-age population, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-school-attendance-15-17" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-school-attendance-15-17" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-school-attendance-15-17" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-school-attendance-15-17" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de frequência escolar bruta das pessoas de 15 a 17 anos de idade</em></span></p>
            <p>The gross attendance rate is the share of residents in the selected age group who attend school, irrespective of the level attended. The denominator is all residents aged 15–17.</p><p>It is not the upper-secondary net attendance rate and does not measure completion or attendance only at the expected education level.</p><p>The official published municipal percentages are retained. They are estimates from the Census 2022 sample; no municipal rates are averaged to calculate Brazil.</p><p>All sexes and all colour/race categories are selected through their published total categories.</p><p>The 12 equal-width bands span the national minimum and maximum among municipalities with data. State filters retain the national limits. Labels are rounded for display.</p><p data-map-band-help hidden>More detail at low values subdivides the lower range when the first equal-width band contains at least 95% of municipalities with data. Both scales span the full national range.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The last available data remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Data prepared on 4 November 2026.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="scale-map-school-attendance-15-17" hidden>Colour scale<select id="scale-map-school-attendance-15-17" data-map-band-scale aria-controls="chart-map-school-attendance-15-17"><option value="equal">Equal-width bands</option><option value="detail">More detail at low values</option></select></label>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-school-attendance-15-17">State<select id="state-map-school-attendance-15-17" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-school-attendance-15-17" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br><span data-map-band-caption>12 equal-width national bands.</span></p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10056" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 10056</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10056/periodos/2022/variaveis/3795?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=58%5B2792%5D%7C2%5B6794%5D%7C86%5B95251%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>.<br>SIDRA 10056, variable 3795, age category 2792.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-school-attendance-15-17" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-map-illiteracy-15-19" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-illiteracy-15-19">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-illiteracy-15-19" class="macro-plot-title">LXVIII. Illiteracy rate by municipality (ages 15–19)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-illiteracy-15-19" class="macro-plot-subtitle">100 minus the published literacy rate for residents aged 15–19; % of the same-age population, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-illiteracy-15-19" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-illiteracy-15-19" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-illiteracy-15-19" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-illiteracy-15-19" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de alfabetização das pessoas de 15 a 19 anos de idade</em></span></p>
            <p>SIDRA table 9543 publishes literacy, not illiteracy. This map is a derived indicator: illiteracy rate (%) = 100 − published literacy rate (%), using the 15–19 age category.</p><p>Literacy concerns the ability to read and write at least a simple note in a language the person knows. The denominator is all residents aged 15–19.</p><p>The derivation retains the source rate’s two decimal places. It is not calculated from rounded person counts, and the national reference is derived from the separately published Brazil rate.</p><p>This indicator comes from the Census 2022 full-count literacy results. All sexes and all colour/race categories are selected through their published total categories.</p><p>6 fixed national bands for positive values. The highest band is open. State filters retain the national cutoffs. Pale blue-grey marks observed zero.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p><p>All class limits use municipalities across Brazil. Filtering a state preserves that national reference.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>

              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Below completed fundamental</strong><br>Fundamental incompleto<br><a href="https://www.gov.br/trabalho-e-emprego/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/programas-projetos-acoes-obras-e-atividades/estatisticas-trabalho/painel-de-indicadores-da-rede-de-observatorios-do-trabalho" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MTE / RAIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Fundamental completed</strong><br>Fundamental completo<br><a href="https://www.gov.br/trabalho-e-emprego/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/programas-projetos-acoes-obras-e-atividades/estatisticas-trabalho/painel-de-indicadores-da-rede-de-observatorios-do-trabalho" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MTE / RAIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Secondary completed</strong><br>Médio completo<br><a href="https://www.gov.br/trabalho-e-emprego/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/programas-projetos-acoes-obras-e-atividades/estatisticas-trabalho/painel-de-indicadores-da-rede-de-observatorios-do-trabalho" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MTE / RAIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Tertiary completed or higher</strong><br>Superior completo ou mais<br><a href="https://www.gov.br/trabalho-e-emprego/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/programas-projetos-acoes-obras-e-atividades/estatisticas-trabalho/painel-de-indicadores-da-rede-de-observatorios-do-trabalho" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MTE / RAIS</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p>RAIS counts formal employment links active on 31 December. A person holding two active formal jobs may contribute two links.</p><p>Each curve is a schooling group’s share of the national job-link total. The four mutually exclusive groups sum to 100%; they describe jobs, not the whole adult population.</p><p>Brazilian fundamental education covers primary and lower secondary schooling. The four labels are the broad groups supplied by the dashboard. Reconciliation with the official 2025 RAIS presentation supports interpreting incomplete study at the next level within the preceding completed-level group.</p><p>No schooling groups are converted to years of study here. RAIS/eSocial reporting changes may affect comparisons over time.</p>

    <div id="panel-fig9a" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="LXX. Life expectancy at birth">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-fig9a" class="macro-plot-title">LXX. Life expectancy at birth</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-fig9a" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Total, male and female; annual internationally harmonised estimates through 2024.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig9a" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig9a" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig9a" aria-busy="true"></div>

            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig9a" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Esperança de vida ao nascer — total</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Esperança de vida ao nascer — homens</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Esperança de vida ao nascer — mulheres</em></span></p>
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Total</strong><br>Life expectancy at birth, total (years)<br><a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.IN?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Men</strong><br>Life expectancy at birth, male (years)<br><a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.MA.IN?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Women</strong><br>Life expectancy at birth, female (years)<br><a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.FE.IN?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p>Life expectancy at birth is the number of years a newborn would live if the mortality rates prevailing at birth remained constant throughout life.</p><p>These internationally harmonised UN population estimates are distributed by the World Bank World Development Indicators API. They are not the IBGE life-table series; values and revisions can differ.</p><p>Reference years follow the source observations; database update dates are not observation years. Total is the source-published series, not an average calculated from the male and female curves.</p>
              <p>Automatic API checks use the same monthly cycle as the rest of the dashboard, beginning on the 20th in America/Fortaleza. New observations appear when the source releases them.</p>
              <p>Lines connect published observations; missing years are not estimated. The last available data remain displayed during temporary source outages.</p>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: UN World Population Prospects / national statistical sources; via <a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.IN?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>SP.DYN.LE00.IN · SP.DYN.LE00.MA.IN · SP.DYN.LE00.FE.IN.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>

    <div id="panel-fig9b" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-label="LXXI. Child mortality">

          <p id="subtitle-fig9b" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Infant, neonatal and under-five mortality; estimates per 1,000 live births through 2024.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-fig9b" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig9b" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig9b" aria-busy="true"></div>
            <div id="presidents-fig9b" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>

        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig9b" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de mortalidade de menores de 5 anos</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de mortalidade infantil (menores de 1 ano)</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de mortalidade neonatal (primeiros 28 dias de vida)</em></span></p>
              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Under age 5</strong><br>Mortality rate, under-5 (per 1,000 live births)<br><a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SH.DYN.MORT?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Under age 1</strong><br>Mortality rate, infant (per 1,000 live births)<br><a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.IMRT.IN?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>First 28 days</strong><br>Mortality rate, neonatal (per 1,000 live births)<br><a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SH.DYN.NMRT?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p>Published estimates from the UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation, distributed through the World Bank WDI API.</p><p>Infant mortality covers deaths before age 1; neonatal mortality covers deaths during the first 28 completed days; under-five mortality is the probability of dying before age 5, expressed per 1,000 live births.</p><p>The age bands overlap. Neonatal deaths are included in infant deaths, and infant deaths are included in under-five deaths. The three curves must not be added.</p><p>Only source-published annual estimates are used. Missing or unreleased years are not extrapolated.</p>
              <p>Automatic API checks use the same monthly cycle as the rest of the dashboard, beginning on the 20th in America/Fortaleza. New observations appear when the source releases them.</p>

            </div>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (UN IGME); via <a href="https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SH.DYN.MORT?locations=BR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank WDI</a>.<br>SH.DYN.MORT · SP.DYN.IMRT.IN · SH.DYN.NMRT.</p>

              <p class="macro-series"><strong>DPT, three doses</strong><br>DPT, three doses<br><a href="https://data.unicef.org/topic/child-health/immunization/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">WHO / UNICEF</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Measles, first dose</strong><br>Measles, first dose<br><a href="https://data.unicef.org/topic/child-health/immunization/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">WHO / UNICEF</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p>WHO/UNICEF estimates of national immunisation coverage, directly from the UNICEF SDMX API. The API flags these as estimated values (E), rather than direct Brazilian administrative coverage.</p><p>DPT3 requires three doses. MCV1 is the first measles-containing vaccine dose. Both selected series use the source age dimension M12T23 (12–23 months).</p><p>Data prepared on 29 October 2026. Both curves use the WHO/UNICEF 2025 revision throughout the 1995–2025 history. Each source check retrieves the full history from one revision; older WDI estimates are not spliced into either curve.</p>

              <p class="macro-series"><strong>Physicians</strong><br>Physicians<br><a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerieR.aspx?module=S&amp;serid=2096726991" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Nurses</strong><br>Nurses<br><a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerieR.aspx?module=S&amp;serid=2096726992" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Dentists</strong><br>Dentists per 10,000 residents<br><a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerieR.aspx?module=S&amp;serid=2096726994" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata</a>.<br>Frequency: annual.</p><p>CNES is Brazil’s national health-facility register. These densities concern professionals recorded at health facilities, rather than everyone licensed by professional councils.</p><p>All three series are annual averages of monthly professional densities per 10,000 residents, using IBGE population projections, 2024 edition.</p><p>The physician series uses the CNES individuals-by-CBO-2002 selection and is not restricted to professionals working exclusively in SUS, Brazil’s public health system.</p><p>Registration does not measure full-time equivalent staffing, geographic access or quality of care.</p>

        <p id="subtitle-fig9susfacilities" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Brazil. Annual averages of monthly facility counts through 2025. Categories can overlap.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-fig9susfacilities" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig9susfacilities" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig9susfacilities" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig9susfacilities" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden><div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig9susfacilities" class="macro-presidents-items"></div></div>
        </div></div><aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig9susfacilities" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Número de estabelecimentos de atendimento ambulatorial pelo SUS</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Número de estabelecimentos de internação pelo SUS</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Número de estabelecimentos de urgência pelo SUS</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Número de estabelecimentos de diagnose e terapia pelo SUS</em></span></p><p>Ipeadata publishes annual averages of monthly facility counts for Brazil. Its source is IBGE’s Social Indicators Synthesis through 2021 and DATASUS from 2022.</p><p>The categories cover outpatient care, inpatient care, emergency care, and diagnosis and therapy delivered through SUS, Brazil’s public health system.</p><p>A facility can offer more than one type of care. <div id="panel-fig9susbeds" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig9susbeds">
      <div class="macro-layout"><div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig9susbeds" class="macro-plot-title">LXXV. Total and SUS inpatient beds</h3>
        <p id="subtitle-fig9susbeds" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Brazil. Annual inpatient beds per 10,000 residents through 2025.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-fig9susbeds" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig9susbeds" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig9susbeds" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig9susbeds" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden><div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig9susbeds" class="macro-presidents-items"></div></div>
        </div></div><aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig9susbeds" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Número de leitos para internação por 10.000 habitantes</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Número de leitos para internação pelo SUS por 10.000 habitantes</em></span></p><p>The total includes inpatient beds available to SUS and beds outside SUS. The SUS curve is the public-system subset.</p><p>The national rates use annual averages of monthly bed counts and IBGE population projections from the 2024 revision, as published by Ipeadata.</p><p>These rates describe registered inpatient capacity per resident. Ipeadata publishes complementary beds separately.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig9susbeds" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite"></div></div></details>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: CNES/DATASUS via Ipeadata. <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerieR.aspx?stub=1&amp;serid=2096726984&amp;MINDATA=2010&amp;MAXDATA=2025&amp;TNIVID=0&amp;TPAID=1&amp;module=S" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIS_NMLTINT1000HUF</a>, <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerieR.aspx?stub=1&amp;serid=2096726985&amp;MINDATA=2010&amp;MAXDATA=2025&amp;TNIVID=0&amp;TPAID=1&amp;module=S" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIS_NMLTINTSUS1000HUF</a>.</p></aside></div>

<div id="panel-map-sus-inpatient-beds" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-sus-inpatient-beds">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-sus-inpatient-beds" class="macro-plot-title">LXXVI. SUS inpatient beds by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-sus-inpatient-beds" class="macro-plot-subtitle">SUS inpatient beds per 10,000 residents, September 2026.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-sus-inpatient-beds" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-sus-inpatient-beds" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-sus-inpatient-beds" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its bed rate.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-sus-inpatient-beds" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Quantidade de leitos de internação do SUS</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>População residente estimada</em></span></p>
            <p>SUS inpatient beds registered in CNES for September 2026 per 10,000 municipal residents estimated by IBGE on 1 July 2026 (SIDRA table 6579).</p><p>The numerator sums QT_SUS at the municipality of the health establishment across all 27 federation units (26 states and the Federal District). It follows the TabNet inpatient-bed scope: surgical, clinical, obstetric, paediatric, other specialty and day-hospital beds. Complementary beds, such as ICU beds, are reported in a separate CNES table.</p><p>A zero means no SUS inpatient bed in those categories was registered in CNES for that municipality and competence. Residents may receive care in other municipalities. The rates measure registered local capacity, not occupancy or access.</p><p>September 2026 was the latest competence with all 27 state files available when checked on 6 November 2026. This monthly snapshot differs from the annual averages in the national chart.</p><p>6 fixed national bands for positive values. The highest band is open. State filters retain the national cutoffs. Pale blue-grey marks observed zero.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p><p>The map uses IBGE 2022 boundaries. Boa Esperança do Norte (MT) appears in the 2026 data and has no separate polygon in this boundary set.</p><p><strong>Reference and coverage</strong></p>
            <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: September 2026. 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-sus-inpatient-beds">State<select id="state-map-sus-inpatient-beds" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-sus-inpatient-beds" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br><span data-map-band-caption>6 fixed national bands for positive values.</span></p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#dce4ed;vertical-align:middle"></span> Observed zero</p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://tabnet.datasus.gov.br/cgi/deftohtm.exe?cnes/cnv/leiintbr.def" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">CNES/DATASUS</a> · <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/6579" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE SIDRA 6579</a>. Boundaries: IBGE 2022.<br>CNES LT (September 2026), QT_SUS, TP_LEITO categories 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 · IBGE SIDRA table 6579, variable 9324 (July 2026).</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-sus-inpatient-beds" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

  </section>
  <section id="section-population" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-population">
    <details id="group-population" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-population" class="macro-heading">Population</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
    <div id="panel-map-population-ln" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-population-ln">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-population-ln" class="macro-plot-title">LXXVII. Resident population by municipality (natural logarithm)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-population-ln" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Natural logarithm of resident population; all nationalities, sexes and ages, Census 2022. Hover shows the original person count.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-population-ln" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-population-ln" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-population-ln" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-population-ln" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>População residente</em></span></p>
            <p>The selected nationality category is Total, combining all nationalities. Sex and age are also Total.</p><p>The mapped value is ln(population), using the natural logarithm of the published person count. It is not ln(1 + population).</p><p>The colourbar shows logarithmic values; hover/tap also reports the original count in people. All municipal total counts are positive.</p><p>The 21 equal-width bands span the national minimum and maximum among municipalities with data. State filters retain the national limits. Labels are rounded for display.</p><p data-map-band-help hidden>More detail at low values subdivides the lower range when the first equal-width band contains at least 95% of municipalities with data. Both scales span the full national range.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The last available data remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Data prepared on 4 November 2026.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="scale-map-population-ln" hidden>Colour scale<select id="scale-map-population-ln" data-map-band-scale aria-controls="chart-map-population-ln"><option value="equal">Equal-width bands</option><option value="detail">More detail at low values</option></select></label>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-population-ln">State<select id="state-map-population-ln" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-population-ln" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br><span data-map-band-caption>21 equal-width national bands.</span></p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10157" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 10157</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10157/periodos/2022/variaveis/93?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=302%5B77794%5D%7C2%5B6794%5D%7C58%5B95253%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>.<br>SIDRA 10157, variable 93.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-population-ln" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-fig10pyramid" class="macro-panel macro-pyramid-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig10pyramid">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig10pyramid" class="macro-plot-title">LXXVIII. Population pyramid by sex and age — Brazil, Census 2022</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Men on the left, women on the right; each age-sex group as a share of Brazil’s total population.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas">
          <div id="chart-fig10pyramid" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig10pyramid" aria-busy="true"></div>
        </div></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig10pyramid" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>População residente por grupo de idade — homens</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>População residente por grupo de idade — mulheres</em></span></p>
            <p>The national population is divided into 21 non-overlapping age groups: twenty five-year groups from 0–4 to 95–99, followed by the open group 100 years or older.</p><p>Both sides use the same denominator: Brazil’s population of both sexes and all ages, 203,080,756 residents in Census 2022. The shares are not normalised separately within each sex.</p><p>The two sides add to 100% across all age groups. The totals are 98,532,431 men (48.52%) and 104,548,325 women (51.48%).</p><p>Men appear on the left in black and women on the right in grey. The horizontal scale is symmetric, and labels show positive percentages on both sides.</p><p>Hover or tap identifies sex, age group, the original positive resident count and its percentage of the common national denominator.</p><p>The youngest group is at the bottom and residents aged 100 or older are at the top. No smoothing, interpolation, seasonal adjustment or annual projection is applied.</p><p>The official IBGE API is checked for revisions to the fixed 2022 dataset. The last available data remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p><p><strong>Reference dataset</strong></p>
            <div id="latest-fig10pyramid" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">Census 2022 · Brazil</div>
          </div></details>
          <button id="download-fig10pyramid" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Sex</p>
            <div id="keys-fig10pyramid" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Sex and side of the population pyramid">
              <span class="macro-key"><span class="macro-key-sample" style="height:8px;border:none;background:#111111"></span><span class="macro-key-label">Men — left; share of total population</span></span>
              <span class="macro-key"><span class="macro-key-sample" style="height:8px;border:none;background:#808080"></span><span class="macro-key-label">Women — right; share of total population</span></span>
            </div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/9514" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE–SIDRA 9514</a>, Census 2022; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/9514/periodos/2022/variaveis/93?localidades=N1%5B1%5D&amp;classificacao=2%5B6794%2C4%2C5%5D%7C287%5B100362%2C93070%2C93084%2C93085%2C93086%2C93087%2C93088%2C93089%2C93090%2C93091%2C93092%2C93093%2C93094%2C93095%2C93096%2C93097%2C93098%2C49108%2C49109%2C60040%2C60041%2C6653%5D%7C286%5B113635%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API</a>.<br>IBGE SIDRA 9514, v93.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-fig10pyramid" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

<div id="panel-fig10fertility" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig10fertility">
      <div class="macro-layout"><div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig10fertility" class="macro-plot-title">LXXIX. Total fertility rate in Brazil and its major regions</h3>
        <p id="subtitle-fig10fertility" class="macro-plot-subtitle">IBGE 2024 revision. Historical estimates through 2022, followed by projections to 2040.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-fig10fertility" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig10fertility" aria-describedby="subtitle-fig10fertility" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig10fertility" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden><div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig10fertility" class="macro-presidents-items"></div></div>
        </div></div><aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig10fertility" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de fecundidade total — Brasil</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de fecundidade total — Norte</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de fecundidade total — Nordeste</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de fecundidade total — Sudeste</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de fecundidade total — Sul</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa de fecundidade total — Centro-Oeste</em></span></p><p>The total fertility rate represents the number of children a woman would have over her lifetime if she experienced the age-specific fertility rates of the reference year. The IBGE series combines demographic estimates through 2022 and a projection scenario from 2023 onward.</p><p>The replacement level is an approximate benchmark of 2.1 children per woman. Future points represent projections in the 2024 revision, which predates subsequent population and fertility releases.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig10fertility" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite"></div></div></details>
          <button id="download-fig10fertility" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-fig10fertility" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://ftp.ibge.gov.br/Projecao_da_Populacao/Projecao_da_Populacao_2024/projecoes_2024_tab4_indicadores.xlsx" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE — Population Projections, 2024 revision (implicit indicators workbook)</a> · <a href="https://ftp.ibge.gov.br/Projecao_da_Populacao/Projecao_da_Populacao_2024/Serie_Relatorios_Metotodologicos_v40_Projecoes_da_Populacao_Brasil_e_Unidades_da_Federacao_Revisao_2024_3a_Edicao.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE — Methodology, 2024 revision (table 2)</a>.<br>2024 Population Projections, table 4 (total fertility rate).</p></aside></div>
      <p id="status-fig10fertility" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p></div>

    <div id="panel-map-household-size" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-household-size">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-household-size" class="macro-plot-title">LXXX. Mean residents per private household by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-household-size" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Average number of residents per private household; all household-reference-person ages, sexes and colours or races, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-household-size" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-household-size" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-household-size" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-household-size" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Média de moradores em domicílios particulares</em></span></p>
            <p>The age, sex and colour-or-race filters refer to the household reference person. All are set to Total.</p><p>The variable is the published mean number of people per private household, not a percentage or a municipal population count.</p><p>The national value is the published IBGE result. The unweighted mean of municipal averages is not used as the national figure.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Colours show this indicator’s magnitude. The national municipal median gives one observation to each municipality with data; it is not a population-weighted national average. State filters retain the national colour reference.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The last available data remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Data prepared on 4 November 2026.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-household-size">State<select id="state-map-household-size" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-household-size" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Green: lower values · red: higher values.<br>Centre: national municipal median.</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/9877" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 9877</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/9877/periodos/2022/variaveis/9325?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=11561%5B100679%5D%7C12237%5B104570%5D%7C11562%5B72593%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>.<br>SIDRA 9877, variable 9325.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-household-size" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

    <div id="panel-map-older65" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-older65">

        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-map-older65" class="macro-plot-title">LXXXI. Population aged 65+ by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-older65" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Residents aged 65+ as a share of the municipal population; %, Census 2022.</p>

        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-map-older65" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-older65" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-older65" aria-busy="true"></div>

          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-older65" class="macro-about">

    <div id="panel-map-ever-lived-outside" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-ever-lived-outside">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-ever-lived-outside" class="macro-plot-title">LXXXIV. Residents who have ever lived outside the municipality (%)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-ever-lived-outside" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Residents who have ever lived elsewhere / all municipal residents × 100; all ages and residence durations, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-ever-lived-outside" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-ever-lived-outside" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-ever-lived-outside" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-ever-lived-outside" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Pessoas que já residiram fora do município</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>População residente</em></span></p>
            <p>Derived as 100 × people who have ever lived outside the municipality (SIDRA 3182, variable 1458, all durations) / resident population (SIDRA 10157, variable 93).</p><p>All sexes and ages are selected. This includes return migrants and moves from other municipalities or countries.</p><p>No minimum time spent outside is imposed. Duration in table 3182 refers to uninterrupted residence in the current municipality.</p><p>The source percentage describes the distribution of residents who have lived elsewhere and equals 100% for Total. This population-share indicator uses published person counts instead.</p><p>Both counts come from the same Census migration publication. They are rounded sample estimates; resulting proportions inherit this rounding.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Colours show this indicator’s magnitude. The national municipal median gives one observation to each municipality with data; it is not a population-weighted national average. State filters retain the national colour reference.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The last available data remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Data prepared on 4 November 2026.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-ever-lived-outside">State<select id="state-map-ever-lived-outside" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>

    <div id="panel-map-five-year-migration" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-five-year-migration">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-five-year-migration" class="macro-plot-title">LXXXV. Residents aged 5+ who lived elsewhere five years earlier (%)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-five-year-migration" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Residents aged 5+ living elsewhere in 2017 / all municipal residents aged 5+ × 100; fixed-date migration, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-five-year-migration" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-five-year-migration" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-five-year-migration" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-five-year-migration" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Pessoas de 5 anos ou mais de idade que não residiam no município 5 anos antes da data de referência</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>População residente total e de 0 a 4 anos de idade</em></span></p>
            <p>Derived as 100 × people aged 5+ who did not live in the current municipality five years before the Census reference (SIDRA 10160, variable 13435) / municipal residents aged 5+.</p><p>The denominator is Total minus ages 0–4 in SIDRA 10157, variable 93, using the same Census sample publication.</p><p>The comparison is residence in 2017 and 2022, including previous residence in another municipality or abroad. It does not count every move made during the interval.</p><p>The original percentage variable describes the age/sex distribution of these migrants and equals 100% for Total. This map uses the derived population share.</p><p>Published person estimates are rounded; small national-versus-municipal sum differences are retained.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>The 12 equal-width bands span the national minimum and maximum among municipalities with data. State filters retain the national limits. Labels are rounded for display.</p><p data-map-band-help hidden>More detail at low values subdivides the lower range when the first equal-width band contains at least 95% of municipalities with data. Both scales span the full national range.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The last available data remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Data prepared on 4 November 2026.</div>
          </div></details>

          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-five-year-migration">State<select id="state-map-five-year-migration" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-five-year-migration" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br><span data-map-band-caption>12 equal-width national bands.</span></p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10160" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 10160</a>, <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10157" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 10157</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10160/periodos/2022/variaveis/13435?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=2%5B6794%5D%7C58%5B95253%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>, <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10157/periodos/2022/variaveis/93?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=302%5B77794%5D%7C2%5B6794%5D%7C58%5B95253%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 2</a>, <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10157/periodos/2022/variaveis/93?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=302%5B77794%5D%7C2%5B6794%5D%7C58%5B1140%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 3</a>.<br>SIDRA 10160, variable 13435 · SIDRA 10157, variable 93, age categories 95253 and 1140.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-five-year-migration" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>

    <div id="panel-map-foreign-population-percent" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-foreign-population-percent">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-foreign-population-percent" class="macro-plot-title">LXXXVI. Foreign-national share of residents by municipality (%)</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-foreign-population-percent" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Foreign nationals as a share of all municipal residents; all sexes and ages, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-foreign-population-percent" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-foreign-population-percent" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-foreign-population-percent" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-foreign-population-percent" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>População residente de nacionalidade estrangeira — percentual do total geral</em></span></p>
            <p>The nationality category is Estrangeira (foreign), SIDRA category 6833. Sex and age are both Total.</p><p>The denominator is the full resident population of each municipality, across all nationalities.</p><p>Nationality differs from place of birth. Brazilian-born or foreign-born Brazilian nationals, including naturalised Brazilians, are not counted as foreign nationals.</p><p>The published percentage is retained at five-decimal API precision. Hover values show five decimals; fixed class limits use two decimals.</p><p>Observed zero percentages appear in pale blue-grey. They remain included in municipal coverage and the original data, but are excluded from the calculation of the positive colour classes. Missing values are never filled with zero.</p><p>Positive values use nine fixed intervals: up to 0.1%; above 0.1% to 0.25%; above 0.25% to 0.5%; above 0.5% to 0.75%; above 0.75% to 1%; above 1% to 5%; above 5% to 10%; above 10% to 20%; and above 20%.</p><p>These fixed classes have unequal counts and are not deciles. All original percentages, including the smallest positive value and the maximum, retain their native five-decimal API precision in hover/tap. No value is capped or replaced.</p><p>Each upper limit is included in the lower class. The first colour class contains only values strictly greater than zero. The last class is open above 20%, and empty fixed intervals are retained. Filtering a state preserves these same limits.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Colours use nine fixed positive-share intervals, including separate bands above 10% to 20% and above 20%. Upper limits belong to the lower class. Observed zeros appear in pale blue-grey and count toward coverage. Original percentages retain five-decimal precision in hover/tap; state filtering preserves the same limits.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The last available data remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Data prepared on 4 November 2026.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-foreign-population-percent">State<select id="state-map-foreign-population-percent" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-foreign-population-percent" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>

          <p id="subtitle-map-catholic-25-plus" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Roman Catholics as a share of residents aged 25 or older; all sexes and educational-attainment levels, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-catholic-25-plus" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-catholic-25-plus" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-catholic-25-plus" aria-busy="true"></div></div>

          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-catholic-25-plus" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em data-map-religion-variable>Pessoas de 25 anos ou mais de idade — percentual do total geral (Católica Apostólica Romana)</em></span></p>
            <p>The denominator is the population aged 25 or older in each municipality, across all religions; it is not the all-age municipal population.</p><p>Estimates come from the preliminary Census 2022 sample. Sex and educational attainment are both set to Total. The IBGE category Umbanda and Candomblé also includes other Afro-Brazilian religions.</p><p>Hover or tap for the percentage published by IBGE, with up to five decimal places.</p><p>This age universe differs from other general Census religion releases that cover residents aged 10 or older.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            <p>Each category has 15 equal-width national bands spanning its observed minimum and maximum. Colours show ranges for the selected category. State filters retain its national limits. Legend labels are rounded for display.</p><p data-map-band-help hidden>More detail at low values subdivides the lower range when the first equal-width band contains at least 95% of municipalities with data. Both scales span the full national range.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p>
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The last available data remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Data prepared on 4 November 2026.</div>
          </div></details>
