  <section id="section-violence-safety" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-violence-safety">
    <details id="group-violence-safety" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-violence-safety" class="macro-heading">Violence and external causes of death</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
    <div id="panel-figvsfemicide" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-figvsfemicide">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-figvsfemicide" class="macro-plot-title">LXXXVIII. Police-recorded victims of crimes classified as femicide</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-figvsfemicide" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Brazil, 2019–2025; annual victims in police records, using the source’s crime classification.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-figvsfemicide" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-figvsfemicide" aria-describedby="subtitle-figvsfemicide" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-figvsfemicide" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden><div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-figvsfemicide" class="macro-presidents-items"></div></div>
        </div></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-figvsfemicide" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Número de vítimas em ocorrências policiais classificadas como feminicídio</em></span></p><p>Annual sum of total_vitima for the exact source event Feminicídio; attempted femicide is excluded. Victims are counted, not police reports.</p><p>The source retains its police crime classification, including records with male victims. In 2025 there are 1,566 female, 8 male and 4 unspecified victims, totalling 1,578.</p><p>This series is distinct from female homicide deaths recorded by SIM. The sources use different classification processes and must not be added or treated as interchangeable.</p><p>The series begins in 2019 to avoid known earlier reporting gaps for Ceará and Tocantins. Each retained year includes records from all 26 states and the Federal District for all 12 calendar months; 2026 is excluded because it is incomplete.</p><p>The reporting location is the state supplied by the public-security authorities, not necessarily the victim’s municipality or state of residence.</p><p>Numbers remain subject to revisions and differences in classification and reporting practices. A change in recorded victims alone does not identify a causal effect of a policy.</p><p>Data prepared on 5 November 2026.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-figvsfemicide" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">2025</div>
          </div></details>
          <button id="download-figvsfemicide" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <div class="macro-indicators"><p class="macro-key-title">Indicators</p><div id="keys-figvsfemicide" class="macro-keys" aria-label="Indicator line styles"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/sua-seguranca/seguranca-publica/estatistica/dados-nacionais-1/base-de-dados-e-notas-metodologicas-dos-gestores-estaduais-sinesp-vde-2022-e-2023" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MJSP / Sinesp VDE</a>.<br>Sinesp VDE total_vitima, Feminicídio.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-figvsfemicide" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

<div id="panel-figvshomicide" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-figvshomicide">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-figvshomicide" class="macro-plot-title">LXXXIX. Homicide mortality by sex</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-figvshomicide" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Brazil, 2000–2025; crude deaths per 100,000 people in each group.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-figvshomicide" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-figvshomicide" aria-describedby="subtitle-figvshomicide" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-figvshomicide" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden><div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-figvshomicide" class="macro-presidents-items"></div></div>
        </div></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-figvshomicide" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa bruta de mortalidade por homicídios — homens</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa bruta de mortalidade por homicídios — mulheres</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Taxa bruta de mortalidade por homicídios — total</em></span></p><p>Assaults, legal intervention and war operations (ICD-10 X85–Y09 and Y35–Y36).</p><p>The three curves are calculated consistently from the official SIM annual files for 2000–2025. They do not splice the earlier Atlas API rates into newer SIM counts.</p><p>Numerators are nonfetal deaths in the reference year, classified by the underlying cause and sex. Residence codes must have a valid Brazilian state prefix; municipality-unknown records within a known state remain in the national totals.</p><p>Each denominator is the corresponding year and sex from the same IBGE population projection revision (2024), reference date 1 July. These are annual estimates/projections, not Census 2022 counts carried to other years.</p><p>Men and women use their respective populations. Total uses the full resident population and includes deaths of unspecified sex. It is not an unweighted mean of the sex-specific rates.</p><p>Rates are crude and are not age-standardised. No correction for underregistration or deaths of undetermined intent is applied.</p><p>The 2025 SIM release is preliminary and uses the official DO25OPEN file, with observations in all 12 calendar months. Dotted final segments identify 2025; the values remain subject to source revisions.</p><p>Data prepared on 5 November 2026.</p><p>2025 source release: <a href="https://s3.sa-east-1.amazonaws.com/ckan.saude.gov.br/SIM/csv/DO25OPEN_csv.zip" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official SIM DO25OPEN file</a>. Preliminary annual data, with records from January through December 2025.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-figvshomicide" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">2025 — preliminary</div>

<div id="panel-map-vs-aggressions-men" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-vs-aggressions-men">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-vs-aggressions-men" class="macro-plot-title">XCI. Male deaths from assault by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-vs-aggressions-men" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Male deaths from assault per 100,000 male residents; municipality of residence, 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-vs-aggressions-men" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-vs-aggressions-men" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-vs-aggressions-men" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value, death count and population denominator.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-vs-aggressions-men" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Óbitos de homens por agressões</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>População residente masculina</em></span></p>
            <p>Men only: SIM sex code 1. Underlying cause X85–Y09 (assault); legal intervention Y35 is not included in this map.</p><p>12 fixed national bands shared by the four mortality maps. Observed zero has its own band. The scale spans the lowest and highest rates observed across the four maps. State filters retain these limits. Labels are rounded for display.</p><p>Each sex uses its own Census 2022 population denominator.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p><p>Calculated as recorded male assault deaths ÷ male municipal residents × 100,000.</p><p>Fixed annual reference: 2022. The numerator is recorded non-fetal deaths in the official SIM 2022 open-data file, selected by the underlying cause of death (CAUSABAS) and municipality of residence (CODMUNRES).</p><p>The population denominator comes from IBGE Census 2022, SIDRA table 9514, variable 93, all ages and total age declaration. Numerator and denominator both refer to 2022.</p><p>The displayed measure is a derived crude annual rate, not an age-standardised rate. It is not a percentage. Annual death rates may fluctuate sharply in municipalities with small populations and few deaths.</p><p>Zero means no selected deaths recorded for that municipality in this source file. Observed zeros count toward coverage, fall in the first band, and retain their zero rate, death count and population in hover/tap. This does not prove the absence of violence or perfect ascertainment. Missing observations are never filled with zero.</p><p>Deaths without a compatible known municipality of residence cannot be assigned to a municipal rate and are not distributed across municipalities. Municipal sums can therefore differ from national source totals.</p><p>Data prepared on 5 November 2026. Sources: official SIM release and IBGE Census 2022 population. The reference year remains 2022.</p><p><strong>Reference and coverage</strong></p>
            <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: annual 2022.</div>
          </div></details>

Annual death rates may fluctuate sharply in municipalities with small populations and few deaths.</p><p>Zero means no selected deaths recorded for that municipality in this source file. Observed zeros count toward coverage, fall in the first band, and retain their zero rate, death count and population in hover/tap. This does not prove the absence of violence or perfect ascertainment. Missing observations are never filled with zero.</p><p>Deaths without a compatible known municipality of residence cannot be assigned to a municipal rate and are not distributed across municipalities. Municipal sums can therefore differ from national source totals.</p><p>Data prepared on 5 November 2026. Sources: official SIM release and IBGE Census 2022 population. The reference year remains 2022.</p><p><strong>Reference and coverage</strong></p>
            <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: annual 2022.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-vs-aggressions-women">State<select id="state-map-vs-aggressions-women" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-vs-aggressions-women" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br><span data-map-band-caption>12 fixed national bands shared by the four mortality maps.</span></p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://dadosabertos.saude.gov.br/dataset/sim" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ministry of Health / SIM</a>, <a href="https://s3.sa-east-1.amazonaws.com/ckan.saude.gov.br/SIM/csv/Mortalidade_Geral_2022_csv.zip" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official 2022 file</a>; population: <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/9514/periodos/2022/variaveis/93?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=2%5B6794,4,5%5D%7C287%5B100362%5D%7C286%5B113635%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / SIDRA 9514 API</a>.<br>SIM, CAUSABAS ICD-10 X85–Y09, SEXO 2, CODMUNRES · SIDRA 9514, variable 93, sex category 5.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-vs-aggressions-women" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>

<div id="panel-map-vs-suicides" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-vs-suicides">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-vs-suicides" class="macro-plot-title">XCIII. Deaths from intentional self-harm by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-vs-suicides" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Deaths from intentional self-harm per 100,000 residents; all sexes, municipality of residence, 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-vs-suicides" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-vs-suicides" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-vs-suicides" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value, death count and population denominator.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-vs-suicides" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Óbitos por lesões autoprovocadas intencionalmente</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>População residente</em></span></p>
            <p>All sexes, including unspecified sex: underlying cause X60–X84 (intentional self-harm). Sequela code Y87.0 is not added.</p><p>Calculated as recorded intentional self-harm deaths ÷ total municipal residents × 100,000.</p><p>Fixed annual reference: 2022. The numerator is recorded non-fetal deaths in the official SIM 2022 open-data file, selected by the underlying cause of death (CAUSABAS) and municipality of residence (CODMUNRES).</p><p>The population denominator comes from IBGE Census 2022, SIDRA table 9514, variable 93, all ages and total age declaration. Numerator and denominator both refer to 2022.</p><p>The displayed measure is a derived crude annual rate, not an age-standardised rate. It is not a percentage. Annual death rates may fluctuate sharply in municipalities with small populations and few deaths.</p><p>Zero means no selected deaths recorded for that municipality in this source file. Observed zeros count toward coverage, fall in the first band, and retain their zero rate, death count and population in hover/tap. This does not prove the absence of violence or perfect ascertainment. Missing observations are never filled with zero.</p><p>Deaths without a compatible known municipality of residence cannot be assigned to a municipal rate and are not distributed across municipalities. Municipal sums can therefore differ from national source totals.</p><p>12 fixed national bands shared by the four mortality maps. Observed zero has its own band. The scale spans the lowest and highest rates observed across the four maps. State filters retain these limits. Labels are rounded for display.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p><p>Data prepared on 5 November 2026. Sources: official SIM release and IBGE Census 2022 population. The reference year remains 2022.</p><p><strong>Reference and coverage</strong></p>
            <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: annual 2022.</div>
          </div></details>

          <button id="download-map-vs-suicides" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>

          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://dadosabertos.saude.gov.br/dataset/sim" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ministry of Health / SIM</a>, <a href="https://s3.sa-east-1.amazonaws.com/ckan.saude.gov.br/SIM/csv/Mortalidade_Geral_2022_csv.zip" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official 2022 file</a>; population: <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/9514/periodos/2022/variaveis/93?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=2%5B6794,4,5%5D%7C287%5B100362%5D%7C286%5B113635%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / SIDRA 9514 API</a>.<br>SIM, CAUSABAS ICD-10 X60–X84, CODMUNRES · SIDRA 9514, variable 93.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-vs-suicides" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

<div id="panel-map-vs-land-transport" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-vs-land-transport">

            <p>All sexes, including unspecified sex: underlying cause V01–V89, land transport accidents. The group includes traffic and nontraffic events and must not be relabelled as only road-traffic deaths.</p><p>Water, air and other transport codes V90–V99 are excluded. Calculated as recorded land transport accident deaths ÷ total municipal residents × 100,000.</p><p>Fixed annual reference: 2022. The numerator is recorded non-fetal deaths in the official SIM 2022 open-data file, selected by the underlying cause of death (CAUSABAS) and municipality of residence (CODMUNRES).</p><p>The population denominator comes from IBGE Census 2022, SIDRA table 9514, variable 93, all ages and total age declaration. Numerator and denominator both refer to 2022.</p><p>The displayed measure is a derived crude annual rate, not an age-standardised rate. It is not a percentage. Annual death rates may fluctuate sharply in municipalities with small populations and few deaths.</p><p>Zero means no selected deaths recorded for that municipality in this source file. Observed zeros count toward coverage, fall in the first band, and retain their zero rate, death count and population in hover/tap. This does not prove the absence of violence or perfect ascertainment. Missing observations are never filled with zero.</p><p>Deaths without a compatible known municipality of residence cannot be assigned to a municipal rate and are not distributed across municipalities. Municipal sums can therefore differ from national source totals.</p><p>12 fixed national bands shared by the four mortality maps. Observed zero has its own band. The scale spans the lowest and highest rates observed across the four maps. State filters retain these limits. Labels are rounded for display.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p><p>Data prepared on 5 November 2026. Sources: official SIM release and IBGE Census 2022 population. The reference year remains 2022.</p><p><strong>Reference and coverage</strong></p>

          </div></details>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://dadosabertos.saude.gov.br/dataset/sim" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ministry of Health / SIM</a>, <a href="https://s3.sa-east-1.amazonaws.com/ckan.saude.gov.br/SIM/csv/Mortalidade_Geral_2022_csv.zip" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official 2022 file</a>; population: <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/9514/periodos/2022/variaveis/93?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=2%5B6794,4,5%5D%7C287%5B100362%5D%7C286%5B113635%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / SIDRA 9514 API</a>.<br>SIM, CAUSABAS ICD-10 V01–V89, CODMUNRES · SIDRA 9514, variable 93.</p>

  <section id="section-climate-economy" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-climate-economy">
    <details id="group-climate-economy" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-climate-economy" class="macro-heading">Climate and the Economy</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
    <div id="panel-climate-temperature-anomalies" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-climate-temperature-anomalies"
         data-section-panel="climate-temperature-anomalies" data-section-asset="/assets/brazilian-economy/sections-2026-11-11/climate-temperature-anomalies.json">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-climate-temperature-anomalies" class="macro-plot-title">XCV. Temperature anomalies</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-climate-temperature-anomalies" class="macro-plot-subtitle" data-section-subtitle>Brazil, 1981–2025. Annual mean surface air temperature relative to 1991–2020.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          
          <div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-climate-temperature-anomalies" class="macro-chart" data-section-chart
            aria-labelledby="title-climate-temperature-anomalies" aria-describedby="subtitle-climate-temperature-anomalies" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Figure information and download">
          <details id="info-climate-temperature-anomalies" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info"><p>Anomalies use the mean of the 30 annual ERA5 values for 1991–2020. The World Bank portal aggregates the 0.25° ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis to Brazil. INMET provides an independent station-based reference.</p><p>Data snapshot prepared on 11 November 2026.</p></div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-climate-temperature-anomalies" data-section-download type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          
          
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://climateknowledgeportal.worldbank.org/download-data" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal — ECMWF ERA5</a> · <a href="https://portal.inmet.gov.br/noticias/ano-de-2025-foi-o-s%C3%A9timo-mais-quente-no-brasil-desde-1961" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">INMET — station-based annual temperature series</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-climate-temperature-anomalies" class="macro-status" data-section-status role="status" hidden></p>
    </div>
    <div id="panel-climate-rainfall-anomalies" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-climate-rainfall-anomalies"
         data-section-panel="climate-rainfall-anomalies" data-section-asset="/assets/brazilian-economy/sections-2026-11-11/climate-rainfall-anomalies.json">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-climate-rainfall-anomalies" class="macro-plot-title">XCVI. Monthly rainfall anomalies</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-climate-rainfall-anomalies" class="macro-plot-subtitle" data-section-subtitle>Brazil, 1981–2025. Precipitation relative to the 1991–2020 normal for each calendar month.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          
          <div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-climate-rainfall-anomalies" class="macro-chart" data-section-chart
            aria-labelledby="title-climate-rainfall-anomalies" aria-describedby="subtitle-climate-rainfall-anomalies" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Figure information and download">
          <details id="info-climate-rainfall-anomalies" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info"><p>For each month, the national ERA5 monthly precipitation total is divided by the 1991–2020 mean for the same calendar month. Zero indicates normal rainfall. National aggregation can conceal local rainfall deficits.</p><p>Data snapshot prepared on 11 November 2026.</p></div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-climate-rainfall-anomalies" data-section-download type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          
          
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://climateknowledgeportal.worldbank.org/download-data" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal — ECMWF ERA5</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-climate-rainfall-anomalies" class="macro-status" data-section-status role="status" hidden></p>
    </div>
    <div id="panel-climate-deforestation" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-climate-deforestation"
         data-section-panel="climate-deforestation" data-section-asset="/assets/brazilian-economy/sections-2026-11-11/climate-deforestation.json">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-climate-deforestation" class="macro-plot-title">XCVII. Deforestation in the Legal Amazon and Cerrado</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-climate-deforestation" class="macro-plot-subtitle" data-section-subtitle>Annual area cleared according to INPE PRODES. Each reference year ends in July.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-section-controls"><label class="macro-map-control" for="view-climate-deforestation" hidden>Indicator<select id="view-climate-deforestation" data-section-view></select></label></div>
          <div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-climate-deforestation" class="macro-chart" data-section-chart
            aria-labelledby="title-climate-deforestation" aria-describedby="subtitle-climate-deforestation" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Figure information and download">
          <details id="info-climate-deforestation" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info"><p>Annual Cerrado mapped values are shown from 2013. Earlier TerraBrasilis records include multi-year periods. For 2026, INPE reported 3,335 km² as the preliminary Legal Amazon estimate and 5,516.69 km² as the consolidated Cerrado result. The geographic boundaries overlap.</p><p>Data snapshot prepared on 11 November 2026.</p></div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-climate-deforestation" data-section-download type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          
          
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://terrabrasilis.dpi.inpe.br/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">INPE — TerraBrasilis</a> · <a href="https://www.gov.br/inpe/pt-br/assuntos/ultimas-noticias/brasil-alcanca-menores-taxas-de-desmatamento-da-serie-historica-na-amazonia-e-no-cerrado" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">INPE — PRODES 2026 release</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-climate-deforestation" class="macro-status" data-section-status role="status" hidden></p>
    </div>
    <div id="panel-climate-native-vegetation" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-climate-native-vegetation"
         data-section-panel="climate-native-vegetation" data-section-asset="/assets/brazilian-economy/sections-2026-11-11/climate-native-vegetation.json">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-climate-native-vegetation" class="macro-plot-title">XCVIII. Native vegetation by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-climate-native-vegetation" class="macro-plot-subtitle" data-section-subtitle>Forest, herbaceous and shrubby vegetation as a share of classified municipal area.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-section-controls"><label class="macro-map-control" for="view-climate-native-vegetation" hidden>Indicator<select id="view-climate-native-vegetation" data-section-view></select></label><label class="macro-map-control" for="state-climate-native-vegetation" hidden>State<select id="state-climate-native-vegetation" data-section-state><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label></div>
          <div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-climate-native-vegetation" class="macro-map-chart" data-section-chart
            aria-labelledby="title-climate-native-vegetation" aria-describedby="subtitle-climate-native-vegetation" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-section-coverage></p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-section-detail aria-live="polite"></p>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Figure information and download">
          <details id="info-climate-native-vegetation" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info"><p>We sum MapBiomas Collection 11 forest and herbaceous and shrubby classes across the biome portions within each municipality and divide by its total classified area. Unobserved pixels are excluded. The mapped percentage includes native regrowth. MapBiomas codes match 5,569 of the 5,570 areas on the 2022 IBGE map.</p><p>Data snapshot prepared on 11 November 2026.</p></div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-climate-native-vegetation" data-section-download type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Lighter to darker values. The scale covers all reported areas for the selected indicator.</p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://brasil.mapbiomas.org/estatisticas/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">MapBiomas Brazil — Collection 11, municipalities by biome</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-climate-native-vegetation" class="macro-status" data-section-status role="status" hidden></p>
    </div>
    <div id="panel-fig10energy" class="macro-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-fig10energy">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-fig10energy" class="macro-plot-title">XCIX. Electricity consumption by sector (GWh)</h3>
          <p class="macro-plot-subtitle">Monthly electricity consumption in Brazil since 1990: commercial, residential, industrial and other uses; GWh, as published.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas">
          <div id="chart-fig10energy" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig10energy" aria-busy="true"></div>
          <div id="presidents-fig10energy" class="macro-presidents" role="group" aria-label="Presidents" hidden>
            <div class="macro-presidents-title">Presidents</div><div id="president-items-fig10energy" class="macro-presidents-items"></div>
          </div></div></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig10energy" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
              <p>Presidential shading includes acting presidencies. The early periods are Sarney until 15 March 1990; Collor from 15 March 1990 to 2 October 1992; and Itamar Franco from 2 October 1992 to 1 January 1995, including his interim presidency before 29 December 1992.</p>
              <p>Presidential periods: <a href="https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/biblioteca-da-pr/galeria-dos-ex-presidentes/jose_sarney/copy_of_capa-dados-ex-presidente/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Presidency Library</a>; <a href="https://www.gov.br/planalto302/pt-br/vice-presidencia/acesso-a-informacao/institucional/biografia-dos-vice-presidentes-da-republica/biografias-vice-presidentes-versao-final.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official vice-presidential biographies</a>.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Commercial</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de energia elétrica - Comercial</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1402" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1402</strong></a>. Monthly; GWh.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Residential</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de energia elétrica - Brasil - Residencial</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1403" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1403</strong></a>. Monthly; GWh.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Industrial</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de energia elétrica - Brasil - Industrial</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1404" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1404</strong></a>. Monthly; GWh.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Other uses</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de energia elétrica - Brasil - Outros</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1405" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1405</strong></a>. Monthly; GWh.</p><p>The four official monthly series show electricity consumption in Brazil by consumer class: commercial (1402), residential (1403), industrial (1404), and other uses (1405).</p><p>Each observation is the published consumption for its reference month, in gigawatt-hours (GWh). One GWh equals one million kWh.</p><p>The series are displayed in their original units, without seasonal adjustment, smoothing, rolling accumulation, interpolation, or rebasing. Seasonal and longer-term movements both remain visible.</p><p>Other uses is the source’s remaining published consumer-class category; it is shown separately rather than inferred as a residual from these three other curves.</p><p>The displayed period starts in January 1990. The API also supplies earlier observations, beginning in February 1979; original reference months are retained.</p><p>The vertical scale fits the four observed curves, with a zero lower bound and small upper padding. Legend placement preserves the data range.</p>
            <p>New observations and revisions are checked through the official SGS API on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The last available history remains displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig10energy" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
          </div></details>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: BCB–SGS; official monthly APIs <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1402/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1402</a>, <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1403/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1403</a>, <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1404/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1404</a>, <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1405/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1405</a>. GWh.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-fig10energy" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>

        <p id="subtitle-fig10electricitymix" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Brazil, annual shares of domestic electricity generation, 2000–2025.</p></div>

        </div></div><aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig10electricitymix" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Energia hidráulica — Produção</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Geração total de energia eólica e de energia solar fotovoltaica</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Eletricidade — Produção das demais fontes (resíduo calculado)</em></span></p><p>Annual generation in GWh from EPE’s Brazilian Energy Balance (BEN 2026), tables 2.6, 2.7, 2.8 and 2.30. Imports are separate from domestic production.</p><p>Wind and solar combines wind and photovoltaic output, including distributed generation in BEN accounting. Other sources are the residual after subtracting hydropower, wind and photovoltaics.</p><p>Each share divides generation by total domestic electricity production. The three categories sum to 100%.</p>

        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas">
          <div id="chart-fig10fuels" class="macro-chart" aria-labelledby="title-fig10fuels" aria-busy="true"></div>

        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Chart information and download">
          <details id="info-fig10fuels" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info">
              <p>Presidential shading includes acting presidencies. The early periods are Sarney until 15 March 1990; Collor from 15 March 1990 to 2 October 1992; and Itamar Franco from 2 October 1992 to 1 January 1995, including his interim presidency before 29 December 1992.</p>
              <p>Presidential periods: <a href="https://www.gov.br/secretariageral/pt-br/centrais-de-conteudo/biblioteca-da-pr/galeria-dos-ex-presidentes/jose_sarney/copy_of_capa-dados-ex-presidente/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Presidency Library</a>; <a href="https://www.gov.br/planalto302/pt-br/vice-presidencia/acesso-a-informacao/institucional/biografia-dos-vice-presidentes-da-republica/biografias-vice-presidentes-versao-final.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official vice-presidential biographies</a>.</p>
            <p class="macro-series"><strong>Gasoline</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de derivados de petróleo - Gasolina</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1393" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1393</strong></a>. Monthly; thousand barrels/day.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>LPG</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de derivados de petróleo - GLP</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1394" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1394</strong></a>. Monthly; thousand barrels/day.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Diesel oil</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de derivados de petróleo - Óleo diesel</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1396" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1396</strong></a>. Monthly; thousand barrels/day.</p><p class="macro-series"><strong>Fuel ethanol — total</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Consumo de álcool carburante - Total</em></span><br>SGS: <a href="https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/consultarmetadados/consultarMetadadosSeries.do?method=consultarMetadadosSeriesInternet&amp;hdOidSerieSelecionada=1401" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>1401</strong></a>. Monthly; thousand barrels/day.</p><p>The four official consumption series cover gasoline (SGS 1393), liquefied petroleum gas — LPG (1394), diesel oil (1396), and total fuel ethanol (1401). The source reported by SGS is the National Agency of Petroleum, Natural Gas and Biofuels (ANP).</p><p>The observation frequency is monthly, while the published volume unit is thousand barrels per day. For example, 500 on the vertical axis means 500,000 barrels per day for that monthly observation.</p><p>The source’s daily-volume unit is retained directly. Values are not multiplied by days in the month, summed over months, converted into a monthly total, seasonally adjusted, or rebased.</p><p>The four product definitions are retained separately as published. LPG means liquefied petroleum gas; total fuel ethanol retains the SGS total category.</p><p>The displayed period begins in January 1990. Dates and values from this period are retained exactly, without filling missing observations or shifting reference months.</p><p>The vertical scale fits all four curves with a zero lower bound and small upper padding. Legends preserve the data range.</p>
            <p>New observations and revisions are checked through the official SGS API on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The last available history remains displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations</strong></p><div id="latest-fig10fuels" class="macro-latest" aria-live="polite">—</div>
          </div></details>

          <p class="macro-source">Source: BCB–SGS; official monthly APIs <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1393/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1393</a>, <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1394/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1394</a>, <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1396/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1396</a>, <a href="https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.1401/dados?formato=json" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">1401</a>. thousand barrels/day.</p>

    <div id="panel-map-water" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-water">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-map-water" class="macro-plot-title">CII. Public water network supply by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-water" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Public network as the main water supply; % of residents in occupied permanent private households, Census 2022.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">
            <div id="chart-map-water" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-water" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-water" aria-busy="true"></div>
          </div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-water" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Moradores em domicílios particulares permanentes ocupados com rede geral como principal forma de abastecimento de água</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Total de moradores em domicílios particulares permanentes ocupados</em></span></p>
              <p>An observed 0% belongs to the first band and counts toward municipal coverage.</p>
              <p>Residents in occupied permanent private households connected to the public water network and using it as their main supply (category 72144).</p><p>All residents in occupied permanent private households (category 72129).</p><p>Calculated as 100 × numerator / denominator, using unrounded official counts.</p><p>Connection alone is insufficient: the public network must be the main source. Does not measure drinking-water quality, treatment or continuity.</p><p>Fixed reference: Census 2022; the map must not automatically advance to a later census or population estimate.</p><p>Colours indicate the magnitude of this indicator, not a ranking of municipal performance or welfare.</p>
              <p>The 15 equal-width bands span the national minimum and maximum among municipalities with data. State filters retain the national limits. Labels are rounded for display.</p><p data-map-band-help hidden>More detail at low values subdivides the lower range when the first equal-width band contains at least 95% of municipalities with data. Both scales span the full national range.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p>
              
              <p>The maps use the same 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from IBGE’s 2022 reference. Source territories outside this boundary reference are counted separately; missing values appear in very light grey.</p>
              <p>Automatic source checks follow the dashboard’s monthly cycle beginning on the 20th, in America/Fortaleza, when the page is visited or remains open and visible. Revisions to the 2022 observations appear after a successful source check; the Census reference remains fixed at 2022.</p>
              <p>The last available data remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p>
              <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Data prepared on 31 October 2026.</div>
            </div>
          </details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="scale-map-water" hidden>Colour scale<select id="scale-map-water" data-map-band-scale aria-controls="chart-map-water"><option value="equal">Equal-width bands</option><option value="detail">More detail at low values</option></select></label>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-water">State
            <select id="state-map-water" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select>
          </label>
          <button id="download-map-water" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br><span data-map-band-caption>15 equal-width national bands.</span></p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/6894" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Census 2022, SIDRA 6894</a>; <a href="https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/6894/n6/all/n1/1/v/382/p/2022/c1821/72129,72144/c58/95253/c86/95251" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>.<br>SIDRA 6894, variable 382, categories 72144 and 72129.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>
      <p id="status-map-water" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

Both scales span the full national range.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p>
              
              <p>The maps use the same 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from IBGE’s 2022 reference. Source territories outside this boundary reference are counted separately; missing values appear in very light grey.</p>

          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/7555" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Census 2022, SIDRA 7555</a>; <a href="https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/7555/n6/all/n1/1/v/382/p/2022/c11558/46292,46290/c58/95253/c86/95251" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>.<br>SIDRA 7555, variable 382, categories 46290 and 46292.</p>

          <h3 id="title-map-waste" class="macro-plot-title">CIV. Waste collection by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-waste" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Direct collection or collection-service container; % of residents in occupied permanent private households, Census 2022.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas">

          </div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-waste" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Moradores em domicílios particulares permanentes ocupados com lixo coletado</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Total de moradores em domicílios particulares permanentes ocupados</em></span></p>
              <p>Residents in occupied permanent private households with directly or indirectly collected waste: collection at the dwelling or deposition in a waste-collection service container (category 2520).</p><p>All residents in occupied permanent private households (category 10972).</p><p>Calculated as 100 × numerator / denominator, using unrounded official counts.</p><p>Includes direct collection at the dwelling and indirect collection through service containers. Does not measure waste treatment or final disposal.</p><p>Fixed reference: Census 2022; the map must not automatically advance to a later census or population estimate.</p><p>Colours indicate the magnitude of this indicator, not a ranking of municipal performance or welfare.</p>
              <p>The 15 equal-width bands span the national minimum and maximum among municipalities with data. State filters retain the national limits. Labels are rounded for display.</p><p data-map-band-help hidden>More detail at low values subdivides the lower range when the first equal-width band contains at least 95% of municipalities with data. Both scales span the full national range.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p>
              
              <p>The maps use the same 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from IBGE’s 2022 reference. Source territories outside this boundary reference are counted separately; missing values appear in very light grey.</p>
              <p>Automatic source checks follow the dashboard’s monthly cycle beginning on the 20th, in America/Fortaleza, when the page is visited or remains open and visible. Revisions to the 2022 observations appear after a successful source check; the Census reference remains fixed at 2022.</p>
              <p>The last available data remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
              <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p>

<div id="panel-map-rented-dwellings" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-rented-dwellings">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header">
          <h3 id="title-map-rented-dwellings" class="macro-plot-title">CV. Rented dwellings by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-rented-dwellings" class="macro-plot-subtitle">2022 Census sample estimates, share of occupied permanent private dwellings.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-figure">
          <div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-rented-dwellings" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-rented-dwellings" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-rented-dwellings" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its share and dwelling counts.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span>
        </div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-rented-dwellings" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Domicílios particulares permanentes ocupados alugados</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Total de domicílios particulares permanentes ocupados</em></span></p>
            <p>The numerator is the number of rented dwellings. The denominator is all occupied permanent private dwellings. Both counts use Total for dwelling type and external wall material.</p><p>The figures are estimates from the 2022 Census sample. Municipal counts may sum to a slightly different total from the published national count due to rounding.</p><p>The 15 equal-width bands span the national minimum and maximum among municipalities with data. State filters retain the national limits. Labels are rounded for display.</p><p data-map-band-help hidden>More detail at low values subdivides the lower range when the first equal-width band contains at least 95% of municipalities with data. Both scales span the full national range.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p><p>All 5,570 municipalities have an estimate. The published national counts give a rental share of 22.2%.</p><p><strong>Reference and coverage</strong></p>
            <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="scale-map-rented-dwellings" hidden>Colour scale<select id="scale-map-rented-dwellings" data-map-band-scale aria-controls="chart-map-rented-dwellings"><option value="equal">Equal-width bands</option><option value="detail">More detail at low values</option></select></label>

Boundaries: IBGE 2022.<br>SIDRA 9928, variable 381, tenure categories 1055 and 95826.</p>

    <div id="panel-map-favela-selected-share" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-favela-selected-share">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-favela-selected-share" class="macro-plot-title">CVI. Favela share of residents in surveyed urban sectors by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-favela-selected-share" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Residents inside favelas / residents inside or outside favelas in the selected urban-survey sectors; 656 municipalities covered, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-favela-selected-share" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-favela-selected-share" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-favela-selected-share" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 656 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-favela-selected-share" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Moradores em domicílios particulares permanentes ocupados nos setores pesquisados em Favelas e Comunidades Urbanas</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Moradores em domicílios particulares permanentes ocupados nos setores pesquisados fora de Favelas e Comunidades Urbanas</em></span></p>
            <p>This is a derived share using the two published absolute-count variables, 13550 and 13551.</p><p>The denominator covers only residents of occupied permanent private households in sectors selected for the Urban Survey of Surroundings of Households. It is not the full population of the municipality.</p><p>The table covers municipalities with Favelas e Comunidades Urbanas. Municipalities outside the table remain without coverage and are not assigned zero.</p><p>Two municipalities within table coverage have the official dash marker for the inside-favela count. The IBGE convention identifies that marker as a numerical zero; their derived selected-sector share is zero.</p><p>Published percentage variable 1013550 has a different denominator: its own inside-favela universe. With Total categories it is 100% whenever that universe is positive, so it does not measure the favela share of municipal population.</p><p>Very light grey marks the 4,914 municipalities outside the table. Two covered municipalities have genuine zero shares and retain the colour for zero.</p><p>12 fixed national bands. The cutoffs are 1%, 2%, 3%, 5%, 7.5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 30%, 40% and 50%. The bands span the observed national minimum and maximum. State filters retain these limits.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p><p>The indicator remains the share of surveyed-sector residents living in Favelas and Urban Communities. It is not the share of the entire municipal population living in these areas.</p><p>Observed zero rates stay in the first colour class. Municipalities outside table coverage appear in very light grey and are excluded from the distribution; missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p><p>All original rates and their full precision are preserved. Filtering a state retains the fixed percentage limits; empty intervals are retained.</p>
            <p>Fixed reference: Census 2022. All selected total categories, formulas and source precision are checked against the official IBGE APIs.</p>
            
            <p>The maps use IBGE’s 5,570 municipal-level territories and simplified boundaries from 2022. Missing coverage is never filled with zero.</p>
            <p>Official APIs are checked on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The last available data remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Data prepared on 4 November 2026.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-favela-selected-share">State<select id="state-map-favela-selected-share" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-favela-selected-share" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br><span data-map-band-caption>12 fixed national bands.</span></p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Outside table coverage</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: IBGE — <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/10206" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">SIDRA 10206</a>; <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10206/periodos/2022/variaveis/13550|13551?localidades=N6[all]&amp;classificacao=86[95251]|14[200]" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 1</a>, <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/10206/periodos/2022/variaveis/13550|13551?localidades=N6[all]&amp;classificacao=86[95251]|14[200]" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official API 2</a>.<br>SIDRA 10206, variables 13550 and 13551.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-favela-selected-share" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>
      </div>
    </details>
  </section>
  <section id="section-other" class="macro-section" aria-labelledby="heading-other">
    <details id="group-other" class="macro-section-group" open>
      <summary class="macro-section-summary"><h2 id="heading-other" class="macro-heading">Other</h2></summary>
      <div class="macro-section-body">
    <div id="panel-map-idhm-2010" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-idhm-2010">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-idhm-2010" class="macro-plot-title">CVII. Municipal Human Development Index (IDHM), 2010</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-idhm-2010" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Income, longevity and education combined into an index from 0 to 1; Census 2010.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-idhm-2010" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-idhm-2010" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-idhm-2010" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,565 / 5,570 reference territories with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its value.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-idhm-2010" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Índice de Desenvolvimento Humano Municipal (IDHM)</em></span></p>
            <p>The Municipal Human Development Index combines income, longevity and education. A higher value indicates higher human development under the Atlas Brasil methodology.</p><p>This is the official Census 2010 indicator, not an estimate for 2022 or 2024. The three dimensions are combined by their geometric mean.</p><p>The Ipeadata API series ADH_IDHM supplies 5,564 municipal observations for 2010. Nazária (PI), omitted from that API response, is supplemented at 0.602 from the official PNUD municipal ranking for the same year.</p><p>The five official categories are Very low (&lt;0.500), Low (0.500–0.599), Medium (0.600–0.699), High (0.700–0.799), and Very high (0.800–1.000). Values exactly at a threshold enter the higher category.</p><p>Five territories in the 2022 reference geometry have no value in this 2010 dataset: Mojuí dos Campos, Pescaria Brava, Balneário Rincão, Pinto Bandeira, and Paraíso das Águas. Very light grey marks those five territories. No parent-municipality value is imputed.</p><p>State filtering retains the same official national classes. The map uses the dashboard’s simplified 2022 boundaries, so it is not a reconstruction of municipal boundaries in 2010.</p>
            <p>The fixed 2010 selection is checked through the official API on the dashboard’s monthly cycle. The last available data remain displayed if the source is temporarily unavailable. The PNUD supplement for Nazária remains explicitly identified.</p>
            <p><strong>Latest observations and API check</strong></p><div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2010. Data prepared on 4 November 2026.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-idhm-2010">State<select id="state-map-idhm-2010" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-idhm-2010" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Official IDHM categories.<br>Red: lower · green: higher.<br>Fixed reference: 2010.</p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> No 2010 observation</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/api/odata4/Metadados(&#x27;ADH_IDHM&#x27;)/Valores" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Ipeadata official API — ADH_IDHM</a>; <a href="https://www.undp.org/pt/brazil/idhm-municipios-2010" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">PNUD — municipal IDHM 2010</a>. Census 2010; boundaries: IBGE 2022.<br>Ipeadata ADH_IDHM.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-idhm-2010" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

<div id="panel-map-digital-exclusion" class="macro-panel macro-map-panel" role="group" aria-labelledby="title-map-digital-exclusion">
      <div class="macro-layout">
        <div class="macro-plot-header"><h3 id="title-map-digital-exclusion" class="macro-plot-title">CVIII. Residents without home internet by municipality</h3>
          <p id="subtitle-map-digital-exclusion" class="macro-plot-subtitle">Residents in occupied permanent private households without a home internet connection; %, Census 2022.</p></div>
        <div class="macro-figure"><div class="macro-canvas"><div id="chart-map-digital-exclusion" class="macro-map-chart" aria-labelledby="title-map-digital-exclusion" aria-describedby="subtitle-map-digital-exclusion" aria-busy="true"></div></div>
          <p class="macro-map-coverage" data-map-coverage>Brazil · 5,570 / 5,570 municipalities with data</p>
          <p class="macro-map-detail" data-map-detail>Hover or tap a municipality to see its share, residents without home internet and total residents in the household universe.</p>
          <span class="macro-map-announcement" aria-live="polite" data-map-announcement></span></div>
        <aside class="macro-sidebar" aria-label="Map information, state and download">
          <details id="info-map-digital-exclusion" class="macro-about"><summary>About the data</summary><div class="macro-info"><p class="macro-series"><strong>Variables</strong><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Moradores em domicílios particulares permanentes ocupados sem conexão domiciliar à Internet</em></span><br><span class="macro-original" lang="pt-BR"><em>Total de moradores em domicílios particulares permanentes ocupados</em></span></p>
            <p>Share of residents in occupied permanent private households without a home internet connection: residents without a connection divided by all residents in that same household universe, multiplied by 100. All ages and all race/colour categories are included.</p><p>The numerator and denominator both come from the Census 2022 sample results, SIDRA table 9942, variable 382; connection categories No and Total, with age and race/colour both set to Total. Collective households and other census universes are excluded.</p><p>This describes a household characteristic. It does not measure individual internet use, service quality, connection speed or the adequacy of access.</p><p>Published person estimates are rounded. The derived shares are checked against the source percentage; the sum of the with/without counts may differ from the total by one person due to rounding.</p><p>The 21 equal-width bands span the national minimum and maximum among municipalities with data. State filters retain the national limits. Labels are rounded for display.</p><p data-map-band-help hidden>More detail at low values subdivides the lower range when the first equal-width band contains at least 95% of municipalities with data. Both scales span the full national range.</p><p>Very light grey marks missing data.</p><p>In this dataset, the municipal median is 13.86%. The separate Brazil share is 10.64%, calculated from the official national numerator and denominator. The national share is weighted by residents in this universe and is not the municipal median.</p><p>All 5,570 municipalities in the 2022 boundaries have a valid observation in the data included in this page; there are no zero or missing shares. A genuinely unavailable source value remains missing and is never converted to zero. Very light grey marks missing data.</p><p>The dashboard checks this fixed 2022 selection through the official IBGE API on its existing monthly cycle. The last available data remain displayed during a temporary source failure; the reference year remains 2022.</p><p><strong>Reference and source check</strong></p>
            <div class="macro-latest" data-map-latest>Reference: 2022. Data prepared on 5 November 2026.</div>
          </div></details>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="scale-map-digital-exclusion" hidden>Colour scale<select id="scale-map-digital-exclusion" data-map-band-scale aria-controls="chart-map-digital-exclusion"><option value="equal">Equal-width bands</option><option value="detail">More detail at low values</option></select></label>
          <label class="macro-map-control" for="state-map-digital-exclusion">State<select id="state-map-digital-exclusion" data-map-state aria-label="State shared by the municipal maps"><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label>
          <button id="download-map-digital-exclusion" type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br><span data-map-band-caption>21 equal-width national bands.</span></p>
          <p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://sidra.ibge.gov.br/tabela/9942" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">IBGE / SIDRA table 9942</a>, <a href="https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/9942/periodos/2022/variaveis/382%7C1000382?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&amp;classificacao=2072%5B77584,77585,77586%5D%7C86%5B95251%5D%7C58%5B95253%5D" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">official Census 2022 API</a>. Boundaries: IBGE 2022.<br>SIDRA 9942, variable 382, categories 77586 and 77584.</p>
        </aside></div><p id="status-map-digital-exclusion" class="macro-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
    </div>

         data-section-panel="fiscal-municipal-debt-ratio" data-section-asset="/assets/brazilian-economy/sections-2026-11-11/fiscal-municipal-debt-ratio.json">

          <div class="macro-section-controls"><label class="macro-map-control" for="state-fiscal-municipal-debt-ratio" hidden>State<select id="state-fiscal-municipal-debt-ratio" data-section-state><option value="BR">Brazil — all states</option></select></label></div>

            aria-labelledby="title-fiscal-municipal-debt-ratio" aria-describedby="subtitle-fiscal-municipal-debt-ratio" aria-busy="true"></div></div>

          <details id="info-fiscal-municipal-debt-ratio" class="macro-about">
            <summary>About the data</summary>
            <div class="macro-info"><p>Debt divided by net current revenue (Dívida Consolidada / Receita Corrente Líquida), using Indicator 1 from the Treasury workbook. Includes municipalities with a fiscal management report and positive net current revenue. Zero is a reported ratio. The source snapshot is dated 1 September 2026.</p><p>Ten bands of 10 percentage points span 0% to 100%. The two upper bands cover over 100% through 200% and over 200%. The thresholds apply nationally and remain fixed when a state is selected.</p><p>Data snapshot prepared on 11 November 2026.</p></div>
          </details>
          <button id="download-fiscal-municipal-debt-ratio" data-section-download type="button" disabled>Download PNG</button>
          
          <p class="macro-map-reference">Light lavender → blue → dark green: lower to higher.<br>Ten bands of 10 percentage points from 0% to 100%, plus two bands above 100%.</p><p class="macro-map-reference"><span aria-hidden="true" style="display:inline-block;width:22px;height:12px;border:1px solid #d5d8dc;background:#f0f1f3;vertical-align:middle"></span> Missing data</p>
          <p class="macro-source">Source: <a href="https://www.tesourotransparente.gov.br/ckan/dataset/capag-municipios" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">National Treasury, CAPAG for municipalities, September 2026 snapshot</a>.</p>
        </aside>
      </div>

<script type="module">
// HEIGHT SETTINGS (logical pixels before the PNG scale factor).
// Per plot: height (desktop), height_mobile and height_export override targets.
// min_plot_height applies to the data area; mobile/export variants can override it.
// Targets are minimum requests: readable legends may add the space they need.
// Municipal rank-class settings. Ten groups are deciles.
// Default illiteracy classes; map-field options can override these settings.
// Positive foreign-national shares: zero has a separate fill.
// Favela share is measured within surveyed sectors; zero is a valid rate.
const MUNICIPAL_SURVEY_CLASS_SETTINGS = Object.freeze({
  upperBounds: Object.freeze([1,5,10,20,30,40,50])
});

const MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_SETTINGS = Object.freeze({
  upperBounds: Object.freeze([0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,1,5,10])
});

const MUNICIPAL_ILLITERACY_CLASS_SETTINGS = Object.freeze({
  bodyMaximum: 5, bodyClasses: 7, tailUpperBounds: Object.freeze([10,20])
});

const MUNICIPAL_COLOUR_CLASS_COUNT = 10;
const MUNICIPAL_CLASS_LEGEND = Object.freeze({
  minColumnWidth: 140, maxColumns: 5, padding: 12,
  header: 18, rowHeight: 17, bottom: 8, swatch: 14, fontSize: 10
});

const CHART_HEIGHTS = Object.freeze({
  desktop: 312, mobile: 340, export: 650,
  compactDesktop: 280, compactMobile: 320,
  minPlot: 230, compactMinPlot: 210,
  insideMax: 450,
  legendGrowth: [16, 32, 48, 64, 96, 144, 208, 320, 480, 800],
  legendSearchMin: 1600, legendSearchExtra: 1000,
  map: { min: 220, desktopMax: 400, mobileMax: 340, export: 520,
    aspect: .95, top: 6, exportTop: 66, footer: 10, exportFooter: 78, footerGap: 24 }
});

function positiveHeight(value) {
  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : null;
}

function chartHeight(plot = {}, {mobile = false, forExport = false} = {}) {
  const key = forExport ? "height_export" : mobile ? "height_mobile" : "height";
  const configured = positiveHeight(plot[key]);
  if (configured !== null) return configured;
  if (!forExport && plot.compact_plot === true) {
    return mobile ? CHART_HEIGHTS.compactMobile : CHART_HEIGHTS.compactDesktop;
  }
  return forExport ? CHART_HEIGHTS.export : mobile ? CHART_HEIGHTS.mobile : CHART_HEIGHTS.desktop;
}

function minimumPlotHeight(plot = {}, {mobile = false, forExport = false} = {}) {
  const key = forExport ? "min_plot_height_export" : mobile ? "min_plot_height_mobile" : "min_plot_height";
  return positiveHeight(plot[key]) ?? positiveHeight(plot.min_plot_height) ??
    (plot.compact_plot === true ? positiveHeight(plot.legend_min_plot_height) ?? CHART_HEIGHTS.compactMinPlot : CHART_HEIGHTS.minPlot);
}

function insideLegendHeightLimit(plot = {}) {
  // true opts into the shared limit; a number remains an explicit plot override.
  return plot.legend_inside_max_height === true ? CHART_HEIGHTS.insideMax : positiveHeight(plot.legend_inside_max_height);
}

function configureChartHeights() {
  const root = document.getElementById("macro-dashboard");
  if (!root) return;
  root.style.setProperty("--macro-chart-height", `${CHART_HEIGHTS.desktop}px`);
  root.style.setProperty("--macro-chart-height-mobile", `${CHART_HEIGHTS.mobile}px`);
  root.style.setProperty("--macro-map-min-height", `${CHART_HEIGHTS.map.min}px`);
  const mobile = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 600px)").matches;
  // Reserve each configured target before lazy loading; legends resolve later.
  for (const plot of PLOTS) {
    const chart = document.getElementById(`chart-${plot.id}`);
    if (chart) chart.style.height = `${chartHeight(plot, {mobile})}px`;
  }
}

Missing months are not filled or carried forward.":"Cada série mantém o histórico disponível e a última observação da fonte. Meses sem observação ficam em branco.","Each sex uses its own Census 2022 population denominator.":"Cada sexo tem como denominador sua respectiva população no Censo 2022.","Each share divides generation by total domestic electricity production. As três categorias somam 100%.","Each upper limit is included in the lower class. The first colour class contains only values strictly greater than zero. Os valores da legenda são arredondados.","The 2019 reference balance is negative: a higher net-exports index represents a lower constructed balance; a negative index represents a positive constructed balance.":"Como o saldo de referência de 2019 é negativo, um índice de exportações líquidas mais alto indica um saldo calculado menor. State filters retain the national limits. Labels are rounded for display.":"As 21 faixas de mesma amplitude vão do mínimo ao máximo nacional entre os municípios com dados.
