// The host owns figure layout, PNG exports, request trust, and monthly scheduling.
const INTEGRATION_INCOME_CACHE_KEY = 'brazil-economy-monthly-income-paired-v1';
let integrationIncomeController;

function integrationQuarterLabel(date) {
  const months=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const year=Number(date.slice(0,4)),end=Number(date.slice(5,7))-1,start=(end+10)%12;
  return end>=2 ? `${months[start]}–${months[end]} ${year}` : `${months[start]} ${year-1}–${months[end]} ${year}`;
}

function integrationMonthNumber(date) {
  if(typeof date!=='string'||!/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-01$/.test(date))throw Error('Invalid monthly reference date.');
  return Number(date.slice(0,4))*12+Number(date.slice(5,7))-1;
}

function validateIntegrationIncomeRows(rows, minimumLast='2026-09-01') {
  if(!Array.isArray(rows)||rows.length<175||rows[0]?.date!=='2012-03-01'||rows.at(-1)?.date<minimumLast)throw Error('Incomplete labour earnings history.');
  const baseAverage=rows[0].average_real_brl,baseMass=rows[0].mass_real_million_brl;
  rows.forEach((row,index)=>{
    if(integrationMonthNumber(row.date)!==integrationMonthNumber('2012-03-01')+index||
        row.period!==row.date.slice(0,7).replace('-','')||row.period_label!==integrationQuarterLabel(row.date)||
        ![row.average_real_brl,row.mass_real_million_brl,row.average_index,row.mass_index].every(v=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>0)||
        Math.abs(row.average_index-100*row.average_real_brl/baseAverage)>1e-10||
        Math.abs(row.mass_index-100*row.mass_real_million_brl/baseMass)>1e-10)throw Error('Invalid labour earnings observation.');
  });
  return rows;
}

function validateIntegrationFiscalRows(rows) {
  if(!Array.isArray(rows)||rows.length!==357||!rows[0].date.startsWith('1997-01-01')||!rows.at(-1).date.startsWith('2026-09-01'))throw Error('Incomplete RTN snapshot.');
  rows.forEach((row,index)=>{
    const date=row.date.slice(0,10);
    if(integrationMonthNumber(date)!==integrationMonthNumber('1997-01-01')+index||
        !['total_revenue_brl_million','revenue_sharing_transfers_brl_million','net_revenue_brl_million',
          'primary_expenditure_brl_million','primary_balance_brl_million','gdp_brl_million'].every(k=>Number.isFinite(row[k]))||row.gdp_brl_million<=0||
        Math.abs(row.total_revenue_brl_million-row.revenue_sharing_transfers_brl_million-row.net_revenue_brl_million)>1e-5||
        Math.abs(row.net_revenue_brl_million-row.primary_expenditure_brl_million-row.primary_balance_brl_million)>1e-5)throw Error('Invalid RTN monthly observation.');
    const keys=['net_revenue','primary_expenditure','primary_balance','gdp'];
    if(index<11){
      if(keys.some(k=>row[`${k}_12m_brl_million`]!==null)||['net_revenue','primary_expenditure','primary_balance'].some(k=>row[`${k}_12m_pct_gdp`]!==null))throw Error('Partial fiscal window.');
      return;
    }
    for(const key of keys){
      const sum=rows.slice(index-11,index+1).reduce((a,r)=>a+r[`${key}_brl_million`],0);
      if(!Number.isFinite(row[`${key}_12m_brl_million`])||Math.abs(sum-row[`${key}_12m_brl_million`])>1e-5)throw Error('Invalid twelve-month fiscal sum.');
    }
    for(const key of keys.slice(0,3)){
      const ratio=100*row[`${key}_12m_brl_million`]/row.gdp_12m_brl_million;
      if(!Number.isFinite(row[`${key}_12m_pct_gdp`])||Math.abs(ratio-row[`${key}_12m_pct_gdp`])>1e-10)throw Error('Invalid twelve-month fiscal share.');
    }
  });
  return rows;
}

function validateIntegrationSeries(plot,bundle=INTEGRATION_SERIES_BUNDLE) {
  if(plot.kind!=='integration-series'||bundle?.version!==1||bundle.snapshot_date!=='2026-11-05'||plot.traces.length!==2)throw Error('Invalid additions snapshot.');
  if(plot.dataRef==='labor_income')return validateIntegrationIncomeRows(bundle.income);
  if(plot.dataRef==='fiscal_primary')return validateIntegrationFiscalRows(bundle.fiscal);
  throw Error('Unknown additions dataset.');
}

function getIntegrationIncomeController() {
  if(!integrationIncomeController)integrationIncomeController=createIntegrationIncomeController();
  return integrationIncomeController;
}

function buildIntegrationSeries(plot,bundle=INTEGRATION_SERIES_BUNDLE) {
  validateIntegrationSeries(plot,bundle);
  if(plot.dataRef==='labor_income'){
    const rows=bundle===INTEGRATION_SERIES_BUNDLE?getIntegrationIncomeController().state().rows:bundle.income;
    validateIntegrationIncomeRows(rows);
    const priceWindow=integrationQuarterLabel(rows.at(-1).date);
    return plot.traces.map(spec=>({spec,priceWindow,
      points:rows.map(row=>[row.date,row[`${spec.metric}_index`]]),
      rawValues:rows.map(row=>[row.date,row[spec.metric==='average'?'average_real_brl':'mass_real_million_brl']]),
      referenceWindows:rows.map(row=>[row.date,row.period_label])}));
  }
  const rows=bundle.fiscal.slice(11);
  return plot.traces.map(spec=>({spec,points:rows.map(row=>[row.date.slice(0,10),row[`${spec.metric}_12m_pct_gdp`]]),
    nominalFlows:rows.map(row=>[row.date.slice(0,10),row[`${spec.metric}_12m_brl_million`]]),
    nominalGDP:rows.map(row=>[row.date.slice(0,10),row.gdp_12m_brl_million])}));
}

const BALANCE_COLORS = ['rgba(8,122,55,0.92)', 'rgba(195,38,50,0.92)'];

function balanceBands(inflows, outflows) {
  const outflowByMonth = new Map(outflows);
  const bands = [];
  let run = [];
  let sign = 0;
  let previous = null;

  function closeRun() {
    if (run.length >= 2) {
      bands.push({ rows: run, color: BALANCE_COLORS[sign > 0 ? 0 : 1] });
    }
    run = [];
    sign = 0;
  }

  function addSegment(left, right, side) {
    if (side !== sign) closeRun();
    if (side === 0) return;
    if (!run.length) run.push(left);
    run.push(right);
    sign = side;
  }

  for (const [date, inflow] of inflows) {
    const outflow = outflowByMonth.get(date);
    if (!Number.isFinite(inflow) || !Number.isFinite(outflow)) {
      closeRun();
      previous = null;
      continue;
    }
    const next = { month: integrationMonthNumber(date), time: Date.parse(date), inflow, outflow };
    if (previous && next.month === previous.month + 1) {
      const left = previous.inflow - previous.outflow;
      const right = next.inflow - next.outflow;
      if (left * right < 0) {
        // The two straight line segments meet at this fraction of the month.
        const fraction = left / (left - right);
        const valueAtCrossing = previous.inflow + fraction * (next.inflow - previous.inflow);
        const crossing = { time: previous.time + fraction * (next.time - previous.time),
          inflow: valueAtCrossing, outflow: valueAtCrossing };
        addSegment(previous, crossing, Math.sign(left));
        addSegment(crossing, next, Math.sign(right));
      } else {
        addSegment(previous, next, Math.sign(left || right));
      }
    } else {
      closeRun();
    }
    previous = next;
  }
  closeRun();
  return bands;
}

function balanceHatches(inflows, outflows, layout, width) {
  const margin = layout.margin;
  const plotWidth = width - margin.l - margin.r;
  const plotHeight = layout.height - margin.t - margin.b;
  const [start, end] = layout.xaxis.range.map(Date.parse);
  const [min, max] = layout.yaxis.range;
  const spacing = 9;
  const x = time => (time - start) / (end - start) * plotWidth;
  const y = value => (max - value) / (max - min) * plotHeight;
  const coordinate = (left, top) => {
    const time = new Date(Math.round(start + left / plotWidth * (end - start)));
    const value = max - top / plotHeight * (max - min);
    return `${time.toISOString().replace('T', '_').slice(0, -1)},${value}`;
  };

  return balanceBands(inflows, outflows).flatMap(({rows, color}) => {
    const outline = [...rows.map(row => [x(row.time), y(row.inflow)]),
      ...[...rows].reverse().map(row => [x(row.time), y(row.outflow)])];
    const levels = outline.map(([left, top]) => left + top);
    const segments = [];
    const firstLevel = Math.min(...levels), lastLevel = Math.max(...levels);
    // Clip each diagonal x + y = level to the ribbon. Pixel coordinates keep
    // the angle and spacing consistent at every chart width and height.
    function addHatch(level) {
      const intersections = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < outline.length; i++) {
        const j = (i + 1) % outline.length;
        const first = levels[i], last = levels[j];
        if (level < Math.min(first, last) || level >= Math.max(first, last)) continue;
        const fraction = (level - first) / (last - first);
        intersections.push(outline[i][0] + fraction * (outline[j][0] - outline[i][0]));
      }
      intersections.sort((a, b) => a - b);
      for (let i = 1; i < intersections.length; i += 2) {
        const left = intersections[i - 1], right = intersections[i];
        if (right - left < 0.01) continue;
        segments.push(`M ${coordinate(left, level - left)} L ${coordinate(right, level - right)}`);
      }
    }
    for (let level = Math.ceil(firstLevel / spacing) * spacing; level < lastLevel; level += spacing) addHatch(level);
    // A brief, narrow gap may fall between two regular stripes.
    if (!segments.length) addHatch((firstLevel + lastLevel) / 2);
    return segments.length ? [{ type: 'path', xref: 'x', yref: 'y', layer: 'below', showlegend: false,
      path: segments.join(' '), line: { color, width: 1.25 }, fillcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)' }] : [];
  });
}

function addBalanceKey(layout, width, inside, inflows, outflows, labels, keyWidth) {
  const margin = layout.margin;
  const plotWidth = width - margin.l - margin.r;
  const plotHeight = layout.height - margin.t - margin.b;
  const inset = 7;
  const keyHeight = 32;
  const right = plotWidth - keyWidth - inset;
  const preferred = inside?.below ? inset : right;
  const [start, end] = layout.xaxis.range.map(Date.parse);
  const [min, max] = layout.yaxis.range;
  const x = date => (Date.parse(date) - start) / (end - start) * plotWidth;
  const y = value => (max - value) / (max - min) * plotHeight;
  const occupied = [inside?.presidents, inside?.indicators].filter(Boolean).map(({position, box}) => {
    const left = position.x * plotWidth;
    const top = (1 - position.y) * plotHeight;
    return [left, top, left + box.width, top + box.height];
  });
  const outflowByMonth = new Map(outflows);
  for (let i = 1; i < inflows.length; i++) {
    const endpoints = [inflows[i - 1][1], inflows[i][1], outflowByMonth.get(inflows[i - 1][0]), outflowByMonth.get(inflows[i][0])];
    const ys = endpoints.filter(Number.isFinite).map(y);
    if (!ys.length) continue;
    occupied.push([x(inflows[i - 1][0]), Math.min(...ys), x(inflows[i][0]), Math.max(...ys)]);
  }
  const fits = ([left, top]) => !occupied.some(([x0, y0, x1, y1]) =>
    left - 3 < x1 && left + keyWidth + 3 > x0 && top - 3 < y1 && top + keyHeight + 3 > y0);
  const candidates = [inset, plotHeight - keyHeight - inset, (plotHeight - keyHeight) / 2]
    .flatMap(top => [preferred, preferred === inset ? right : inset, (inset + right) / 2].map(left => [left, top]));
  const [left, keyTop] = candidates.find(fits) || candidates[0];
  for (const [index, label] of labels.entries()) {
    const top = keyTop + index * 16;
    for (const offset of [0, 3, 6]) layout.shapes.push({
      type: 'line', xref: 'paper', yref: 'paper', layer: 'above', showlegend: false,
      x0: (left + offset) / plotWidth, x1: (left + offset + 5) / plotWidth,
      y0: 1 - (top + 11) / plotHeight, y1: 1 - (top + 6) / plotHeight,
      line: { color: BALANCE_COLORS[index], width: 1.5 },
    });
    layout.annotations.push({
      xref: 'paper', yref: 'paper', x: (left + 14) / plotWidth, y: 1 - top / plotHeight,
      xanchor: 'left', yanchor: 'top', text: label, showarrow: false, borderpad: 0, font: { size: 11 },
    });
  }
}

function decorateCagedBalance(series, layout, {width, inside}) {
  const admissions = series.find(trace => trace.spec.code === 'ipea:CAGED12_ADMISNAJU12')?.points;
  const separations = series.find(trace => trace.spec.code === 'ipea:CAGED12_DESLIGNAJU12')?.points;
  if (!admissions?.length || !separations?.length) return;
  layout.shapes.push(...balanceHatches(admissions, separations, layout, width));
  // Reserve space for the longer Portuguese labels when placing the key.
  const keyWidth = DASHBOARD_PORTUGUESE ? 132 : 94;
  addBalanceKey(layout, width, inside, admissions, separations, ['Net job gains', 'Net job losses'], keyWidth);
}

function decorateIntegrationFigure(plot,series,data,layout,{width=520,inside}={}) {
  series.forEach((trace,index)=>{
    const item=data[index];
    if(plot.dataRef==='labor_income'){
      const values=new Map(trace.rawValues),windows=new Map(trace.referenceWindows);
      item.customdata=item.x.map(date=>[windows.get(date),values.get(date),trace.priceWindow]);
      const raw=trace.spec.metric==='average'?'BRL %{customdata[1]:,.0f} per worker':'BRL %{customdata[1]:,.0f} million, total';
      item.hovertemplate='%{customdata[0]}<br><b>%{y:.2f} (Jan–Mar 2012 = 100)</b><br>'+raw+'<br>Prices: %{customdata[2]}<extra>'+trace.spec.label+'</extra>';
    }else{
      const flows=new Map(trace.nominalFlows),gdp=new Map(trace.nominalGDP);
      item.customdata=item.x.map(date=>[dateLabel(date,'monthly'),flows.get(date),gdp.get(date)]);
      item.hovertemplate='%{customdata[0]}<br><b>%{y:.3f}% of GDP (12 months)</b><br>Flow: BRL %{customdata[1]:,.2f} million<br>GDP: BRL %{customdata[2]:,.2f} million<extra>'+trace.spec.label+'</extra>';
    }
  });
  if (plot.dataRef === 'fiscal_primary') {
    const revenue = series.find(trace => trace.spec.metric === 'net_revenue').points;
    const expenditure = series.find(trace => trace.spec.metric === 'primary_expenditure').points;
    layout.shapes.push(...balanceHatches(revenue, expenditure, layout, width));
    addBalanceKey(layout, width, inside, revenue, expenditure, ['Surplus', 'Deficit'], 60);
  }
}

function validateIntegrationIncomePayload(payload,code) {
  const source=INTEGRATION_SERIES_BUNDLE.sources[code];
  if(!source||!Array.isArray(payload)||payload.length!==1)throw Error('Invalid earnings API response.');
  const variable=payload[0],results=variable.resultados;
  if(String(variable.id)!==source.indicator||variable.unidade!==source.expected_unit||!Array.isArray(results)||results.length!==1||
      !Array.isArray(results[0].classificacoes)||results[0].classificacoes.length!==0||!Array.isArray(results[0].series)||results[0].series.length!==1)throw Error('Unexpected earnings variable, unit or classification.');
  const series=results[0].series[0];
  if(String(series.localidade?.id)!=='1'||series.localidade?.nivel?.id!=='N1'||!series.serie||typeof series.serie!=='object')throw Error('Unexpected earnings geography.');
  // Requiring numeric observations prevents the generic API parser from silently
  // dropping unavailable or malformed rows from this complete paired history.
  for(const [period,value] of Object.entries(series.serie)){
    if(!/^\d{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(period)||!String(value??'').trim()||!Number.isFinite(Number(String(value).replace(',','.')))||Number(String(value).replace(',','.'))<=0)throw Error('Missing or invalid earnings API estimate.');
  }
  return true;
}

function integrationIncomeRowsFromRaw(average,mass,minimumLast='2026-09-01',monthLimit=observationMonthLimit()) {
  if(!Array.isArray(average)||!Array.isArray(mass)||average.length!==mass.length||!average.length)throw Error('Incomplete paired earnings update.');
  if(average.at(-1)?.[0]!==mass.at(-1)?.[0])throw Error('Earnings releases use different price reference windows.');
  const baseAverage=average[0][1],baseMass=mass[0][1];
  const rows=average.map(([date,value],index)=>{
    if(date!==mass[index]?.[0]||date>monthLimit)throw Error('Mismatched or future earnings window.');
    return {period:date.slice(0,7).replace('-',''),date,period_label:integrationQuarterLabel(date),
      average_real_brl:value,mass_real_million_brl:mass[index][1],
      average_index:value/baseAverage*100,mass_index:mass[index][1]/baseMass*100};
  });
  return validateIntegrationIncomeRows(rows,minimumLast);
}

function createIntegrationIncomeController(options={}) {
  const bundle=options.bundle||INTEGRATION_SERIES_BUNDLE,now=options.now||(()=>new Date()),
    cycleFor=options.cycleFor||monthlyUpdateCycle,monthLimitFor=options.monthLimitFor||observationMonthLimit,
    fetchSeries=options.fetchSeries||((code,signal)=>fetchPublicSeries(code,signal)),
    storage=options.storage!==undefined?options.storage:(()=>{try{return globalThis.localStorage;}catch(error){return null;}})();
  let rows=validateIntegrationIncomeRows(bundle.income),source='seed',checkedCycle=null,pending=null,lastAttempt=0,lastAttemptAt=null;
  try{
    const saved=JSON.parse(storage?.getItem(INTEGRATION_INCOME_CACHE_KEY)||'null');
    if(saved?.version===1&&saved.retrieved>=bundle.snapshot_date&&typeof saved.checkedCycle==='string'){
      validateIntegrationIncomeRows(saved.rows,rows.at(-1).date);
      if(saved.rows.at(-1).date<=monthLimitFor(now())){rows=saved.rows;source='cache';checkedCycle=saved.checkedCycle;lastAttemptAt=saved.retrieved;}
    }
  }catch(error){/* A malformed optional cache leaves the checked seed in use. */}
  const state=()=>({rows,source,checkedCycle,lastAttemptAt,priceWindow:integrationQuarterLabel(rows.at(-1).date)});
  return {state,async refresh({force=false}={}){
    if(pending)return pending;
    const date=now(),cycle=cycleFor(date),time=date.getTime();
    if(!force&&(checkedCycle===cycle||lastAttempt&&time-lastAttempt<300000))return state();
    lastAttempt=time;lastAttemptAt=date.toISOString().slice(0,10);
    pending=(async()=>{
      const abort=new AbortController(),timer=setTimeout(()=>abort.abort(),options.timeoutMs??30000);
      try{
        const [average,mass]=await Promise.all(bundle.income_codes.map(code=>fetchSeries(code,abort.signal)));
        const candidate=integrationIncomeRowsFromRaw(average,mass,rows.at(-1).date,monthLimitFor(date));
        // Commit the pair only after both entire histories pass every check.
        rows=candidate;source='api';checkedCycle=cycle;
        try{storage?.setItem(INTEGRATION_INCOME_CACHE_KEY,JSON.stringify({version:1,retrieved:date.toISOString().slice(0,10),checkedCycle,rows}));}
        catch(error){/* Valid data remains available when browser storage is full. */}
        return state();
      }catch(error){
        // A release mismatch is detected after the shared parser. Drop only
        // these two response promises so a later retry can obtain both again.
        if(!options.fetchSeries)for(const code of bundle.income_codes){
          const source=bundle.sources[code],url=trustedPublicURL(source.url,source.provider);
          publicPayloads.delete(publicRequestKey(monthlyUpdateCycle(),url,source.method||'GET',source.headers,source.body));
        }
        throw error;
      }finally{clearTimeout(timer);}
    })();
    try{return await pending;}finally{pending=null;}
  }};
}

function createIntegrationIncomeRefresh(plot,draw,root) {
  const controller=getIntegrationIncomeController();
  let busy=false;
  const show=(state,error=false)=>{
    const target=root.querySelector('[data-integration-income-state]');
    if(target)target.textContent=`${state.lastAttemptAt?`Last source check: ${formatDataNoteDate(state.lastAttemptAt)}.`:'Data included in this page.'} Price reference: ${state.priceWindow}.${error?' The update was unavailable or incomplete; the data already shown remain displayed.':''}`;
  };
  show(controller.state());
  return async()=>{
    if(busy)return;
    busy=true;
    try{
      const before=controller.state(),after=await controller.refresh();
      if(after.rows!==before.rows)await draw(buildIntegrationSeries(plot));
      show(after);
    }catch(error){show(controller.state(),true);}
    finally{busy=false;}
  };
}

Object.assign(PUBLIC_API_SOURCES, INTEGRATION_SERIES_BUNDLE.sources);

const EXTERNAL_TRADE_CACHE_KEY = "brazil-economy-external-trade-group-v1";

function isExternalTradeCode(code) {
  return EXTERNAL_TRADE_CODES.includes(code);
}

function validateExternalTradeRaw(input, previous = null, limit = observationMonthLimit()) {
  const result = {};
  for (const code of EXTERNAL_TRADE_CODES) {
    const rows = input?.[code];
    if (!Array.isArray(rows) || !rows.length) throw new Error("Missing external-trade history.");
    let lastMonth = null;
    const copy = [];
    for (const point of rows) {
      if (!Array.isArray(point) || point.length !== 2 ||
          !/^\d{4}-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])-01$/.test(point[0]) ||
          typeof point[1] !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(point[1]) || point[1] <= 0 ||
          point[0] > limit) throw new Error("Invalid external-trade observation.");
      const month = monthIndex(point[0]);
      if (lastMonth !== null && month !== lastMonth + 1) throw new Error("External-trade history has a duplicate or missing month.");
      lastMonth = month;
      copy.push([point[0], point[1]]);
    }
    const reference = copy.filter(point => point[0].startsWith("2019-"));
    if (reference.length !== 12 || new Set(reference.map(point => point[0].slice(5, 7))).size !== 12)
      throw new Error("External trade requires all twelve months of 2019.");
    const old = previous?.[code] || EXTERNAL_TRADE_SEED.raw[code];
    if (copy.length < old.length || copy[0][0] > old[0][0] || copy.at(-1)[0] < old.at(-1)[0])
      throw new Error("External-trade response shortens the existing history.");
    result[code] = copy;
  }
  const commonStart = EXTERNAL_TRADE_CODES.map(code => result[code][0][0]).sort().at(-1);
  const commonEnd = EXTERNAL_TRADE_CODES.map(code => result[code].at(-1)[0]).sort()[0];
  if (commonStart > "1990-01-01" || commonEnd < "2019-12-01")
    throw new Error("External-trade common coverage is incomplete.");
  return result;
}

function buildExternalTradeSeries(plot, input) {
  const raw = validateExternalTradeRaw(input || EXTERNAL_TRADE_SEED.raw);
  const commonEnd = EXTERNAL_TRADE_CODES.map(code => raw[code].at(-1)[0]).sort()[0];
  return plot.traces.map(spec => {
    if (!isExternalTradeCode(spec.code)) throw new Error("Unexpected external-trade series.");
    const source = raw[spec.code];
    const reference = source.filter(point => point[0].startsWith("2019-"));
    const base = reference.reduce((total, point) => total + point[1], 0) / 12;
    return { spec, commonEnd, referenceMean: base,
      points: source.filter(point => point[0] >= plot.start && point[0] <= commonEnd)
        .map(([date, value]) => [date, 100 * value / base]) };
  });
}

function createExternalTradeController(options = {}) {
  const fetcher = options.fetcher || globalThis.fetch;
  const now = options.now || (() => new Date());
  const fetchSeries = options.fetchSeries || ((code, signal) => fetchIpeaSeries(code, signal, fetcher));
  let storage;
  try { storage = options.storage === undefined ? globalThis.localStorage : options.storage; }
  catch (error) { storage = null; }
  let raw = validateExternalTradeRaw(EXTERNAL_TRADE_SEED.raw), source = "seed", cycle = null, pending = null;
  const commit = (candidate, nextSource, nextCycle) => {
    raw = candidate; source = nextSource; cycle = nextCycle;
    if (options.publish !== false) {
      // Synchronous publication happens only after all three histories pass.
      for (const code of EXTERNAL_TRADE_CODES) currentRaw[code] = raw[code];
      if (cycle) for (const code of EXTERNAL_TRADE_CODES) refreshedCycles.set(code, cycle);
    }
  };
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(storage?.getItem(EXTERNAL_TRADE_CACHE_KEY) || "null");
    if (saved?.version === 1 && typeof saved.retrieved === "string" &&
        saved.retrieved >= EXTERNAL_TRADE_SEED.retrieved_date && saved.retrieved <= now().toISOString().slice(0, 10) &&
        /^\d{4}-\d{2}-20$/.test(saved.cycle || "") && saved.cycle <= monthlyUpdateCycle(now()))
      commit(validateExternalTradeRaw(saved.raw, raw), "cache", saved.cycle);
  } catch (error) { /* An incomplete cache leaves all three embedded histories intact. */ }
  const state = () => ({ raw, source, cycle });
  return { current: state, async refresh({ force = false } = {}) {
    const nextCycle = monthlyUpdateCycle(now());
    if (!force && cycle === nextCycle) return state();
    if (pending) return pending;
    pending = (async () => {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), options.timeoutMs ?? 45000);
      try {
        const rows = await Promise.all(EXTERNAL_TRADE_CODES.map(code => fetchSeries(code, controller.signal)));
        const candidate = validateExternalTradeRaw(Object.fromEntries(EXTERNAL_TRADE_CODES.map((code, i) => [code, rows[i]])), raw);
        commit(candidate, "api", nextCycle);
        try { storage?.setItem(EXTERNAL_TRADE_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ version: 1,
          retrieved: now().toISOString().slice(0, 10), cycle: nextCycle, raw })); }
        catch (error) { /* A full or disabled cache does not discard a complete update. */ }
        return state();
      } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
    })();
    try { return await pending; } finally { pending = null; }
  } };
}

let externalTradeController;
function getExternalTradeController() {
  if (!externalTradeController) externalTradeController = createExternalTradeController();
  return externalTradeController;
}

function cachedExternalTradeSeries(code) {
  return getExternalTradeController().current().raw[code];
}

function freshExternalTradeSeries(code) {
  return getExternalTradeController().refresh().then(state => state.raw[code], () => null);
}

function externalTradeBasePlot(plot) {
  return { ...plot, kind: "external-trade-base", axis2: undefined,
    legend_below: true, legend_below_gap: 42, legend_below_align: "right", legend_below_indicators: false };
}

function decorateExternalTradeFigure(plot, series, figure, options = {}) {
  const layout = figure.layout, mobile = options.mobile === true || figure.legendInfo.width < 500;
  const topDomain = [.59, .94], bottomDomain = [0, .415];
  const ranges = { y: [55, 130], y2: [0, 180] };
  // Preserve the approved variance-sensitive limits; future releases can grow
  // only the necessary edge when a new observation falls outside that range.
  for (const axis of ["y", "y2"]) {
    const values = series.filter(trace => (trace.spec.axis || "y") === axis).flatMap(trace => trace.points.map(point => point[1]));
    const step = axis === "y" ? 10 : 20, minimum = Math.min(...values), maximum = Math.max(...values);
    if (minimum < ranges[axis][0]) ranges[axis][0] = Math.floor(minimum / step) * step;
    if (maximum > ranges[axis][1]) ranges[axis][1] = Math.ceil(maximum / step) * step;
  }
  layout.yaxis = { ...layout.yaxis, domain: topDomain, anchor: "x", range: ranges.y,
    title: { text: "Index (2019 = 100)", standoff: 7 }, tick0: 60, dtick: 10, zeroline: false };
  layout.yaxis2 = { ...layout.yaxis, domain: bottomDomain, anchor: "x2", range: ranges.y2,
    title: { text: "Index (2019 = 100)", standoff: 7 }, tick0: 0, dtick: 20 };
  layout.xaxis2 = { ...layout.xaxis, domain: [0, 1], anchor: "y2", showticklabels: true };
  layout.xaxis = { ...layout.xaxis, domain: [0, 1], anchor: "y", matches: "x2", showticklabels: false };
  figure.data.slice(0, series.length).forEach((trace, index) => {
    trace.xaxis = index === 0 ? "x" : "x2";
    trace.yaxis = index === 0 ? "y" : "y2";
    trace.connectgaps = false;
    if (trace.yaxis === "y2") {
      trace.showlegend = true;
      trace.legend = "legend";
    }
  });
  const plotWidth = figure.legendInfo.width - layout.margin.l - layout.margin.r;
  const plotHeight = layout.height - layout.margin.t - layout.margin.b;
  layout.showlegend = true;
  layout.legend = {
    ...layout.legend,
    title: { text: "Indicators", font: { size: 11 } },
    orientation: "v", x: 5 / plotWidth, y: bottomDomain[1] - 5 / plotHeight,
    xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", traceorder: "normal",
    font: { size: 11 }, bgcolor: "rgba(255,255,255,.96)",
    bordercolor: "#000", borderwidth: 1, itemclick: false, itemdoubleclick: false
  };
  layout.shapes = layout.shapes.flatMap(shape => shape.type === "rect" && shape.layer === "below" &&
    shape.yref === "paper" && shape.y0 === 0 && shape.y1 === 1 ? [
      { ...shape, y0: topDomain[0], y1: topDomain[1] },
      { ...shape, xref: "x2", y0: bottomDomain[0], y1: bottomDomain[1] }
    ] : [shape]);
  layout.shapes.push({ type: "line", xref: "x2 domain", yref: "y2", x0: 0, x1: 1,
    y0: 100, y1: 100, line: { color: "#777", width: .8, dash: "dot" }, layer: "below", showlegend: false });
  const heading = (text, y) => ({ xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: 0, y,
    xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", yshift: -2, showarrow: false, align: "left",
    font: { family: '"Times New Roman", Times, serif', size: mobile ? 11 : 12, color: "#222" }, text });
  // Headings occupy a reserved gap above each panel and do not touch curves.
  layout.annotations.unshift(
    heading(mobile ? "A. Terms of trade<br>Export prices relative to import prices" : "A. Terms of trade — export prices relative to import prices", 1.025),
    heading("B. Export and import volumes (quantum)", .495));
  figure.externalTradeGeometry = { topDomain, bottomDomain, ranges, legendBand: true };
  return figure;
}

function externalTradeFigure(plot, series, width = 520, options = {}) {
  const mobile = options.mobile === true || width < 500;
  const margins = options.margins || { l: mobile ? 50 : 60, r: 14, t: mobile ? 44 : 30, b: 42 };
  const figure = figureFor(externalTradeBasePlot(plot), series, width, { ...options, margins });
  return decorateExternalTradeFigure(plot, series, figure, { ...options, mobile });
}

function buildExternalTradeExportFigure(plot, series) {
  const figure = buildExportFigure(externalTradeBasePlot(plot), series);
  return decorateExternalTradeFigure(plot, series, figure, { forExport: true });
}


function buildSeries(plot, raw) {
  if (plot.kind === "external-trade-panels") return buildExternalTradeSeries(plot, raw);
  if (plot.kind === "integration-series") return buildIntegrationSeries(plot);
  if (plot.kind === "violence-history") return buildVSHistorySeries(plot);
  if (plot.kind === "population-pyramid") return buildPopulationPyramidSeries(plot, raw?.ages ? raw : POPULATION_PYRAMID_SEED);
  return plot.traces.map(spec => {
    const source = String(spec.code).startsWith("snapshot:") ? SEEDS[spec.code] : raw[spec.code];
    if (!Array.isArray(source) || !source.length) throw new Error(`Missing series ${spec.code}`);
    let points;
    let priceBase;
    if (spec.op === "share_of_total") {
      const denominator = raw[spec.denominator];
      if (!Array.isArray(denominator) || !denominator.length) throw new Error(`Missing series ${spec.denominator}`);
      const totals = new Map(denominator);
      points = source.filter(([date]) => totals.get(date) > 0)
        .map(([date, value]) => [date, value / totals.get(date) * 100]);
    } else if (spec.op === "compound12") {
      points = rolling(source, 12, "compound");
    } else if (spec.op === "real_selic12") {
      const inflation = raw[spec.cpi];
      if (!Array.isArray(inflation) || !inflation.length) throw new Error(`Missing series ${spec.cpi}`);
      const inflationByMonth = new Map(inflation);
      points = rolling(source, 12, "compound")
        .filter(([date, nominal]) => Number.isFinite(nominal) && Number.isFinite(inflationByMonth.get(date)) && inflationByMonth.get(date) > -100)
        .map(([date, nominal]) => [date, 100 * ((1 + nominal / 100) / (1 + inflationByMonth.get(date) / 100) - 1)]);
    } else if (spec.op === "sum12") {
      // Monthly flows are added once; this is not a year-to-date series.
      points = rolling(source, 12, "sum");
    } else if (spec.op === "rebase_year") {
      const reference = source.filter(point => Number(point[0].slice(0, 4)) === spec.baseYear);
      const expected = spec.frequency === "quarterly" ? 4 : 12;
      if (reference.length !== expected) throw new Error(`Incomplete reference year for SGS ${spec.code}`);
      const base = reference.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point[1], 0) / reference.length;
      if (!Number.isFinite(base) || base === 0) throw new Error(`Invalid reference year for SGS ${spec.code}`);
      points = source.map(point => [point[0], 100 * point[1] / base]);
    } else if (spec.op === "net_exports_rebase_year") {
      // A fixed-2019-weight volume-balance proxy, rebased after subtraction.
      // The negative reference balance is valid and its sign is retained.
      const imports = raw[spec.subtractCode];
      if (!Array.isArray(imports) || !imports.length) throw new Error(`Missing series ${spec.subtractCode}`);
      const referenceMean = (values, code) => {
        const reference = values.filter(point => Number(point[0].slice(0, 4)) === spec.baseYear);
        if (reference.length !== 4) throw new Error(`Incomplete reference year for SGS ${code}`);
        const mean = reference.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point[1], 0) / 4;
        if (!Number.isFinite(mean) || mean <= 0) throw new Error(`Invalid reference year for SGS ${code}`);
        return mean;
      };
      const exportsMean = referenceMean(source, spec.code);
      const importsMean = referenceMean(imports, spec.subtractCode);
      const exportsWeight = spec.exportsWeight, importsWeight = spec.importsWeight;
      const baseBalance = exportsWeight - importsWeight;
      if (!(exportsWeight > 0) || !(importsWeight > 0) || !Number.isFinite(baseBalance) || baseBalance === 0) {
        throw new Error("Invalid net-exports reference balance");
      }
      const importsByDate = new Map(imports);
      points = source.filter(point => importsByDate.has(point[0])).map(([date, value]) => [
        date, 100 * (exportsWeight * value / exportsMean -
          importsWeight * importsByDate.get(date) / importsMean) / baseBalance
      ]);
    } else if (spec.op === "mean3") {
      points = rolling(clipped(source, plot.start), 3, "mean");
    } else if (spec.op === "year_end_december") {
      // This annual source reports December coverage under a January year label.
      points = source.map(([date, value]) => [`${date.slice(0, 4)}-12-01`, value]);
    } else if (spec.op === "ytd_sum12") {
      points = rolling(clipped(monthlyFromYTD(source), plot.start), 12, "sum");
    } else if (spec.op === "bndes_original_gdp") {
      // Explicit replication of Fig. 3(a): sum 12 original YTD observations.
      const numerator = rolling(clipped(source, plot.start), 12, "sum");
      const denominator = new Map(rolling(clipped(raw[spec.denominator], plot.start), 12, "sum"));
      points = numerator.filter(point => denominator.has(point[0]) && denominator.get(point[0]) !== 0)
        .map(point => [point[0], 100 * point[1] / denominator.get(point[0])]);
    } else if (spec.op === "bndes_gdp") {
      const numerator = rolling(clipped(monthlyFromYTD(source), plot.start), 12, "sum");
      const denominator = new Map(rolling(clipped(raw[spec.denominator], plot.start), 12, "sum"));
      points = numerator.filter(point => denominator.has(point[0]) && denominator.get(point[0]) !== 0)
        .map(point => [point[0], 100 * point[1] / denominator.get(point[0])]);
    } else if (spec.op === "deflate_ipca_latest") {
      const cpi = raw[spec.cpi];
      if (!Array.isArray(cpi) || !cpi.length) throw new Error(`Missing series ${spec.cpi}`);
      const monthlyCpi = new Map(cpi.filter(point => Number.isFinite(point[1]) && point[1] > -100));
      const common = source.filter(point => monthlyCpi.has(point[0]) && Number.isFinite(point[1]));
      priceBase = common.map(point => point[0]).sort().at(-1);
      if (!priceBase) throw new Error("No common transfer and IPCA reference month is available.");
      // A payment in month t is converted using rates t+1 through the base month.
      // Stop at a missing CPI month: earlier amounts cannot cross that gap.
      const factors = new Map([[priceBase, 1]]);
      let month = monthIndex(priceBase), factor = 1;
      while (monthlyCpi.has(monthDate(month))) {
        factor *= 1 + monthlyCpi.get(monthDate(month)) / 100;
        if (!Number.isFinite(factor) || factor <= 0) break;
        factors.set(monthDate(month - 1), factor);
        month--;
      }
      points = source.filter(point => point[0] <= priceBase && factors.has(point[0]))
        .map(point => [point[0], point[1] * factors.get(point[0])]);
    } else if (spec.op === "gdp_real" || spec.op === "deflate_ipca") {
      let level = 1;
      const index = new Map(raw[spec.cpi].map(point => {
        level *= 1 + point[1] / 100;
        return [point[0], level];
      }));
      const base = index.get(spec.base);
      if (!Number.isFinite(base)) throw new Error(`The price reference ${spec.base} is unavailable.`);
      points = source.filter(point => index.has(point[0]))
        .map(point => [point[0], point[1] * base / index.get(point[0])]);
    } else {
      points = source;
    }
    const factor = spec.factor ?? 1;
    points = clipped(points, plot.start).map(point => [point[0], point[1] * factor]);
    if (!points.length) throw new Error(`No observations for ${plot.id}`);
    return priceBase ? { spec, points, priceBase } : { spec, points };
  });
}

function isIpeaCode(code) {
  return typeof code === "string" && /^ipea:[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$/.test(code);
}

function isRegionalIpeaSeries(seriesCode) {
  return ["SIS_ESTATAMBUF", "SIS_ESTABINTSUSUF", "SIS_ESTABURGSUSUF", "SIS_ESTABDTSUSUF", "SIS_NMLTINT1000HUF", "SIS_NMLTINTSUS1000HUF", "SUS_NMMED10MHUF", "SIS_NMENF1000HUF", "SIS_NMODN1000HUF"].includes(seriesCode) ||
    seriesCode === "FAM_PBF" || seriesCode === "VAL_PBF12" ||
    /^PNADCT_TXINFORMUF(?:_(?:1417|1824|2539|4059|60M|BRA|HOM|MUL|PRD|NEG))?$/.test(seriesCode);
}

function dependencies(plot) {
  if (plot.kind === "integration-series") return [];
  if (plot.kind === "violence-history") return [];
  if (plot.kind === "population-pyramid") return [];
  return [...new Set(plot.traces.flatMap(trace => [trace.code, trace.cpi, trace.denominator, trace.subtractCode]
    .filter(code => Number.isFinite(code) || isIpeaCode(code) || isPublicCode(code))))];
}

function resolvedPriceBase(plot, series) {
  const base = series.find(trace => trace.priceBase)?.priceBase;
  if (!base) return dashboardText("latest available month");
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(DASHBOARD_LOCALE, { month: "long", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" })
    .format(new Date(base + "T12:00:00Z"));
}

function resolvePriceBaseText(text, plot, series) {
  const latestYear = series.flatMap(trace => trace.points).map(point => point[0].slice(0, 4)).sort().at(-1) || dashboardText("latest available year");
  return String(text).replaceAll("{priceBase}", resolvedPriceBase(plot, series)).replaceAll("{lastYear}", latestYear);
}

function axisBounds(spec, series, hardMinimum) {
  if (spec.fixed === true && Number.isFinite(spec.min) && Number.isFinite(spec.max) && spec.max > spec.min) {
    return [spec.min, spec.max];
  }
  const values = series.flatMap(trace => trace.points.map(point => point[1]));
  const minimum = Math.min(...values);
  const maximum = Math.max(...values);
  const padding = spec.fit_data === true ? Math.max((maximum - minimum) * .015, Math.abs(maximum) * .001, .01) :
    spec.tight === true ? Math.max((maximum - minimum) * .04, Math.abs(maximum) * .001, .0001) :
    Math.max((maximum - minimum) * .05, Math.abs(maximum) * .015, .01);
  let lower = Number.isFinite(spec.min) ? Math.min(spec.min, minimum - padding) : minimum - padding;
  let upper = Number.isFinite(spec.max) ? Math.max(spec.max, maximum + padding) : maximum + padding;
  if (spec.min === 0 && minimum >= 0) lower = 0;
  if (spec.fixedMin === true && Number.isFinite(spec.min)) lower = spec.min;
  if (Number.isFinite(hardMinimum)) {
    lower = hardMinimum;
    upper = Math.max(hardMinimum + 5, Math.ceil(upper / 5) * 5);
  }
  if (spec.fit_data === true) {
    const step = Number.isFinite(spec.niceStep) && spec.niceStep > 0 ? spec.niceStep : 1;
    lower = Math.floor(lower / step) * step;
    upper = Math.ceil(upper / step) * step;
  }
  if (Number.isFinite(spec.tickStep) && spec.tickStep > 0) {
    upper = Math.max(lower + spec.tickStep, Math.ceil(upper / spec.tickStep) * spec.tickStep);
  }
  return [lower, upper];
}

function seriesIntervalMonths(frequency) {
  if (frequency === "biennial") return 24;
  if (frequency === "annual" || frequency === "crop-year" || frequency === true) return 12;
  return frequency === "quarterly" ? 3 : 1;
}

function finiteQuarterlyPoint(period, value) {
  const match = /^(\d{4})0([1-4])$/.exec(String(period));
  if (!match) return null;
  const month = String(Number(match[2]) * 3 - 2).padStart(2, "0");
  return finiteMonthlyPoint(match[1] + month, value);
}

function decorateSixSeriesProjection(plot, series, data, layout) {
  const first = plot.projection_start;
  layout.shapes.push({
    type: "rect", xref: "x", yref: "paper", x0: first, x1: layout.xaxis.range[1],
    y0: 0, y1: 1, fillcolor: "rgba(80,80,80,.12)", line: {width: 0}, layer: "below"
  });
  const [minimum, maximum] = layout.yaxis.range;
  layout.annotations.push({
    xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: .98, y: (plot.reference_line - minimum) / (maximum - minimum),
    xanchor: "right", yanchor: "bottom", yshift: 2,
    text: plot.reference_line_label, showarrow: false, font: {size: 9, color: "#555"}
  });
  const projections = [];
  series.forEach((_, index) => {
    const item = data[index];
    const split = item.x.findIndex(date => date >= first);
    if (split < 1) return;
    const bridge = split - 1;
    const customdata = item.x.map(date => {
      const status = dashboardText(date >= first ? "Projection" : "Historical estimate");
      return `${date.slice(0, 4)} · ${status}`;
    });
    projections.push({
      ...item, x: item.x.slice(bridge), y: item.y.slice(bridge),
      customdata: customdata.slice(bridge), line: {...item.line, dash: "dash"}
    });
    item.x = item.x.slice(0, split);
    item.y = item.y.slice(0, split);
    item.customdata = customdata.slice(0, split);
  });
  // Keep the original series count and order for the native legend helpers.
  data.splice(series.length, 0, ...projections);
}

function dateLabel(date, frequency = "monthly") {
  if (frequency === "crop-year") {
    const year = Number(date.slice(0, 4));
    return year + "/" + String(year + 1).slice(-2);
  }
  if (frequency === true || frequency === "annual" || frequency === "biennial") return date.slice(0, 4);
  if (frequency === "quarterly") return `${DASHBOARD_PORTUGUESE ? "T" : "Q"}${Math.ceil(Number(date.slice(5, 7)) / 3)} ${date.slice(0, 4)}`;
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(DASHBOARD_LOCALE, { month: "short", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" })
    .format(new Date(date + "T12:00:00Z"));
}

function addGaps(points, frequency) {
  const output = [];
  for (const point of points) {
    const previous = output.at(-1);
    const difference = previous ? monthIndex(point[0]) - monthIndex(previous[0]) : 0;
    const step = seriesIntervalMonths(frequency);
    if (difference > step) output.push([monthDate(monthIndex(previous[0]) + step), null]);
    output.push(point);
  }
  return output;
}

function rgba(hex, alpha) {
  const fullHex = hex.length === 4 ? "#" + [...hex.slice(1)].map(c => c + c).join("") : hex;
  const rgb = [1, 3, 5].map(i => parseInt(fullHex.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
  return `rgba(${rgb.join(",")},${alpha})`;
}

function wrappedTitle(text, width, fontSize) {
  const limit = Math.max(26, Math.floor((width - 24) / (fontSize * .49)));
  const lines = [""];
  for (const word of text.split(/\s+/)) {
    const line = lines.at(-1);
    if (line && line.length + word.length + 1 > limit) lines.push(word);
    else lines[lines.length - 1] += (line ? " " : "") + word;
  }
  return lines.join("<br>");
}

function chooseLegend(series, ranges, count, width) {
  const boxWidth = Math.min(.45, 105 / Math.max(220, width - 70));
  const boxHeight = Math.min(.7, (count * 17 + 24) / 285);
  const candidates = [
    { x: .02, y: .98, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", left: 0, top: 0 },
    { x: .98, y: .98, xanchor: "right", yanchor: "top", left: 1 - boxWidth, top: 0 },
    { x: .02, y: .02, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "bottom", left: 0, top: 1 - boxHeight },
    { x: .98, y: .02, xanchor: "right", yanchor: "bottom", left: 1 - boxWidth, top: 1 - boxHeight }
  ];
  const start = Math.min(...series.flatMap(trace => trace.points.map(point => Date.parse(point[0]))));
  const end = Math.max(...series.flatMap(trace => trace.points.map(point => Date.parse(point[0]))));
  const scored = candidates.map(candidate => {
    let score = 0;
    for (const trace of series) {
      const range = ranges[trace.spec.axis || "y"];
      for (const point of trace.points) {
        const x = (Date.parse(point[0]) - start) / Math.max(1, end - start);
        const y = 1 - (point[1] - range[0]) / Math.max(.01, range[1] - range[0]);
        if (x >= candidate.left && x <= candidate.left + boxWidth &&
            y >= candidate.top && y <= candidate.top + boxHeight) score++;
      }
    }
    return { candidate, score };
  }).sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score);
  const { left, top, ...position } = scored[0].candidate;
  return position;
}

/**
 * Place a vertical Presidents legend only where it clears every data mark.
 *
 * `width` and `height` are the logical Plotly canvas dimensions, before PNG
 * scaling. `margins` must be the margins of the figure actually being drawn.
 * `series` is the unchanged buildSeries output: [{spec, points:[[ISO,value]]}].
 * Pass `preferredPosition` to preserve an existing zero-collision position.
 * An external=true result asks the caller to render its external legend.
 *
 * Geometry is rasterized into a conservative two-pixel occupancy grid. A
 * summed-area table then makes every candidate-box collision test O(1).
 */
function chooseLegendPlacement({
  series, ranges, start, end, width, height, margins,
  labels, fontSize = 10, titleSize = 10,
  preferredPosition = null, previousPosition = null
}) {
  const padding = 4;
  const cell = 2;
  const entries = Array.isArray(labels) ? labels.map(String) : [];
  const font = Number.isFinite(fontSize) ? fontSize : 10;
  const titleFont = Number.isFinite(titleSize) ? titleSize : 10;
  const plotWidth = Math.max(0, width - (margins?.l || 0) - (margins?.r || 0));
  const plotHeight = Math.max(0, height - (margins?.t || 0) - (margins?.b || 0));

  // Times-like character advances, calibrated to Plotly 3.1 SVG rectangles:
  // 8 labels => 87x175 @font10/title10; 74x173 @font7/title8.
  function emWidth(text) {
    const widths = {
      " ": .25, i: .278, l: .278, I: .333, j: .278, t: .278,
      f: .333, r: .333, s: .389, a: .444, c: .444, e: .444,
      v: .5, x: .5, y: .5, z: .444, m: .778, w: .722,
      B: .667, F: .556, H: .722, L: .611, P: .556,
      M: .889, W: .944, T: .611
    };
    return [...text].reduce((sum, character) => sum +
      (widths[character] ?? (/[A-Z]/.test(character) ? .667 : .5)), 0);
  }
  const widest = Math.max(0, ...entries.map(label => emWidth(label) * font * 1.04));
  const legendWidth = entries.length ? Math.ceil(Math.max(44 + widest, 12 + emWidth("Presidents") * titleFont * 1.04)) : 0;
  const rowHeight = Math.max(19, Math.ceil(font * 1.25 + 5));
  const legendHeight = entries.length ? entries.length * rowHeight + titleFont + 13 : 0;
  const box = { width: legendWidth, height: legendHeight };
  const defaultPosition = { x: .02, y: .98, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top" };
  if (!entries.length) return { external: false, position: defaultPosition, box };
  if (plotWidth < legendWidth + padding * 2 || plotHeight < legendHeight + padding * 2) {
    return { external: true, position: defaultPosition, box };
  }

  const columns = Math.ceil(plotWidth / cell);
  const rows = Math.ceil(plotHeight / cell);
  const occupied = new Uint8Array(columns * rows);
  const first = Date.parse(start);
  const last = Date.parse(end);
  if (!Number.isFinite(first) || !Number.isFinite(last) || last <= first) {
    return { external: true, position: defaultPosition, box };
  }

  function rectangle(left, top, right, bottom) {
    if (right < 0 || bottom < 0 || left > plotWidth || top > plotHeight) return;
    const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(left / cell));
    const x1 = Math.min(columns - 1, Math.floor(right / cell));
    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(top / cell));
    const y1 = Math.min(rows - 1, Math.floor(bottom / cell));
    for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) occupied.fill(1, y * columns + x0, y * columns + x1 + 1);
  }

  function point(date, value, range) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(value) || !range || range[1] <= range[0]) return null;
    const stamp = Date.parse(date);
    if (!Number.isFinite(stamp)) return null;
    return [(stamp - first) / (last - first) * plotWidth,
      (range[1] - value) / (range[1] - range[0]) * plotHeight];
  }

  function segment(a, b, thickness) {
    // Sample at no more than one pixel along the longest direction. The
    // occupied cell footprint is conservative relative to the actual stroke.
    const distance = Math.max(Math.abs(b[0] - a[0]), Math.abs(b[1] - a[1]));
    const samples = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(distance));
    const radius = Math.max(.8, thickness / 2);
    for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
      const t = i / samples;
      const x = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t;
      const y = a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t;
      rectangle(x - radius, y - radius, x + radius, y + radius);
    }
  }

  const barSeries = series.filter(trace => trace.spec?.type === "bar");
  const barCount = Math.max(1, barSeries.length);
  for (const trace of series) {
    const spec = trace.spec || {};
    const range = ranges[spec.axis || "y"] || ranges.y;
    const values = trace.points || [];
    if (spec.type === "bar") {
      const differences = values.slice(1).map((value, i) => Date.parse(value[0]) - Date.parse(values[i][0]))
        .filter(value => Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0).sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const interval = differences.length ? differences[Math.floor(differences.length / 2)] : 365.25 * 86400000;
      const totalWidth = .8 * interval / (last - first) * plotWidth;
      const barWidth = totalWidth / barCount;
      const offset = (barSeries.indexOf(trace) - (barCount - 1) / 2) * barWidth;
      const zero = point(start, 0, range);
      if (!zero) continue;
      for (const value of values) {
        const p = point(value[0], value[1], range);
        if (p) rectangle(p[0] + offset - barWidth / 2, Math.min(p[1], zero[1]),
          p[0] + offset + barWidth / 2, Math.max(p[1], zero[1]));
      }
    } else {
      let previous = null;
      let previousDate = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
        const value = values[i];
        const p = point(value[0], value[1], range);
        const month = Number(value[0].slice(0, 4)) * 12 + Number(value[0].slice(5, 7));
        const gap = previousDate === null ? 0 : month - previousDate;
        const maximumGap = seriesIntervalMonths(spec.frequency);
        if (p && previous && gap <= maximumGap) segment(previous, p, Math.max(1.3, spec.width || 1));
        previous = p;
        previousDate = month;
      }
    }
  }

  const stride = columns + 1;
  const integral = new Uint32Array(stride * (rows + 1));
  for (let y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
    let sum = 0;
    for (let x = 0; x < columns; x++) {
      sum += occupied[y * columns + x];
      integral[(y + 1) * stride + x + 1] = integral[y * stride + x + 1] + sum;
    }
  }

  function collision(left, top) {
    const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((left - padding) / cell));
    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((top - padding) / cell));
    const x1 = Math.min(columns, Math.ceil((left + legendWidth + padding) / cell));
    const y1 = Math.min(rows, Math.ceil((top + legendHeight + padding) / cell));
    return integral[y1 * stride + x1] - integral[y0 * stride + x1] -
      integral[y1 * stride + x0] + integral[y0 * stride + x0];
  }

  const preference = preferredPosition || previousPosition;
  function pixels(position) {
    if (!position) return null;
    const x = position.x * plotWidth - (position.xanchor === "right" ? legendWidth : position.xanchor === "center" ? legendWidth / 2 : 0);
    const y = (1 - position.y) * plotHeight - (position.yanchor === "bottom" ? legendHeight : position.yanchor === "middle" ? legendHeight / 2 : 0);
    return [x, y];
  }
  function paper(left, top) {
    return { x: left / plotWidth, y: 1 - top / plotHeight, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top" };
  }
  function fits(left, top) {
    return left >= padding && top >= padding &&
      left + legendWidth <= plotWidth - padding && top + legendHeight <= plotHeight - padding;
  }
  const preferred = pixels(preference);
  if (preferred && fits(...preferred) && collision(...preferred) === 0) {
    return { external: false, position: paper(...preferred), box };
  }

  const right = plotWidth - legendWidth - padding;
  const bottom = plotHeight - legendHeight - padding;
  const xs = [], ys = [];
  for (let x = padding; x < right; x += 8) xs.push(x);
  for (let y = padding; y < bottom; y += 8) ys.push(y);
  xs.push(right); ys.push(bottom);
  let best = null;
  for (const top of ys) for (const left of xs) {
    const count = collision(left, top);
    const distance = preferred ? Math.hypot(left - preferred[0], top - preferred[1]) : left + top;
    if (!best || count < best.count || (count === best.count && distance < best.distance)) {
      best = { left, top, count, distance };
    }
  }
  return {
    external: !best || best.count !== 0,
    position: best ? paper(best.left, best.top) : defaultPosition,
    box
  };
}


/* Place compact legends inside the plotting rectangle without changing data. */
function chooseInsideLegendLayout({
  series, ranges, start, end, width, height, margins,
  labels, fontSize = 10, titleSize = 10, preferredPosition = null,
  hardRanges = false, indicatorPosition = null, connectGaps = false, _heightSearch = false, fixedCorners = false, showSingleIndicator = false, heightPolicy = CHART_HEIGHTS
}) {
  const pw = Math.max(1, width - margins.l - margins.r);
  const ph = Math.max(1, height - margins.t - margins.b);
  const font = Math.max(1, Number(fontSize) || 10);
  const titleFont = Math.max(1, Number(titleSize) || 10);
  const inset = 5, clearance = 8, gap = 6, cell = 2;
  const original = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(ranges).map(([axis, range]) => [axis, range.slice()]));
  const presidents = Array.isArray(labels) ? labels.map(String) : [];
  const indicators = (series.length > 1 || showSingleIndicator) ? series.map(trace => String(trace.spec.legendLabel || trace.spec.label || "Indicator")) : [];
  const first = Date.parse(start), last = Date.parse(end);

  function textWidth(text) {
    const advance = { " ": .25, i: .278, l: .278, I: .333, j: .278, t: .278,
      f: .333, r: .333, s: .389, a: .444, c: .444, e: .444, m: .778, w: .722,
      M: .889, W: .944, B: .667, F: .556, H: .722, L: .611, P: .556, T: .611,
      "—": 1, "–": .5, "%": .833, "/": .278 };
    return Math.ceil([...text].reduce((sum, letter) => sum +
      (advance[letter] ?? (/[A-Z]/.test(letter) ? .667 : .5)), 0) * font * 1.1 + 1);
  }
  function boxes(items, requested, isPresident) {
    if (!items.length) return [];
    const columns = [...new Set(requested.map(n => Math.min(n, items.length)))];
    const columnWidth = Math.max(...items.map(textWidth)) + (isPresident ? 14 : 32);
    const rowHeight = Math.max(12, Math.ceil(font * 1.15) + 3);
    const title = isPresident ? "Presidents" : "Indicators";
    return columns.map(count => {
      const rows = Math.ceil(items.length / count);
      const usedColumns = Math.ceil(items.length / rows);
      return { box: { width: Math.max(usedColumns * columnWidth + (usedColumns - 1) * gap, textWidth(title)) + 10,
          height: rows * rowHeight + titleFont + 3 + 10 },
        columns: usedColumns, rows, columnWidth, columnGap: gap, rowHeight, fontSize: font, titleSize: titleFont };
    }).filter(info => info.box.width <= pw - inset * 2 && info.box.height <= ph - inset * 2);
  }
  const presidentBoxes = boxes(presidents, [2, 4], true);
  const indicatorBoxes = boxes(indicators, [1, 2, 3, 4], false);
  const columns = Math.ceil(pw / cell), rows = Math.ceil(ph / cell), stride = columns + 1;
  const occupied = new Uint8Array(columns * rows);
  function paint(left, top, right, bottom) {
    if (right < 0 || bottom < 0 || left > pw || top > ph) return;
    const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(left / cell)), x1 = Math.min(columns - 1, Math.floor(right / cell));
    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(top / cell)), y1 = Math.min(rows - 1, Math.floor(bottom / cell));
    for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) occupied.fill(1, y * columns + x0, y * columns + x1 + 1);
  }
  function point(value, range) {
    if (!value || !Number.isFinite(value[1]) || !range || !(range[1] > range[0])) return null;
    const date = Date.parse(value[0]);
    if (!Number.isFinite(date) || !(last > first)) return null;
    return [(date - first) / (last - first) * pw, (range[1] - value[1]) / (range[1] - range[0]) * ph];
  }
  function line(a, b, thickness) {
    const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.max(Math.abs(b[0] - a[0]), Math.abs(b[1] - a[1]))));
    const radius = Math.max(1, thickness / 2);
    for (let k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
      const x = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / n, y = a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / n;
      paint(x - radius, y - radius, x + radius, y + radius);
    }
  }
  const bars = series.filter(trace => trace.spec.type === "bar");
  for (const trace of series) {
    const spec = trace.spec || {}, range = original[spec.axis || "y"], values = trace.points || [];
    if (spec.type === "bar") {
      const differences = values.slice(1).map((value, i) => Date.parse(value[0]) - Date.parse(values[i][0]))
        .filter(value => value > 0).sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const interval = differences.length ? differences[Math.floor(differences.length / 2)] : 365.25 * 86400000;
      const bw = .8 * interval / (last - first) * pw / Math.max(1, bars.length);
      const offset = (bars.indexOf(trace) - (bars.length - 1) / 2) * bw;
      const baseline = point([start, 0], range);
      if (baseline) for (const value of values) {
        const p = point(value, range);
        if (p) paint(p[0] + offset - bw / 2, Math.min(p[1], baseline[1]),
          p[0] + offset + bw / 2, Math.max(p[1], baseline[1]));
      }
    } else {
      let previous = null, previousMonth = null;
      const maximumGap = seriesIntervalMonths(spec.frequency);
      for (let index = 0; index < values.length; index++) {
        const value = values[index], p = point(value, range);
        const month = Number(value[0].slice(0, 4)) * 12 + Number(value[0].slice(5, 7));
        if (p && previous && (connectGaps || month - previousMonth <= maximumGap)) line(previous, p, Math.max(1.3, spec.width || 1));
        if (p) {
          const radius = 1;
          paint(p[0] - radius, p[1] - radius, p[0] + radius, p[1] + radius);
        }
        previous = p; previousMonth = month;
      }
    }
  }
  const sat = new Uint32Array(stride * (rows + 1));
  for (let y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
    let sum = 0;
    for (let x = 0; x < columns; x++) {
      sum += occupied[y * columns + x];
      sat[(y + 1) * stride + x + 1] = sat[y * stride + x + 1] + sum;
    }
  }
  function hits(left, top, box) {
    const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((left - clearance) / cell));
    const x1 = Math.min(columns, Math.ceil((left + box.width + clearance) / cell));
    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor((top - clearance) / cell));
    const y1 = Math.min(rows, Math.ceil((top + box.height + clearance) / cell));
    return sat[y1 * stride + x1] - sat[y0 * stride + x1] - sat[y1 * stride + x0] + sat[y0 * stride + x0];
  }
  function preference(info, requested, defaultBottom = false) {
    let position = requested;
    if (typeof requested === "string") {
      const parts = requested.split("-");
      position = { x: parts[1] === "right" ? 1 : parts[1] === "center" ? .5 : 0,
        y: parts[0] === "bottom" ? 0 : parts[0] === "middle" ? .5 : 1,
        xanchor: parts[1] || "left", yanchor: parts[0] === "bottom" ? "bottom" : parts[0] === "middle" ? "middle" : "top" };
    }
    position = position || { x: 0, y: defaultBottom ? 0 : 1, xanchor: "left", yanchor: defaultBottom ? "bottom" : "top" };
    return [position.x * pw - (position.xanchor === "right" ? info.box.width : position.xanchor === "center" ? info.box.width / 2 : 0),
      (1 - position.y) * ph - (position.yanchor === "bottom" ? info.box.height : position.yanchor === "middle" ? info.box.height / 2 : 0)];
  }
  function locations(info, requested, defaultBottom = false) {
    const pref = preference(info, requested, defaultBottom), right = pw - info.box.width - inset, bottom = ph - info.box.height - inset;
    const xs = [inset, right, Math.max(inset, Math.min(right, pref[0]))];
    const ys = [inset, bottom, Math.max(inset, Math.min(bottom, pref[1]))];
    for (let x = inset; x < right; x += 8) xs.push(x);
    for (let y = inset; y < bottom; y += 8) ys.push(y);
    const found = [];
    for (const top of new Set(ys)) for (const left of new Set(xs)) {
      if (!hits(left, top, info.box)) found.push({ left, top, distance: Math.hypot(left - pref[0], top - pref[1]) });
    }
    return found.sort((a, b) => a.distance - b.distance);
  }
  function pack(info, at) {
    return { ...info, position: { x: at.left / pw, y: 1 - at.top / ph, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top" } };
  }
  function separate(a, ai, b, bi) {
    return a.left + ai.box.width + clearance <= b.left || b.left + bi.box.width + clearance <= a.left ||
      a.top + ai.box.height + clearance <= b.top || b.top + bi.box.height + clearance <= a.top;
  }
  // Prefer a common visual edge before allowing unrelated positions. All
  // candidates use the existing plot ranges and collision map: alignment alone
  // never reserves more space or changes the figure's height.
  const presidentLocationCache = new Map();
  function freePresidents(info) {
    if (!presidentLocationCache.has(info)) presidentLocationCache.set(info, locations(info, preferredPosition));
    return presidentLocationCache.get(info);
  }
  function axisCandidates(maximum, preferred, extra) {
    if (maximum < inset) return [];
    const values = [inset, maximum, Math.max(inset, Math.min(maximum, preferred)), ...extra];
    for (let value = inset; value < maximum; value += 8) values.push(value);
    return [...new Set(values)].filter(value => value >= inset && value <= maximum)
      .sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a - preferred) - Math.abs(b - preferred) || a - b);
  }
  function alignedLocation(anchorInfo, anchor, candidateInfo, edge, requested = null, defaultBottom = false) {
    const pref = preference(candidateInfo, requested, defaultBottom);
    const xmax = pw - candidateInfo.box.width - inset, ymax = ph - candidateInfo.box.height - inset;
    let positions;
    if (edge === "top" || edge === "bottom") {
      const top = edge === "top" ? anchor.top : anchor.top + anchorInfo.box.height - candidateInfo.box.height;
      positions = axisCandidates(xmax, pref[0], [anchor.left - candidateInfo.box.width - clearance,
        anchor.left + anchorInfo.box.width + clearance]).map(left => ({ left, top }));
    } else {
      const left = edge === "left" ? anchor.left : anchor.left + anchorInfo.box.width - candidateInfo.box.width;
      positions = axisCandidates(ymax, pref[1], [anchor.top - candidateInfo.box.height - clearance,
        anchor.top + anchorInfo.box.height + clearance]).map(top => ({ left, top }));
    }
    for (const at of positions) {
      if (at.left < inset || at.top < inset || at.left > xmax || at.top > ymax) continue;
      if (separate(anchor, anchorInfo, at, candidateInfo) && !hits(at.left, at.top, candidateInfo.box)) return at;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function requireMoreHeight(code, message, extra = {}) {
    if (!_heightSearch) {
      const candidates = [...new Set([...heightPolicy.legendGrowth.map(extra => height + extra),
        Math.max(heightPolicy.legendSearchMin, height + heightPolicy.legendSearchExtra)])];
      for (const nextHeight of candidates) {
        try {
          const result = chooseInsideLegendLayout({ series, ranges: original, start, end, width,
            height: nextHeight, margins, labels, fontSize: font, titleSize: titleFont,
            preferredPosition, hardRanges, indicatorPosition, connectGaps, _heightSearch: true, fixedCorners, showSingleIndicator, heightPolicy });
          return { ...result, requiredHeight: nextHeight };
        } catch (error) {
          if (!String(error.code || "").startsWith("INSIDE_LEGEND_")) throw error;
          if (error.code === "INSIDE_LEGEND_WIDTH") throw error;
        }
      }
    }
    const error = new Error(message);
    error.code = code;
    Object.assign(error, extra);
    throw error;
  }
  if (fixedCorners && indicators.length) {
    // Keep the requested diagonal corners without changing the debt scale.
    for (const pi of presidentBoxes) for (const ii of indicatorBoxes) {
      const p = { left: inset, top: inset };
      const i = { left: pw - ii.box.width - inset, top: ph - ii.box.height - inset };
      if (!hits(p.left, p.top, pi.box) && !hits(i.left, i.top, ii.box) && separate(p, pi, i, ii)) {
        return { ranges: original, presidents: pack(pi, p), indicators: pack(ii, i),
          reservedFraction: 0, fixedCorners: true };
      }
    }
    return requireMoreHeight("INSIDE_LEGEND_CORNER_COLLISION",
      "A taller plotting area is needed to keep the requested diagonal legend corners clear of the data.");
  }
  if (indicatorPosition === "top-aligned" && indicators.length) {
    const pairs = [];
    for (const pi of presidentBoxes) for (const ii of indicatorBoxes) {
      const combinedWidth = pi.box.width + clearance + ii.box.width;
      if (combinedWidth <= pw - inset * 2) pairs.push({ pi, ii, combinedWidth });
    }
    if (!pairs.length) {
      const error = new Error("The two aligned legend boxes need a wider plotting area.");
      error.code = "INSIDE_LEGEND_WIDTH";
      error.requiredWidth = margins.l + margins.r + inset * 2 +
        Math.min(...presidentBoxes.map(info => info.box.width)) + clearance +
        Math.min(...indicatorBoxes.map(info => info.box.width));
      throw error;
    }
    // Keep Presidents left of Indicators. Shift the whole top-aligned block
    // toward the right first, leaving the early-2000s Selic peak unobstructed.
    for (const { pi, ii, combinedWidth } of pairs) {
      const right = pw - combinedWidth - inset;
      const lefts = [right, inset];
      for (let left = right; left > inset; left -= 4) lefts.push(left);
      for (const left of new Set(lefts)) {
        const p = { left, top: inset }, i = { left: left + pi.box.width + clearance, top: inset };
        if (!hits(p.left, p.top, pi.box) && !hits(i.left, i.top, ii.box)) return {
          ranges: original, presidents: pack(pi, p), indicators: pack(ii, i), reservedFraction: 0 };
      }
    }
    return requireMoreHeight("INSIDE_LEGEND_TOP_COLLISION",

  }
  if (indicatorPosition === "bottom-right" && indicators.length) {
    // Indicators remain exactly five pixels from the lower-right plot corner.
    // First align Presidents with their base or their vertical column.
    for (const edge of ["bottom", "right", "left"]) for (const ii of indicatorBoxes) {
      const i = { left: pw - ii.box.width - inset, top: ph - ii.box.height - inset };
      if (hits(i.left, i.top, ii.box)) continue;
      for (const pi of presidentBoxes) {
        const p = alignedLocation(ii, i, pi, edge, preferredPosition);
        if (p) return { ranges: original, presidents: pack(pi, p), indicators: pack(ii, i),
          reservedFraction: 0, alignment: edge };
      }
    }
    for (const ii of indicatorBoxes) {
      const i = { left: pw - ii.box.width - inset, top: ph - ii.box.height - inset };
      if (hits(i.left, i.top, ii.box)) continue;
      for (const pi of presidentBoxes) for (const p of freePresidents(pi)) {
        if (separate(p, pi, i, ii)) return {
          ranges: original, presidents: pack(pi, p), indicators: pack(ii, i), reservedFraction: 0 };
      }
    }
    return requireMoreHeight("INSIDE_LEGEND_BOTTOM_RIGHT_COLLISION",
      "The bottom-right indicator box needs a taller plotting area to clear the data.");
  }
  if (indicators.length) {
    // Search every permitted column configuration for a side-by-side pair
    // before considering a vertically stacked pair or independent placement.
    for (const edge of ["top", "bottom", "left", "right"]) {
      for (const pi of presidentBoxes) for (const ii of indicatorBoxes) {
        for (const p of freePresidents(pi)) {
          const i = alignedLocation(pi, p, ii, edge, null, true);
          if (i) return { ranges: original, presidents: pack(pi, p), indicators: pack(ii, i),
            reservedFraction: 0, alignment: edge };
        }
      }
    }
  }
  const alternatives = indicatorBoxes.map(info => {
    const places = locations(info, null, true);
    const extremes = places.length ? [places[0],
      places.reduce((a, b) => a.left < b.left ? a : b), places.reduce((a, b) => a.left > b.left ? a : b),
      places.reduce((a, b) => a.top < b.top ? a : b), places.reduce((a, b) => a.top > b.top ? a : b)] : [];
    return { info, places: [...new Set(extremes)] };
  });
  for (const pi of presidentBoxes) for (const p of freePresidents(pi)) {
    if (!indicators.length) return { ranges: original, presidents: pack(pi, p), indicators: null, reservedFraction: 0 };
    for (const alternative of alternatives) for (const i of alternative.places) {
      if (separate(p, pi, i, alternative.info)) return {
        ranges: original, presidents: pack(pi, p), indicators: pack(alternative.info, i), reservedFraction: 0 };

  }
  if (hardRanges) return requireMoreHeight("INSIDE_LEGEND_HARD_RANGE_COLLISION",
    "A taller plotting area is needed to retain the fixed axis ranges without covering data.");
  // A reserved top band guarantees visible legends even for dense line/bar plots.
  const arrangements = [];
  for (const pi of presidentBoxes) {
    if (!indicators.length) arrangements.push({ pi, p: { left: inset, top: inset }, bottom: inset + pi.box.height });
    for (const ii of indicatorBoxes) {
      if (pi.box.width + clearance + ii.box.width <= pw - inset * 2) arrangements.push({ pi, ii,
        p: { left: inset, top: inset }, i: { left: inset + pi.box.width + clearance, top: inset },
        bottom: inset + Math.max(pi.box.height, ii.box.height) });
      if (pi.box.height + clearance + ii.box.height <= ph - inset * 2) arrangements.push({ pi, ii,
        p: { left: inset, top: inset }, i: { left: inset, top: inset + pi.box.height + clearance },
        bottom: inset + pi.box.height + clearance + ii.box.height });
    }
  }
  const fitting = arrangements.filter(item => item.bottom + clearance + cell < ph);
  fitting.sort((a, b) => a.bottom - b.bottom || a.pi.columns - b.pi.columns);
  const chosen = fitting[0];
  if (!chosen) throw new Error("Plot area is too small for the inside legends.");
  const reservedFraction = (chosen.bottom + clearance + cell) / ph;
  const expanded = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(original).map(([axis, range]) => [axis,
    [range[0], range[0] + (range[1] - range[0]) / (1 - reservedFraction)]]));
  return { ranges: expanded, presidents: pack(chosen.pi, chosen.p),
    indicators: chosen.ii ? pack(chosen.ii, chosen.i) : null, reservedFraction };
}




function belowLegendLayout({ plot, series, ranges, width, height, margins, governments, mobile = true, forExport = false, footerReserve = 0 }) {
  const fontSize = 11, titleSize = 11, rowHeight = 16, gap = 6;
  // Match the desktop Times metrics. Wide glyphs such as W and m need their
  // own advances; the safety factor also covers nearby serif fallback fonts.
  const textWidth = text => {
    const advance = { " ": .25, i: .278, l: .278, I: .333, j: .278, t: .278,
      f: .333, r: .333, s: .389, a: .444, c: .444, e: .444, m: .778, w: .722,
      M: .889, W: .944, B: .667, F: .556, H: .722, L: .611, P: .556, T: .611,
      "—": 1, "–": .5, "%": .833, "/": .278 };
    return Math.ceil([...String(text)].reduce((sum, letter) => sum +
      (advance[letter] ?? (/[A-Z]/.test(letter) ? .667 : .5)), 0) * fontSize * 1.1 + 1);
  };
  const box = (labels, requested, swatch) => {
    const rows = Math.ceil(labels.length / Math.min(requested, labels.length));
    const columns = Math.ceil(labels.length / rows);
    const columnWidth = Math.max(...labels.map(textWidth)) + swatch;
    return { columns, rows, columnWidth, columnGap: gap, rowHeight, fontSize, titleSize,
      box: { width: Math.max(columns * columnWidth + (columns - 1) * gap,
          textWidth(swatch === 14 ? "Presidents" : "Indicators")) + 10,
        height: rows * rowHeight + titleSize + 13 } };
  };
  const presidentLabels = governments.map(government => government[0]);
  const indicatorLabels = (plot.legend_below_indicators !== false && (series.length > 1 || plot.show_single_indicator === true)) ? series.map((trace, index) =>
    (mobile ? plot.mobile_legend_labels?.[index] : null) || trace.spec.legendLabel || trace.spec.label) : [];
  let presidentBoxes = [2, 3, 4, 1].map(n => box(presidentLabels, n, 14));
  let indicatorBoxes = indicatorLabels.length ? [1, 2, 3].map(n => box(indicatorLabels, n, 32)) : [null];
  const available = width - 10, arrangements = [];
  // Retain every word at the same font size. Wrap on phones when a side-by-side
  // pair is requested or a label box would otherwise exceed the canvas width.
  const nativePairFits = presidentBoxes.some(presidents => indicatorBoxes.some(indicators =>
    indicators && presidents.box.width + gap + indicators.box.width <= available));
  const labelBoxTooWide = indicatorBoxes.every(indicators => indicators && indicators.box.width > available);
  if (mobile && indicatorLabels.length &&
      ((plot.legend_mobile_side_by_side === true && !nativePairFits) || labelBoxTooWide)) {
    const presidents = box(presidentLabels, 1, 14);
    const indicatorWidth = available - presidents.box.width - gap;
    const labelWidth = indicatorWidth - 42;
    const longestWord = Math.max(...indicatorLabels.flatMap(label => label.split(/\s+/)).map(textWidth));
    if (labelWidth >= longestWord) {
      const wrappedLabels = indicatorLabels.map(label => {
        const lines = [];
        let line = "";
        for (const word of label.split(/\s+/)) {
          const candidate = line ? `${line} ${word}` : word;
          if (line && textWidth(candidate) > labelWidth) { lines.push(line); line = word; }
          else line = candidate;
        }
        if (line) lines.push(line);
        return lines.join("\n");
      });
      const labelLineHeight = plot.legend_mobile_line_height || 14;
      const rows = indicatorLabels.length;
      const rowHeight = Math.max(16, Math.max(...wrappedLabels.map(label => label.split("\n").length)) * labelLineHeight + 4);
      presidentBoxes = [presidents];
      indicatorBoxes = [{ columns: 1, rows, columnWidth: indicatorWidth - 10,
        columnGap: gap, rowHeight, fontSize, titleSize, wrappedLabels, labelLineHeight,
        box: { width: indicatorWidth, height: rows * rowHeight + titleSize + 13 } }];
    }
  }
  for (const presidents of presidentBoxes) for (const indicators of indicatorBoxes) {
    if (presidents.box.width > available || (indicators && indicators.box.width > available)) continue;
    const sideBySide = !indicators || presidents.box.width + gap + indicators.box.width <= available;
    if (sideBySide) arrangements.push({ presidents, indicators, stacked: false,
      legendHeight: Math.max(presidents.box.height, indicators?.box.height || 0) });
    if (indicators) arrangements.push({ presidents, indicators, stacked: true,
      legendHeight: presidents.box.height + gap + indicators.box.height });
  }
  // Prefer a short band, then the familiar two-column president box. A small
  // stacking penalty avoids moving a box onto another row just to save 1–2px.
  arrangements.sort((a, b) => (a.legendHeight + (a.stacked ? 6 : 0)) -
    (b.legendHeight + (b.stacked ? 6 : 0)) ||
    Math.abs(a.presidents.columns - 2) - Math.abs(b.presidents.columns - 2) ||
    (a.indicators?.columns || 0) - (b.indicators?.columns || 0));
  if (!arrangements.length) throw new Error("Mobile legend labels need a wider chart.");
  const { presidents, indicators, stacked, legendHeight } = arrangements[0];
  const bandStart = plot.legend_below === true ? (plot.legend_below_gap ?? 34) : 40;
  margins.b = bandStart + legendHeight + 8 + footerReserve;
  const minimumDataHeight = minimumPlotHeight(plot, {mobile, forExport});
  const requiredHeight = Math.max(height, margins.t + margins.b + minimumDataHeight);
  const pw = width - margins.l - margins.r;
  const ph = height - margins.t - margins.b;
  const position = (left, top) => ({ x: (left - margins.l) / pw,
    y: 1 - (ph + bandStart + top) / ph, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top" });
  const rightAligned = plot.legend_below_align === "right";
  const rightEdge = width - 5;
  const presidentLeft = rightAligned ? rightEdge - presidents.box.width -
    (!stacked && indicators ? gap + indicators.box.width : 0) : 5;
  presidents.position = position(presidentLeft, 0);
  if (indicators) indicators.position = stacked ? position(
    rightAligned ? rightEdge - indicators.box.width : 5, presidents.box.height + gap) :
    position(rightEdge - indicators.box.width, 0);
  return { ranges, presidents, indicators, indicatorLabels, reservedFraction: 0, below: true, requiredHeight,
    ...(plot.legend_below === true ? {footerOffset: bandStart + legendHeight + 12} : {}) };
}

/** Calendar-year labels anchored to the last observed year, rather than the
 * first observation's cadence. The date range and observations are unchanged.
 */
function generateYearTicks(start, end, finalDate, width = 520, margins = { l: 60, r: 14 }, showFirstYear = false, requiredYear = null, tickMonth = 1, preferAnnual = false) {
  const first = Date.parse(start), last = Date.parse(end), final = Date.parse(finalDate);
  if (![first, last, final].every(Number.isFinite) || last <= first || final < first || final > last) {
