  const object=topology.objects.municipalities;
  const geometries=object.geometries.filter(g=>validMunicipalCode(municipalCode(g),names) && (uf==="BR" || names[municipalCode(g)][1]===uf));
  if (!geometries.length) throw new Error("No boundaries for this state.");
  const selected={type:"GeometryCollection",geometries},features=libraries.topojson.feature(topology,selected).features;
  features.forEach(feature=>{feature.id=municipalCode(feature);});
  const dims=municipalDimensions(width,mobile,exported,classified);
  const collection={type:"FeatureCollection",features};
  const projection=libraries.d3.geoMercator().fitExtent([[dims.left+6,dims.top+6],[dims.width-dims.right-6,dims.top+dims.mapHeight-6]],collection);
  const path=libraries.d3.geoPath(projection).digits(2);
  const legend=classified ? {...dims.classificationLegend,mapLeft:dims.left} : municipalLegendPlacement(features.map(feature=>path.bounds(feature)),dims,mobile,exported);
  if(legend.mode==="reserved-left")projection.fitExtent([[legend.mapLeft+6,dims.top+6],[dims.width-dims.right-6,dims.top+dims.mapHeight-6]],collection);
  const outline=libraries.topojson.mesh(topology,selected,(a,b)=>a===b);
  const borders=libraries.topojson.mesh(topology,selected,(a,b)=>municipalCode(a).slice(0,2)!==municipalCode(b).slice(0,2));
  return {dims,legend,paths:features.map(feature=>({code:feature.id,path:path(feature)})),outline:path(outline),borders:path(borders),features,projection};
}
function municipalSubtitle(field,year) {
  if (field.subtitle) return field.subtitle;
  if (field.key==="gdpMunicipal") return `Annual GDP at current prices; BRL (colourbar: BRL billion), ${year}.`;
  if (field.key==="gdpPerCapita") return `Annual GDP per resident at current prices; BRL per person, ${year}.`;
  if (field.key==="pbfTotal") return `Total payments in December ${year}; BRL (colourbar: BRL million).`;
  if (field.key==="pbfAverage") return `Total December ${year} payments divided by benefits paid; BRL per benefit.`;
  if (field.key==="income") return `Mean monthly nominal household income per person; BRL, Census ${year}.`;
  if (field.key==="schooling") return `Mean years of study among people aged 25 or more; Census ${year}.`;
  return `Brazil’s cash transfer programme; number of benefits paid in December ${year}.`;
}

function municipalValue(field,value,rawValue) {
  if (field.religionOptions && Number.isFinite(value)) {
    const format = new Intl.NumberFormat(DASHBOARD_PORTUGUESE ? DASHBOARD_LOCALE : "en-GB", {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 5});
    return format.format(value) + "%";
  }
  if (field.key === "rentedDwellings" && Number.isFinite(value)) {
    const share = `${municipalNumber(value, field.decimals)}%`;
    return Array.isArray(rawValue) && rawValue.length === 2 && rawValue.every(Number.isSafeInteger) ?
      `${share}; ${municipalNumber(rawValue[0],0)} ${dashboardText("rented")} / ${municipalNumber(rawValue[1],0)} ${dashboardText("occupied permanent private dwellings")}` : share;
  }
  if(field.key === "susInpatientBeds")return healthBedsValue(field,value,rawValue);
  if(field.key === "digitalExclusion")return digitalExclusionValue(field,value,rawValue);
  if(field.vsSnapshot)return VSRateValue(field,value,rawValue);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) && field.missingLabel) return field.missingLabel;
  if (field.valueTransform === "ln" && Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return `${dashboardText("ln(population)")}: ${municipalNumber(value,field.decimals)}${Number.isFinite(rawValue) ? `; ${municipalNumber(rawValue,0)} ${dashboardText("people")}` : ""}`;
  }
  const unit=dashboardText(field.unit || '');
  const currency = unit.startsWith("BRL") ? "BRL" : unit.startsWith("R$") ? "R$" : "";
  return currency ? `${dashboardText(currency)} ${municipalNumber(value,field.decimals)}${unit.slice(currency.length)}` : `${municipalNumber(value,field.decimals)} ${unit}`;
}

function formatDataNoteDate(value) {
  const date=new Date(value);
  return Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat(DASHBOARD_PORTUGUESE ? DASHBOARD_LOCALE : "en-GB",{day:"numeric",month:"long",year:"numeric",timeZone:"UTC"}).format(date) : String(value || "");
}

function mapPreparationDate(field) {
  const originalDates={"map-gdp":"2026-10-29","map-gdp-per-capita":"2026-10-29","map-income":"2026-10-29","map-schooling":"2026-10-29"};
  return field.snapshotDate || originalDates[field.id] || MUNICIPAL_SNAPSHOT_DATE;
}

function municipalLayerStatus(layer) {
  if (layer.fixedSnapshot) return "";
  if (layer.status==="waiting") return "Waiting for matching December references in the payment and benefit-count series. Keeping the last valid average.";
  if (layer.status==="stale") return "Source temporarily unavailable. Keeping the last valid published dataset; API checks will retry.";
  if (layer.status==="updating") return "Checking the source API for published updates…";
  if (layer.status==="seed") return "Data included in this page. The source will be checked when the map is opened.";
  return "";
}

// Independent municipal data adapter. The host supplies its existing day-20
// cycle and scheduler; this adapter creates no timer or page-level listeners.
// Official IBGE Census 2022 municipal counts; the census year is deliberately fixed.
const CENSUS_YEAR = 2022;
const CENSUS_EXPECTED_MUNICIPALITIES = 5570;
const CENSUS_YOUNG_AGES = ['93070', '93084', '93085'];
const CENSUS_OLDER_AGES = ['93096', '93097', '93098', '49108', '49109', '60040', '60041', '6653'];
const CENSUS_REQUESTS = {
  water: {table: 6894, variable: '382', varyingClass: '1821', categories: ['72129', '72144'],
    fixedClasses: {'58': '95253', '86': '95251'}},
  sewer: {table: 7555, variable: '382', varyingClass: '11558', categories: ['46292', '46290'],
    fixedClasses: {'58': '95253', '86': '95251'}},
  waste: {table: 9541, variable: '382', varyingClass: '67', categories: ['10972', '2520'],
    fixedClasses: {'58': '95253', '86': '95251'}},
  agesYoung: {table: 9514, variable: '93', varyingClass: '287', categories: ['100362', ...CENSUS_YOUNG_AGES],
    fixedClasses: {'2': '6794', '286': '113635'}},
  agesOlder: {table: 9514, variable: '93', varyingClass: '287', categories: CENSUS_OLDER_AGES,
    fixedClasses: {'2': '6794', '286': '113635'}}
};

function censusRequestURL(spec) {
  const classes = `${spec.varyingClass}[${spec.categories.join(',')}]|` +
    Object.entries(spec.fixedClasses).map(([key, value]) => `${key}[${value}]`).join('|');
  return `https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/${spec.table}/periodos/${CENSUS_YEAR}` +
    `/variaveis/${spec.variable}?localidades=N6%5Ball%5D&classificacao=${encodeURIComponent(classes)}`;
}

function censusCount(value) {
  if (value === '-') return 0; // IBGE's conventional symbol for an actual zero.
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^\d+$/.test(value)) return null;
  const numeric = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(numeric) && numeric >= 0 ? numeric : null;
}

function parseCensusCounts(payload, spec) {
  if (!Array.isArray(payload) || payload.length !== 1 ||
      String(payload[0]?.id) !== spec.variable || payload[0]?.unidade !== 'Pessoas' ||
      !Array.isArray(payload[0]?.resultados)) throw new Error('Incompatible Census 2022 variable or unit.');
  const categories = new Map();
  for (const result of payload[0].resultados) {
    const actual = {};
    for (const classification of result.classificacoes || []) {
      const selected = Object.keys(classification.categoria || {});
      if (selected.length !== 1 || actual[String(classification.id)] !== undefined)
        throw new Error('Ambiguous Census 2022 classification.');
      actual[String(classification.id)] = selected[0];
    }
    const category = actual[spec.varyingClass];
    const expected = {...spec.fixedClasses, [spec.varyingClass]: category};
    if (!spec.categories.includes(category) ||
        JSON.stringify(Object.entries(actual).sort()) !== JSON.stringify(Object.entries(expected).sort()) ||
        categories.has(category) || !Array.isArray(result.series))
      throw new Error('Incompatible Census 2022 population selection.');
    const values = new Map();
    for (const item of result.series) {
      const code = String(item.localidade?.id || '');
      if (!/^\d{7}$/.test(code) || item.localidade?.nivel?.id !== 'N6' || values.has(code))
        throw new Error('Invalid or duplicated Census 2022 municipality.');
      if (Object.keys(item.serie || {}).length !== 1 || !Object.hasOwn(item.serie, String(CENSUS_YEAR)))
        throw new Error('Census 2022 response changed its reference year.');
      values.set(code, censusCount(item.serie[String(CENSUS_YEAR)]));
    }
    if (values.size !== CENSUS_EXPECTED_MUNICIPALITIES)
      throw new Error('Incomplete Census 2022 municipality universe.');
    categories.set(category, values);
  }
  if (categories.size !== spec.categories.length) throw new Error('Missing Census 2022 categories.');
  return categories;
}

function censusContentVersion(values, tables) {
  // Deterministic revision identifier: it changes when the returned counts change.
  let hash = 2166136261;
  const text = `${CENSUS_YEAR}|${tables}|` + Object.keys(values).sort().map(code => `${code}:${values[code]}`).join('|');
  for (const char of text) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ char.charCodeAt(0), 16777619) >>> 0;
  return `IBGE-Census-${CENSUS_YEAR}-${tables}-${hash.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`;
}

async function loadCensusLayers(fetchJson, options = {}) {
  if (typeof fetchJson !== 'function') throw new Error('Census API JSON fetcher is required.');
  const entries = await Promise.all(Object.entries(CENSUS_REQUESTS).map(async ([key, spec]) =>
    [key, parseCensusCounts(await fetchJson(censusRequestURL(spec)), spec)]));
  const raw = Object.fromEntries(entries);
  const baseCodes = [...raw.agesYoung.get('100362').keys()];
  const geometryCodes = new Set(options.geometryCodes || baseCodes);
  if (geometryCodes.size !== CENSUS_EXPECTED_MUNICIPALITIES ||
      [...geometryCodes].some(code => !/^\d{7}$/.test(code))) throw new Error('Incompatible Census 2022 geometry.');
  const coverageRatio = options.minCoverageRatio ?? 1;
  if (coverageRatio < .95 || coverageRatio > 1) throw new Error('Invalid Census coverage threshold.');
  const minimum = Math.ceil(geometryCodes.size * coverageRatio);
  const result = {};
  const fetchedAt = new Date().toISOString();

  function makeLayer(key, pairs, unit, tables) {
    const values = {}; let invalid = 0, excluded = 0, totalReported = 0;
    for (const [code, [numerator, denominator]] of pairs) {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(numerator) || !Number.isSafeInteger(denominator) || numerator < 0 || denominator <= 0 ||
          (['water', 'sewer', 'waste', 'older65'].includes(key) && numerator > denominator)) {invalid++; continue;}
      const value = 100 * numerator / denominator;
      if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {invalid++; continue;}
      totalReported++;
      if (geometryCodes.has(code)) values[code] = value; else excluded++;
    }
    const available = Object.keys(values).length;
    if (available < minimum) throw new Error(`Incomplete valid Census 2022 ${key} coverage.`);
    result[key] = {values: Object.freeze(values), year: CENSUS_YEAR, valueUnit: unit,
      sourceVersion: censusContentVersion(values, tables), fetchedAt,
      coverage: {available, geometry: geometryCodes.size, totalReported, excluded,
        missing: geometryCodes.size - available, invalid},
      apiSources: Object.values(CENSUS_REQUESTS).filter(s => tables.includes(String(s.table))).map(censusRequestURL)};
  }
  for (const [key, denominatorCategory, numeratorCategory] of
      [['water', '72129', '72144'], ['sewer', '46292', '46290'], ['waste', '10972', '2520']]) {
    const data = raw[key], denominator = data.get(denominatorCategory), numerator = data.get(numeratorCategory);
    makeLayer(key, baseCodes.map(code => [code, [numerator.get(code), denominator.get(code)]]), '%', String(CENSUS_REQUESTS[key].table));
  }
  const total = raw.agesYoung.get('100362');
  function ageSum(data, ageCodes, code) {
    const counts = ageCodes.map(age => data.get(age)?.get(code));
    return counts.every(Number.isSafeInteger) ? counts.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) : null;
  }
  const demographicPairs = {older65: [], ageing: [], dependency: []};
  for (const code of baseCodes) {
    const all = total.get(code), young = ageSum(raw.agesYoung, CENSUS_YOUNG_AGES, code),
      older = ageSum(raw.agesOlder, CENSUS_OLDER_AGES, code);
    const valid = [all, young, older].every(Number.isSafeInteger) && all >= young + older;
    demographicPairs.older65.push([code, valid ? [older, all] : [null, null]]);
    demographicPairs.ageing.push([code, valid ? [older, young] : [null, null]]);
    demographicPairs.dependency.push([code, valid ? [young + older, all - young - older] : [null, null]]);
  }
  makeLayer('older65', demographicPairs.older65, '%', '9514');
  makeLayer('ageing', demographicPairs.ageing, 'people aged 65+ per 100 children aged 0–14', '9514');
  makeLayer('dependency', demographicPairs.dependency, 'people aged 0–14 or 65+ per 100 people aged 15–64', '9514');
  return result;
}

export {CENSUS_YEAR, CENSUS_REQUESTS, censusRequestURL, parseCensusCounts, loadCensusLayers};

    }
    if (key === "digitalExclusion") {
      extraCensusAssert(recipe.op === "ratio100" && recipe.inputs[0] === "digitalWithout" &&

        "DIGITAL_RECIPE_CONFIGURATION");
      for (const code of codes) {
        const checked = digitalExclusionAudit(code, sources.digitalWithout.values[code],
          sources.digitalTotal.values[code], sources.digitalWith.values[code], sources.digitalPublished.values[code]);

        rawValues[code] = checked.raw;
      }
    }
    const counted = recipe.op === "log" ? rawValues : values;
    const unit = recipe.unit || (recipe.op === "complement100" || recipe.op.startsWith("ratio100") ? "%" :
      recipe.op === "log" ? `ln(${requests[plan.dependencies[0]].unit})` : requests[plan.dependencies[0]].unit);
    layers[key] = {

      sourceVersion: options.sourceVersion || `IBGE-Census2022:${extraCensusVersion(JSON.stringify({recipe,

      zeroCount: Object.values(counted).filter(value => value === 0).length,
      missingCodes: codes.filter(code => values[code] === null),
      ...(recipe.op === "log" || key === "digitalExclusion" ? {rawValues} : {}),
    };
  }
  return layers;
}

function VSMapSnapshot(key,geometryCodes) {
  const spec=VS_SIM_MAP_DEFINITIONS[key],keys=Object.keys(VS_SIM_MAP_ROWS);
  if(!spec||VS_SIM_MAP_META.year!==2022||keys.length!==5570||
      VS_SIM_MAP_META.expectedTerritories!==5570||!VS_SIM_MAP_META.sourceVersion)
    throw new Error("Incompatible fixed SIM 2022 map definition.");
  const codes=geometryCodes instanceof Set?geometryCodes:new Set(geometryCodes),values={},rawValues={};
  if(codes.size!==5570||keys.some(code=>!codes.has(code)))
    throw new Error("The fixed SIM 2022 snapshot does not match the municipal geometry.");
  for(const code of keys){
    const row=VS_SIM_MAP_ROWS[code];
    if(!/^\d{7}$/.test(code)||!Array.isArray(row)||row.length!==6||
      row.some(value=>!Number.isSafeInteger(value)||value<0)||row[0]===0||row[1]===0)
      throw new Error("Invalid fixed SIM count or Census denominator.");
    const numerator=row[spec.countIndex],denominator=spec.denominator==="men"?row[0]:
      spec.denominator==="women"?row[1]:row[0]+row[1];
    const value=100000*numerator/denominator;
    if(!Number.isSafeInteger(denominator)||denominator<=0||!Number.isFinite(value)||value<0)
      throw new Error("Invalid fixed SIM 2022 municipal rate.");
    values[code]=value;rawValues[code]=Object.freeze({count:numerator,population:denominator});
  }
  return {vsSnapshot:true,fixedSnapshot:true,fixedYear:2022,seedYear:2022,
    seedValues:Object.freeze(values),seedRawValues:Object.freeze(rawValues),outputUnit:spec.unit,

}
function VSFixedRateScale(values,field) {
  const finite=Object.values(values).filter(value=>Number.isFinite(value));
  const breaks=field.classUpperBounds,colours=field.classColours;
  if(!finite.length||finite.some(value=>value<0)||!Array.isArray(breaks)||breaks.length!==8||breaks[0]<=0||
    breaks.some((v,i)=>!Number.isFinite(v)||v<0||(i&&v<=breaks[i-1]))||
    !Array.isArray(colours)||colours.length!==breaks.length+1)
    throw new Error("Invalid fixed SIM rate classes.");
  const positive=finite.filter(value=>value>0);
  const classes=colours.map((colour,index)=>({lower:index?breaks[index-1]:0,
    upper:index<breaks.length?breaks[index]:null,lowerInclusive:false,
    upperInclusive:index<breaks.length,upperUnbounded:index===breaks.length,colour,count:0,
    label:index===0?`>0–${breaks[0]}`:index===breaks.length?`>${breaks.at(-1)}`:`>${breaks[index-1]}–${breaks[index]}`}));
  const scale={method:"vs-fixed-rate",min:positive.length?Math.min(...positive):null,max:positive.length?Math.max(...positive):null,count:positive.length,
    zeroCount:finite.filter(value=>value===0).length,coverageCount:finite.length,
    breaks:breaks.slice(),classes,national:true,requestedClasses:classes.length};
  for(const value of positive)classes[municipalDecileIndex(value,scale)].count++;
  return scale;
}
function VSRateValue(field,value,rawValue) {
  if(!Number.isFinite(value))return field.missingLabel||"No compatible 2022 observation";
  const spec=VS_SIM_MAP_DEFINITIONS[field.key];
  const rate=`${municipalNumber(value,field.decimals)} ${field.unit}`;
  if(!spec||!rawValue||!Number.isSafeInteger(rawValue.count)||!Number.isSafeInteger(rawValue.population))return rate;
  return `${rate}; ${dashboardText(spec.countLabel)}: ${municipalNumber(rawValue.count,0)}; ${dashboardText(spec.populationLabel)}: ${municipalNumber(rawValue.population,0)}`;
}

function healthBedsScale(values, field) {
  const positive = Object.values(values).filter(value => Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0);
  if (!positive.length) throw new Error("No positive SUS bed rates.");
  const breaks = field.classUpperBounds;
  const classes = field.classColours.map((colour, index) => {
    const lower = index ? breaks[index - 1] : 0;
    const upper = index < breaks.length ? breaks[index] : null;
    return {lower, upper, lowerInclusive: false, upperInclusive: upper !== null,
      upperUnbounded: upper === null, colour, count: 0,
      label: upper === null ? `>${lower}` : `>${lower}–${upper}`};
  });
  const scale = {method: "health-fixed-rate", min: Math.min(...positive), max: Math.max(...positive),
    breaks, classes, count: positive.length, national: true,
    zeroCount: Object.values(values).filter(value => value === 0).length};
  for (const value of positive) classes[municipalDecileIndex(value, scale)].count++;
  return scale;
}

function healthBedsValue(field, value, rawValue) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return field.missingLabel;
  const rate = `${municipalNumber(value, field.decimals)} ${field.unit}`;
  return Array.isArray(rawValue) && rawValue.every(Number.isSafeInteger) ?
    `${rate}; ${municipalNumber(rawValue[0], 0)} ${dashboardText("beds")} / ${municipalNumber(rawValue[1], 0)} ${dashboardText("residents")}` : rate;
}

    if (previous?.cycle === cycle && instant - previous.at < retryMs) return;
    attempts.set(group, {cycle, at: instant});
    for (const key of keys) layers[key] = {...layers[key], status: 'updating', error: null};
    emit();
    try {
      const recipes = Object.fromEntries(keys.map(key => [key, EXTRA_CENSUS_RECIPES[key]]));
      const datasets = await loadExtraCensusLayers(jsonRequest, EXTRA_CENSUS_REQUESTS, recipes,
        {geometryCodes: codes});
      if (disposed) return;
      if (!datasets || typeof datasets !== 'object' || Array.isArray(datasets) ||
          Object.keys(datasets).length !== keys.length)
        throw new Error('Incomplete extra Census result group.');
      const checkedAt = dateNow().toISOString(), next = {};
      for (const key of keys) {
        const definition = definitions[key], dataset = datasets[key];
        if (!dataset || dataset.year !== 2022 || dataset.unit !== definition.outputUnit ||
            dataset.sourceTerritoryCount !== definition.sourceTerritoryCount ||
            !dataset.values || typeof dataset.values !== 'object' || Array.isArray(dataset.values))
          throw new Error('Incompatible extra Census layer.');
        if (group === 'religion2022' && Object.values(dataset.values).some(value => value !== null && (value < 0 || value > 100)))
          throw new Error('Religion share outside 0–100%.');
        const rows = Object.entries(dataset.values).filter(([, value]) => value !== null)
          .map(([code, value]) => ({code, value}));
        const parsed = classifyRows(key, rows, 2022);
        const rawValues = extraRawValues(key, dataset.rawValues, parsed.values, {allowMissing: true});
        const reportedCodes = Object.keys(dataset.rawValues || dataset.values);
        parsed.coverage = coverage(parsed.values, dataset.sourceTerritoryCount,
          reportedCodes.filter(code => !codes.has(code)).length,
          Array.isArray(dataset.missingCodes) ? dataset.missingCodes.filter(code => dataset.rawValues?.[code] !== 0).length : 0);
        next[key] = {...parsed, ...(rawValues ? {rawValues} : {}),
          sourceVersion: dataset.sourceVersion || 'Census2022-extra',
          valueUnit: dataset.unit, definitionSignature: definition.definitionSignature,
          checkedAt, checkedCycle: cycle, updatedAt: checkedAt, origin: 'api', status: 'current', error: null};
      }
      // No layer advances until every requested recipe has passed validation.
      Object.assign(layers, next); emit();
      await Promise.all(keys.map(persist));
    } catch (error) {
      if (disposed) return;
      for (const key of keys) layers[key] = {...layers[key], status: 'stale',
        error: String(error?.message || 'Census source temporarily unavailable.')};
      emit();
    }
  }

  async function refreshLayer(key, cycle) {
    if (definitions[key].fixedSnapshot) return;
    if (layers[key].checkedCycle === cycle) return;
    const instant = dateNow().getTime(), previousAttempt = attempts.get(key);
    if (previousAttempt?.cycle === cycle && instant - previousAttempt.at < retryMs) return;
    attempts.set(key, { cycle, at: instant });
    layers[key] = { ...layers[key], status: 'updating', error: null }; emit();
    try {
      const result = definitions[key].externalIndex ? parseIdhm2010(await jsonRequest(IDHM2010_API)) : null;
      const loaded = result ? {...classifyRows(key,Object.entries(result.values).map(([code,value])=>({code,value})),2010),
        sourceVersion:IDHM2010_VERSION,valueUnit:'index',apiCount:result.apiCount,supplemented:result.supplemented} :
        definitions[key].code ? await loadPBF(key) : await loadIBGE(key);
      if (disposed) return;
      const checkedAt = dateNow().toISOString();
      layers[key] = loaded.unchanged ? { ...layers[key], checkedAt, checkedCycle: cycle, status: 'current', error: null } :
        { ...loaded, checkedAt, checkedCycle: cycle, updatedAt: checkedAt, origin: 'api', status: 'current', error: null };
      emit(); await persist(key);
      if (definitions[key].code) await persist('pbfAverage');
    } catch (error) {
      if (disposed) return;
      layers[key] = { ...layers[key], status: 'stale', error: String(error?.message || 'Source temporarily unavailable.') };
      emit();
    }
  }
  function refresh() {
    if (disposed) return Promise.resolve(snapshot());
    if (pending) return pending;
    pending = (async () => {
      await hydrate();
      const cycle = cycleFor(dateNow());
      if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-20$/.test(cycle)) throw new Error('Invalid dashboard update cycle.');
      await Promise.all([
        ...Object.keys(definitions).filter(key => !gdpKeys.includes(key) && !censusKeys.includes(key) && !extraCensusKeys.includes(key)).map(key => refreshLayer(key, cycle)),
        refreshCensusGroup(cycle),
        ...[...extraCensusGroups].map(([group, keys]) => refreshExtraCensusGroup(cycle, group, keys)),
        refreshGDPGroup(cycle)
      ]);
      return snapshot();
    })().finally(() => { pending = null; });
    return pending;
  }
  return { snapshot, hydrate, refresh,
    subscribe(listener) { listeners.add(listener); return () => listeners.delete(listener); },
    dispose() { disposed = true; listeners.clear(); for (const request of activeRequests) request.abort(); } };
}



let municipalLibraryPromise;
function loadMunicipalLibraries() {
  if (!municipalLibraryPromise) municipalLibraryPromise=(async()=>{
    const load=(url,ready)=>ready() ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
      const script=document.createElement("script");script.src=url;script.crossOrigin="anonymous";
      script.onload=()=>ready()?resolve():reject(new Error("Map library did not initialize."));
      script.onerror=()=>{script.remove();reject(new Error("Map library could not load."));};document.head.append(script);
    });
    await Promise.all([
      load("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js",()=>!!window.d3?.geoMercator),
      load("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/dist/topojson-client.min.js",()=>!!window.topojson?.feature),
      load("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fflate@0.8.2/umd/index.js",()=>!!window.fflate?.gunzipSync)
    ]);
    const bytes=Uint8Array.from(atob(MUNICIPAL_GEOMETRY_GZIP),character=>character.charCodeAt(0));
    const topology=JSON.parse(window.fflate.strFromU8(window.fflate.gunzipSync(bytes)));
    const ids=topology.objects?.municipalities?.geometries?.map(municipalCode);
    if (ids?.length!==Object.keys(MUNICIPAL_SEED_ROWS).length || ids.some(code=>!validMunicipalCode(code))) throw new Error("Municipal data and boundaries do not match.");
    return {libraries:{d3:window.d3,topojson:window.topojson},topology};
  })().catch(error=>{municipalLibraryPromise=undefined;throw error;});
  return municipalLibraryPromise;
}
// The statistical position is unchanged; the single-hue option only

const MUNICIPAL_DECILE_ANCHORS = Object.freeze(["#fff7fb","#ece2f0","#d0d1e6","#a6bddb","#67a9cf","#3690c0","#02818a","#016c59","#014636"]);
function municipalPuBuGnColour(index,count) {

  const lo=Math.floor(p),hi=Math.min(lo+1,MUNICIPAL_DECILE_ANCHORS.length-1),weight=p-lo;
  const channels=hex=>[1,3,5].map(offset=>parseInt(hex.slice(offset,offset+2),16));
  const a=channels(MUNICIPAL_DECILE_ANCHORS[lo]),b=channels(MUNICIPAL_DECILE_ANCHORS[hi]);
  return "#"+a.map((value,i)=>Math.round(value*(1-weight)+b[i]*weight).toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
}
const MUNICIPAL_DECILE_COLOURS = Object.freeze(Array.from({length:MUNICIPAL_COLOUR_CLASS_COUNT},(_,index)=>municipalPuBuGnColour(index,MUNICIPAL_COLOUR_CLASS_COUNT)));
function municipalClassLegendLayout(width,y,count=MUNICIPAL_COLOUR_CLASS_COUNT) {
  const policy=MUNICIPAL_CLASS_LEGEND;
  const padding=Math.min(policy.padding,width/10),available=Math.max(1,width-padding*2);
  const columnMinimum=count>=12?130:policy.minColumnWidth;
  const columns=Math.max(1,Math.min(count,count>=12?3:count===8?4:policy.maxColumns,Math.floor(available/columnMinimum)));
  const rows=Math.ceil(count/columns),columnWidth=available/columns;
  return {x:padding,y,width:available,columns,rows,columnWidth,header:policy.header,
    rowHeight:policy.rowHeight,swatch:policy.swatch,fontSize:policy.fontSize,
    height:policy.header+rows*policy.rowHeight+policy.bottom,mode:"below-grid"};
}
const MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_COLOURS = Object.freeze(Array.from({length:MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_SETTINGS.upperBounds.length+1},(_,index)=>{
  const p=index/MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_SETTINGS.upperBounds.length*(MUNICIPAL_DECILE_ANCHORS.length-1);
  const lo=Math.floor(p),hi=Math.min(lo+1,MUNICIPAL_DECILE_ANCHORS.length-1),weight=p-lo;
  const channels=hex=>[1,3,5].map(offset=>parseInt(hex.slice(offset,offset+2),16));
  const a=channels(MUNICIPAL_DECILE_ANCHORS[lo]),b=channels(MUNICIPAL_DECILE_ANCHORS[hi]);
  return "#"+a.map((value,i)=>Math.round(value*(1-weight)+b[i]*weight).toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");

const MUNICIPAL_SURVEY_CLASS_COLOURS = Object.freeze(MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_COLOURS.slice());
function municipalSurveyShareScale(values,settings=MUNICIPAL_SURVEY_CLASS_SETTINGS) {
  const finite=Object.values(values).filter(value=>Number.isFinite(value));
  if(!finite.length||finite.some(value=>value<0||value>100))throw new Error("Invalid surveyed-sector percentages.");
  const bounds=settings.upperBounds;
  if(!Array.isArray(bounds)||bounds.length!==7||bounds.some((value,i)=>!Number.isFinite(value)||value<=(i?bounds[i-1]:0)))
    throw new Error("Invalid surveyed-sector class limits.");
  const classes=Array.from({length:bounds.length+1},(_,index)=>{
    const lower=index===0?0:bounds[index-1],upper=index<bounds.length?bounds[index]:null;
    return {lower,upper,lowerInclusive:index===0,upperUnbounded:upper===null,colour:MUNICIPAL_SURVEY_CLASS_COLOURS[index],count:0,
      label:index===0?`≤${upper.toFixed(2)}`:upper===null?`>${lower.toFixed(2)}`:`>${lower.toFixed(2)}–${upper.toFixed(2)}`};
  });

    method:"survey-fixed-intervals",national:true,requestedClasses:classes.length,
    zeroCount:finite.filter(value=>value===0).length,coverageCount:finite.length};
  for(const value of finite)classes[municipalDecileIndex(value,scale)].count++;

}

function municipalForeignShareScale(values,settings=MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_SETTINGS) {
  const finite=Object.values(values).filter(value=>Number.isFinite(value));
  if(!finite.length||finite.some(value=>value<0))throw new Error("Invalid foreign-national percentages.");
  const bounds=settings.upperBounds;
  if(!Array.isArray(bounds)||bounds.length!==7||bounds.some((value,i)=>!Number.isFinite(value)||value<=(i?bounds[i-1]:0)))
    throw new Error("Invalid fixed foreign-national class limits.");

    const lower=index===0?0:bounds[index-1],upper=index<bounds.length?bounds[index]:null;
    return {lower,upper,lowerInclusive:false,upperUnbounded:upper===null,colour:MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_COLOURS[index],count:0,
      label:index===0?`≤${upper.toFixed(2)}`:upper===null?`>${lower.toFixed(2)}`:`>${lower.toFixed(2)}–${upper.toFixed(2)}`};
  });
  const scale={min:positive.length?positive[0]:null,max:positive.length?positive.at(-1):null,count:positive.length,
    breaks:bounds.slice(),classes,method:"positive-fixed-intervals",national:true,requestedClasses:classes.length,
    zeroCount:finite.filter(value=>value===0).length,coverageCount:finite.length};

function municipalTailAwareScale(values,settings=MUNICIPAL_ILLITERACY_CLASS_SETTINGS) {
  const sorted=Object.values(values).filter(value=>Number.isFinite(value)).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  if(!sorted.length)throw new Error("No finite municipal values for illiteracy classes.");
  const bodyMaximum=settings.bodyMaximum,bodyClasses=settings.bodyClasses,tailUpperBounds=settings.tailUpperBounds;
  if(!Number.isFinite(bodyMaximum)||!Number.isInteger(bodyClasses)||bodyClasses<1||!Array.isArray(tailUpperBounds)||
     tailUpperBounds.some((value,i)=>!Number.isFinite(value)||value<=(i?tailUpperBounds[i-1]:bodyMaximum)))
    throw new Error("Invalid illiteracy class settings.");
  const min=sorted[0],max=sorted.at(-1),count=sorted.length,body=sorted.filter(value=>value<=bodyMaximum);
  const bodyMaxObserved=body.at(-1);
  const bodyBreaks=body.length ? Array.from({length:bodyClasses-1},(_,i)=>body[Math.ceil(body.length*(i+1)/bodyClasses)-1])
    .filter(value=>value<bodyMaxObserved) : [];
  const candidates=[...new Set([...bodyBreaks,bodyMaximum,...tailUpperBounds])].filter(value=>value>=min&&value<max).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  // Merge empty bands when a refreshed or synthetic dataset has gaps.
  const breaks=[];let previousCount=0;
  for(const upper of candidates){
    const cumulative=sorted.filter(value=>value<=upper).length;
    if(cumulative>previousCount&&cumulative<count){breaks.push(upper);previousCount=cumulative;}
  }
  const uppers=[...breaks,max],classCount=uppers.length;
  const classes=uppers.map((upper,index)=>({
    lower:index===0?min:uppers[index-1],upper,lowerInclusive:index===0,
    colour:MUNICIPAL_DECILE_COLOURS[classCount===1?Math.floor((MUNICIPAL_COLOUR_CLASS_COUNT-1)/2):Math.round(index*(MUNICIPAL_COLOUR_CLASS_COUNT-1)/(classCount-1))],count:0
  }));
  const scale={min,max,count,breaks,classes,method:"body-quantiles-fixed-tail",national:true,
    bodyMaximum,bodyClasses,bodyCount:body.length,tailUpperBounds:tailUpperBounds.slice(),requestedClasses:bodyClasses+tailUpperBounds.length+1};
  for(const value of sorted)classes[municipalDecileIndex(value,scale)].count++;
  return scale;
}


function NLLegacyNineScale(values,field) {
  const finite=Object.values(values).filter(value=>Number.isFinite(value));
  if(!finite.length)throw new Error("No finite legacy municipal values.");
  if(field.key==="populationLnTotal"){
    const sorted=finite.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b),min=sorted[0],max=sorted.at(-1),count=sorted.length;
    const palette=field.classColours,requestedClasses=palette.length;
    const breaks=[...new Set(Array.from({length:requestedClasses-1},(_,i)=>sorted[Math.ceil(count*(i+1)/requestedClasses)-1]))].filter(v=>v<max);
    const uppers=[...breaks,max],n=uppers.length;
    const classes=uppers.map((upper,index)=>({lower:index?uppers[index-1]:min,upper,lowerInclusive:index===0,
      colour:palette[n===1?Math.floor((requestedClasses-1)/2):Math.round(index*(requestedClasses-1)/(n-1))],count:0}));
    const scale={min,max,count,breaks,classes,method:"nearest-rank",national:true,requestedClasses};
    for(const value of sorted)classes[municipalDecileIndex(value,scale)].count++;
    return scale;
  }
  const foreign=field.key==="nationalityForeignPercent",survey=field.key==="favelaSelectedShare";
  if(!foreign&&!survey||finite.some(v=>v<0||(survey&&v>100)))throw new Error("Invalid nine-band legacy map.");
  const bounds=field.classUpperBounds;
  if(!Array.isArray(bounds)||bounds.length!==8||bounds.some((v,i)=>!Number.isFinite(v)||v<=(i?bounds[i-1]:0)))
    throw new Error("Invalid nine-band legacy class limits.");
  const selected=foreign?finite.filter(v=>v>0):finite;
  const classes=MUNICIPAL_DECILE_ANCHORS.map((colour,index)=>{
    const lower=index?bounds[index-1]:0,upper=index<8?bounds[index]:null;
    return {lower,upper,lowerInclusive:survey&&index===0,upperUnbounded:upper===null,colour,count:0,
      label:index===0?`≤${municipalNumber(upper,2)}`:upper===null?`>${municipalNumber(lower,2)}`:`>${municipalNumber(lower,2)}–${municipalNumber(upper,2)}`};
  });
  const scale={min:selected.length?Math.min(...selected):null,max:selected.length?Math.max(...selected):null,
    count:selected.length,breaks:bounds.slice(),classes,method:foreign?"positive-fixed-intervals":"survey-fixed-intervals",national:true,
    requestedClasses:9,zeroCount:finite.filter(v=>v===0).length,coverageCount:finite.length};
  for(const value of selected)classes[municipalDecileIndex(value,scale)].count++;
  return scale;
}
function NLLegacyNineDescription(field) {

Upper limits belong to the lower band and ties stay together. Hover or tap to see the original population count. Light lavender through blue to dark green shows lower to higher values. State filters keep national limits.";
  if(field.key==="nationalityForeignPercent")return "Foreign-national percentages use nine fixed positive-share bands at 0.1%, 0.25%, 0.5%, 0.75%, 1%, 5%, 10% and 20%, then above 20%. The nine canonical colours show lower to higher positive shares. Pale blue-grey marks observed zeros, which count toward municipal coverage. Original five-decimal percentages and national class limits are retained.";

The nine canonical colours show lower to higher shares. Observed zeros stay in the first colour; municipalities outside the 656-territory coverage appear in very light grey. State filters keep the same limits.";

function NLLegacyNineAria(field,layer,scale) {

function municipalDecileScale(values) {
  const sorted=Object.values(values).filter(value=>Number.isFinite(value)).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  if(!sorted.length)throw new Error("No finite municipal values for decile classes.");
  const min=sorted[0],max=sorted.at(-1),count=sorted.length;
  const breaks=[...new Set(Array.from({length:MUNICIPAL_COLOUR_CLASS_COUNT-1},(_,i)=>sorted[Math.ceil(count*(i+1)/MUNICIPAL_COLOUR_CLASS_COUNT)-1]))].filter(value=>value<max);
  const uppers=[...breaks,max],classCount=uppers.length;
  const classes=uppers.map((upper,index)=>({
    lower:index===0?min:uppers[index-1],upper,lowerInclusive:index===0,
    colour:MUNICIPAL_DECILE_COLOURS[classCount===1?Math.floor((MUNICIPAL_COLOUR_CLASS_COUNT-1)/2):Math.round(index*(MUNICIPAL_COLOUR_CLASS_COUNT-1)/(classCount-1))],count:0
  }));
  const scale={min,max,count,breaks,classes,method:"nearest-rank",national:true};
  for(const value of sorted)classes[municipalDecileIndex(value,scale)].count++;
  return scale;
}

function municipalLowerDetailBands(values,field) {
  const finite=Object.values(values).filter(Number.isFinite);
  if(!finite.length)return null;
  const min=Math.min(...finite),max=Math.max(...finite);
  if(max===min)return null;
  const count=field.classCount,firstUpper=min+(max-min)/count;
  if(finite.filter(value=>value<=firstUpper).length/finite.length<.95)return null;

  // Keep repeated minimum values, such as observed zeros, in the first band.
  const aboveMin=finite.filter(value=>value>min).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  const pivot=Math.min(firstUpper,aboveMin[Math.ceil(aboveMin.length*.9)-1]);
  const labelStep=(field.legendScale||1)/10**(field.legendDecimals??2);
  const lowerCount=Math.min(Math.floor(count*2/3),Math.floor((pivot-min)/labelStep));
  if(lowerCount<2)return null;
  const upperCount=count-lowerCount;
  const upperRemainder=max-pivot-upperCount*labelStep;
  if(upperRemainder<0)return null;

  const lowerStep=(pivot-min)/lowerCount;
  const lower=Array.from({length:lowerCount-1},(_,i)=>min+(i+1)*lowerStep);
  if(!aboveMin.some(value=>value>lower[0] && value<=firstUpper))return null;
  const upper=Array.from({length:upperCount-1},(_,i)=>{
    const rank=i+1;
    return pivot+rank*labelStep+upperRemainder*(rank/upperCount)**2;
  });
  return [...lower,pivot,...upper];
}

function municipalBandCaption(count,lowerDetailBreaks,customCaption) {
  if(customCaption)return customCaption;
  return lowerDetailBreaks
    ? `${count} national bands with finer detail at low values.`
    : `${count} equal-width national bands.`;
}

function municipalDetailedScale(values,field) {
  const finite=Object.values(values).filter(Number.isFinite);
  if(!finite.length)throw new Error("No finite values for detailed municipal bands.");
  const classified=field.classExcludeZero ? finite.filter(value=>value>0) : finite;
  const min=field.classDomain?.[0] ?? field.classLowerBound ?? Math.min(...finite);
  const max=field.classDomain?.[1] ?? Math.max(...finite);
  const step=(max-min)/field.classCount;
  const breaks=field.classUpperBounds ?? field.lowerDetailBreaks ??
    (max===min ? [] : Array.from({length:field.classCount-1},(_,i)=>min+(i+1)*step));

  const uppers=[...breaks,field.classTopOpen ? null : max];
  const formatter=new Intl.NumberFormat(DASHBOARD_LOCALE,{maximumFractionDigits:field.legendDecimals??field.decimals??2});
  const format=value=>formatter.format(value/(field.legendScale||1));
  const classes=uppers.map((upper,index)=>{
    const lower=index?uppers[index-1]:min;
    const lowerInclusive=index===0 && !field.classExcludeZero;
    const upperUnbounded=upper===null;
    const label=upperUnbounded ? `>${format(lower)}` : upper===lower ? format(upper) :
      `${lowerInclusive?"":">"}${format(lower)}–${format(upper)}`;
    return {lower,upper,lowerInclusive,upperInclusive:!upperUnbounded,upperUnbounded,label,
      colour:municipalPuBuGnColour(index,uppers.length),count:0};
  });
  const scale={min,max,count:classified.length,breaks,classes,national:true,requestedClasses:field.classCount,
    method:field.classUpperBounds ? "fixed-intervals" : field.lowerDetailBreaks ? "lower-range-detail" : "equal-intervals"};
  if(field.classExcludeZero){
    scale.zeroCount=finite.length-classified.length;
    scale.coverageCount=finite.length;
  }
  for(const value of classified)classes[municipalDecileIndex(value,scale)].count++;
  return scale;
}

function municipalDecileIndex(value,scale) {
  if(!Number.isFinite(value))return null;
  if(scale.method==="official-idhm-bands"){
    const index=scale.breaks.findIndex(upper=>value<upper);return index<0?4:index;
  }
  const index=scale.breaks.findIndex(upper=>value<=upper);
  return index<0?scale.classes.length-1:index;
}
function municipalDecileColour(value,scale) {
  const index=municipalDecileIndex(value,scale);
  return index===null?"#dddddd":scale.classes[index].colour;
}

function municipalMapRGB(field,position) {
  if (field.colourScale !== "sequential-red" || position === null || !Number.isFinite(position))
    return municipalRGB(position,field.reverse);
  const p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,position)),low=[255,245,240],high=MUNICIPAL_COLOURS.red;
  return `rgb(${low.map((value,i)=>Math.round(value*(1-p)+high[i]*p)).join(",")})`;

function municipalMapStyleDescription(field) {
  if(field.lowerDetailBreaks)return "Narrower bands distinguish low values. State filters retain the full national range. Very light grey marks missing data.";
  if(field.colourScale === "detailed-pubugn")return field.classDescription;
  if(field.key === "susInpatientBeds")return "SUS inpatient beds per 10,000 residents in fixed national bands. Light lavender through blue to dark green shows lower to higher positive rates. Pale blue-grey marks observed zero beds. Very light grey marks municipalities outside table coverage. State filters keep the national bands. Boundaries: IBGE 2022.";
  if(field.key === "digitalExclusion")return "Census 2022 share of residents in occupied permanent private households without a home internet connection. Green means lower percentages, yellow is the unweighted national municipal median, and red means higher percentages. The national domain is retained when a state is selected. Missing observations appear in very light grey and are never filled as zero. Hover or tap shows the percentage, residents without a connection and total residents in the same household universe. This is not a measure of individual internet use or connection quality.";
  if(field.legacyNineBands)return NLLegacyNineDescription(field);
  if(field.colourScale === "vs-fixed-rate")return "Fixed SIM 2022 crude annual rates per 100,000 matching Census 2022 residents, by municipality of residence. " +
    (field.vsSex ? "Male and female assault maps use the same nine numerical rate limits and colours, with a separate population denominator for each sex. " : "") +
    "Nine fixed positive-rate bands use the same light-lavender, blue and dark-green palette as the resident-population and foreign-national-share maps. Lighter means lower and darker higher. Pale blue-grey marks observed zero. Very light grey marks missing data. Zero values remain numeric in coverage and hover. Finite upper limits are included in the lower class; the upper tail is open. State filtering preserves all limits. These are intervals, not quantiles or a median-centred scale. Hover also shows the death count and population denominator. The reference year remains 2022.";
  if(field.colourScale === "official-idhm")return "Official Census 2010 Municipal Human Development Index: income, longevity and education; index 0 to 1. Fixed categories: below 0.500, 0.500 to 0.599, 0.600 to 0.699, 0.700 to 0.799, 0.800 or higher. Equality enters the higher class. Red means lower and green higher. Very light grey marks five territories without a 2010 value. Boundaries are the 2022 reference geometry; values retain their 2010 year. State filtering keeps the same classes.";
  if(field.colourScale === "survey-fixed-pubugn")return "Favela shares refer only to the surveyed urban sectors, not the entire municipal population. Eight fixed classes use the upper limits 1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 30%, 40% and 50%, followed by above 50%. Observed zeros are coloured in the first class. Very light grey marks areas outside survey coverage. Original rates and the same fixed class limits are retained when filtering a state.";
  if(field.colourScale === "positive-tail-pubugn")return "Foreign-national shares use eight fixed positive intervals: up to 0.1%, above 0.1% to 0.25%, above 0.25% to 0.5%, above 0.5% to 0.75%, above 0.75% to 1%, above 1% to 5%, above 5% to 10%, and above 10%. Pale blue-grey marks observed zeros, which remain in coverage and the original data. Class counts are unequal. Tooltip percentages retain five-decimal precision. State filters keep these same fixed limits.";
  if(field.colourScale === "tail-aware-pubugn")return "Illiteracy classes: seven national quantile bands among municipalities with rates up to 5%, followed by the bands above 5% to 10%, above 10% to 20%, and above 20%. These are unequal-frequency classes, not deciles. Ties stay together. Every original percentage, including the maximum, is retained. Labels are rounded and state filters keep the national limits.";
  if(field.colourScale === "decile-pubugn")return "National municipal decile classes: light lavender through blue to dark green, from lower to higher values. Each class contains approximately one tenth of municipalities with data; ties stay together. Colours show rank groups, not equal numerical intervals. Legend labels are rounded; tooltips retain the indicator's values. State filters keep the national class limits. "+(field.missingPattern === "diagonal" ? "Very light grey marks municipalities outside survey coverage." : "Very light grey marks missing data.");
  const direction=field.colourScale === "sequential-red" ?
    "Lighter red means lower values; darker red means higher values. The national municipal median anchors the middle intensity." :
    field.reverse ? "Green below the median; red above." : "Red below the median; green above.";
  const zeros=field.zeroPattern === "solid" ? " Pale blue-grey marks observed zero values, which count toward coverage and the median reference." : "";
  const missing=field.missingPattern === "diagonal" ? "Very light grey marks municipalities outside survey coverage." : "Very light grey marks missing data.";
  return `${direction}${zeros} ${missing} The median uses one observation per municipality with data.`;
}

"+municipalNumber(coverage.excluded,0)+" additional source territories fall outside the 2022 boundaries.":""} ${layer.checkedAt ?     }
