MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_SETTINGS.upperBounds.length+1 : ["decile-pubugn","tail-aware-pubugn"].includes(view.field.colourScale)));
    const figure=buildMunicipalSVG(document,view.field,view.layer,view.geometry,names,uf);
    view.chart.replaceChildren(figure.svg);view.chart.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");view.chart.style.height=`${view.geometry.dims.height}px`;
    view.root.querySelector("[data-map-coverage]").textContent=`${uf==="BR"?"Brazil":MUNICIPAL_UFS.find(item=>item[0]===uf)[1]+" ("+uf+")"} · ${municipalNumber(figure.available,0)} / ${municipalNumber(figure.total,0)} municipalities with data`;
    view.sizeKey=key;view.dirty=false;view.domain=figure.domain;view.button.disabled=!!view.exporting;
    showSelection(selected);
  }
  function setUF(next) {
    uf=validMunicipalUF(next)?next:"BR";selected=null;pinned=null;
    try{sessionStorage.setItem("macro-municipal-uf-v1",uf);}catch(_){}
    for(const view of views.values()){view.select.value=uf;view.dirty=true;draw(view);}showSelection(null);
  }
  async function start(field) {
    requested.add(field.id);const view=views.get(field.id);if(!view)return;
    if(!resources){
      lastLibraryAttempt=Date.now();
      try{resources=await loadMunicipalLibraries();for(const item of views.values()){item.loadError=false;updateLabels(item);}}catch(_){view.loadError=true;view.chart.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");updateLabels(view);return;}
    }
    for(const item of views.values())draw(item);
    void controller.refresh();
  }
  for(const field of MUNICIPAL_MAPS) {
    const root=document.getElementById(`panel-${field.id}`),chart=document.getElementById(`chart-${field.id}`),select=root.querySelector("[data-map-state]"),button=document.getElementById(`download-${field.id}`);
    const view={field,root,chart,select,button,layer:initial[field.key],dirty:true};views.set(field.id,view);
    view.bandScale=root.querySelector("[data-map-band-scale]");
    if(view.bandScale){
      view.bandCaption=root.querySelector("[data-map-band-caption]");
      view.bandHelp=root.querySelector("[data-map-band-help]");
      view.bandScale.addEventListener("change",()=>{
        updateBandScale(view);
        view.dirty=true;
        draw(view);
      });
    }
    for(const[abbr,name]of MUNICIPAL_UFS){const option=document.createElement("option");option.value=abbr;option.textContent=`${name} (${abbr})`;select.append(option);}select.value=uf;
    select.addEventListener("change",()=>setUF(select.value));
    if (field.religionOptions) {
      const control = root.querySelector("[data-map-religion]");
      const variable = root.querySelector("[data-map-religion-variable]");
      const source = root.querySelector("[data-map-religion-source]");
      const sourceCode = root.querySelector("[data-map-religion-code]");
      function setReligion() {
        const choice = field.religionOptions.find(option => option.key === control.value);
        if (!choice) return;
        const {key, title, subtitle, exportName, snapshotDate} = choice;
        view.field = {...field, key, title, subtitle, exportName, snapshotDate,
          sourceLabel: dashboardText("Source: IBGE, Census 2022; " + choice.sourceCode + ".")};
        view.layer = controller.snapshot()[key];
        variable.textContent = choice.variable;
        source.href = choice.sourceURL;
        sourceCode.textContent = choice.sourceCode + ".";
        view.dirty = true;
        updateLabels(view);
        draw(view);
        if (selected) showSelection(selected, true);
      }
      control.value = field.key;
      control.addEventListener("change", setReligion);
      setReligion();
    }
    chart.addEventListener("pointerover",event=>{const path=event.target.closest?.("[data-municipality]");if(path&&window.matchMedia("(hover:hover)").matches)showSelection(path.getAttribute("data-municipality"));});
    chart.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>showSelection(pinned));
    chart.addEventListener("click",event=>{const path=event.target.closest?.("[data-municipality]");if(path){const code=path.getAttribute("data-municipality");pinned=pinned===code?null:code;showSelection(pinned,true);}});
    registerSectionRedraw(field,root,()=>draw(view));
    if(typeof ResizeObserver!=="undefined"){let scheduled=false;const observer=new ResizeObserver(()=>{if(scheduled)return;scheduled=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{scheduled=false;draw(view);});});observer.observe(chart);}
    button.addEventListener("click",async()=>{
      if(!resources||view.exporting)return;view.exporting=true;button.disabled=true;
      const exportUF=uf,exportLayer=view.layer,exportField=view.field;
      try {
        const geometry=municipalGeometry(resources.libraries,resources.topology,names,exportUF,1000,false,true,(exportField.colourScale === "detailed-pubugn" ? exportField.classCount : exportField.colourScale === "health-fixed-rate" ? exportField.classColours.length + 1 : exportField.legacyNineBands ? exportField.classColours.length : exportField.colourScale === "vs-fixed-rate" ? exportField.classColours.length : exportField.colourScale === "official-idhm" ? 5 : exportField.colourScale === "survey-fixed-pubugn" ? MUNICIPAL_SURVEY_CLASS_SETTINGS.upperBounds.length+1 : exportField.colourScale === "positive-tail-pubugn" ? MUNICIPAL_FOREIGN_CLASS_SETTINGS.upperBounds.length+1 : ["decile-pubugn","tail-aware-pubugn"].includes(exportField.colourScale)));
        const {svg}=buildMunicipalSVG(document,exportField,exportLayer,geometry,names,exportUF,true);
        const markup=new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svg),url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([markup],{type:"image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"}));
        try{
          const image=new Image();await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{image.onload=resolve;image.onerror=reject;image.src=url;});
          const canvas=document.createElement("canvas");canvas.width=geometry.dims.width*2;canvas.height=geometry.dims.height*2;const context=canvas.getContext("2d");context.fillStyle="#fff";context.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);context.drawImage(image,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
          const blob=await new Promise(resolve=>canvas.toBlob(resolve,"image/png"));if(!blob)throw new Error("PNG export unavailable.");
          const png=URL.createObjectURL(blob);try{const link=document.createElement("a");link.href=png;link.download=`${exportField.exportName || exportField.id}-${exportLayer.year}-${exportUF.toLowerCase()}.png`;document.body.append(link);link.click();link.remove();}finally{setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(png),30000);}
        }finally{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}
      }catch(_){const status=root.querySelector(".macro-status");status.textContent="PNG export could not be completed. Please try again.";status.hidden=false;}finally{view.exporting=false;button.disabled=false;}
    });
    updateLabels(view);draw(view);
  }
  void controller.hydrate();
  registerRefresh({id:"municipal-maps"},async()=>{if(!requested.size)return;void controller.refresh();if(!resources&&Date.now()-lastLibraryAttempt>=300000)void start(MUNICIPAL_MAPS.find(field=>requested.has(field.id)));});
  if(typeof IntersectionObserver==="undefined")MUNICIPAL_MAPS.forEach(field=>void start(field));
  else{
    const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{for(const entry of entries)if(entry.isIntersecting){const field=MUNICIPAL_MAPS.find(item=>`panel-${item.id}`===entry.target.id);if(field)void start(field);observer.unobserve(entry.target);}},{rootMargin:"650px 0px"});
    for(const view of views.values())observer.observe(view.root);
  }
  return {controller,views,setUF,showSelection,start};
}


const SECTION_SIDRA_URLS = Object.freeze({
  "crop-production-area-yield": "https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/5457/n1/1/v/216,214,112/p/all/c782/40124,40122,40139,40112",
  "food-inflation": "https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/7060/n1/1/v/2265/p/all/c315/7169,7170,7171,7432",
});

const SECTION_PAM_CROPS = [
  { id: "soybeans", code: "40124", start: "1974" },
  { id: "maize", code: "40122", start: "1974" },
  { id: "coffee", code: "40139", start: "2002" },
  { id: "beans", code: "40112", start: "1974" },
];

const SECTION_PAM_VARIABLES = [
  { code: "214", unit: "1017", name: "Production" },
  { code: "216", unit: "1006", name: "Harvested area" },
  { code: "112", unit: "33", name: "Yield" },
];

const SECTION_IPCA_CATEGORIES = [
  { code: "7169", name: "Headline IPCA" },
  { code: "7170", name: "Food and beverages" },
  { code: "7171", name: "Food at home" },
  { code: "7432", name: "Food away from home" },
];

function sectionSidraSeriesKey(variable, category) {
  return variable + "/" + category;
}

function readSectionSidraRows(rows, definitions, monthly) {
  const periodPattern = monthly ? /^\d{4}(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/ : /^\d{4}$/;
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length < 2 || rows[0]?.V !== "Valor") {
    throw new Error("Unexpected SIDRA response.");
  }
  const series = new Map(definitions.map(definition => [
    sectionSidraSeriesKey(definition.variable, definition.category),
    { ...definition, observations: new Map() },
  ]));
  for (const row of rows.slice(1)) {
    const entry = series.get(sectionSidraSeriesKey(row?.D2C, row?.D4C));
    const period = row?.D3C;
    if (!entry || row.NC !== "1" || row.D1C !== "1" ||
        typeof period !== "string" || !periodPattern.test(period)) {
      throw new Error("Unexpected SIDRA series or reference period.");
    }
    if (period < entry.start) continue;
    const raw = typeof row.V === "string" ? row.V.trim() : "";
    const value = Number(raw.replace(",", "."));
    if (!/^-?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?$/.test(raw) || !Number.isFinite(value) ||
        row.MC !== entry.unit || entry.observations.has(period) || (!monthly && value < 0)) {
      throw new Error("Missing, duplicate or invalid SIDRA observation.");
    }
    entry.observations.set(period, value);
  }

  let latest;
  for (const entry of series.values()) {
    const periods = [...entry.observations.keys()].sort();
    if (periods[0] !== entry.start || (latest && periods.at(-1) !== latest)) {
      throw new Error("SIDRA series do not cover a common reference period.");
    }
    latest = periods.at(-1);
    const ordinal = period => monthly ? Number(period.slice(0, 4)) * 12 + Number(period.slice(4)) : Number(period);
    if (periods.some((period, index) => ordinal(period) !== ordinal(entry.start) + index)) {
      throw new Error("SIDRA observations are incomplete.");
    }
    entry.periods = periods;
  }
  return series;
}

function replaceSectionSidraPoints(series, observations, monthly, base) {
  if (!series || !Array.isArray(series.points) || !series.points.length) {
    throw new Error("Published chart history is unavailable for comparison.");
  }
  const points = observations.periods.map(period => {
    const value = observations.observations.get(period);
    return monthly
      ? [period.slice(0, 4) + "-" + period.slice(4) + "-01", value]
      : [period + "-01-01", Number((value / base * 100).toFixed(2))];
  });
  const dates = new Set(points.map(point => point[0]));
  if (series.points.some(([date]) => !dates.has(date))) {
    throw new Error("SIDRA refresh would shorten the published history.");
  }
  const unchanged = series.points.length === points.length &&
    series.points.every(([date, value], index) => date === points[index][0] && value === points[index][1]);
  return unchanged ? series : { ...series, points };
}

function refreshSectionPamHistory(panel, rows) {
  const definitions = SECTION_PAM_CROPS.flatMap(crop => SECTION_PAM_VARIABLES.map(variable => ({
    category: crop.code, variable: variable.code, unit: variable.unit, start: crop.start,
  })));
  const data = readSectionSidraRows(rows, definitions, false);
  if (panel.views?.length !== SECTION_PAM_CROPS.length) {
    throw new Error("Unexpected crop views in the published chart.");
  }
  const views = panel.views.map(view => {
    const crop = SECTION_PAM_CROPS.find(entry => entry.id === view.id);
    if (!crop || view.series?.length !== SECTION_PAM_VARIABLES.length) {
      throw new Error("Unexpected crop series in the published chart.");
    }
    const series = view.series.map(trace => {
      const variable = SECTION_PAM_VARIABLES.find(entry => entry.name === trace.name);
      if (!variable) throw new Error("Unknown crop indicator.");
      const observations = data.get(sectionSidraSeriesKey(variable.code, crop.code));
      const base = observations.observations.get("2002");
      if (!(base > 0)) throw new Error("PAM index base is unavailable.");
      return replaceSectionSidraPoints(trace, observations, false, base);
    });
    const end = series[0].points.at(-1)[0].slice(0, 4);
    const subtitle = "Brazil, " + crop.start + "–" + end + ". Each series is indexed to 2002 = 100.";
    return subtitle === view.subtitle && series.every((trace, index) => trace === view.series[index])
      ? view : { ...view, series, subtitle };
  });
  if (views.every((view, index) => view === panel.views[index])) return panel;
  return { ...panel, views, series: views[0].series, subtitle: views[0].subtitle };
}

function refreshSectionFoodInflation(panel, rows) {
  const definitions = SECTION_IPCA_CATEGORIES.map(category => ({
    category: category.code, variable: "2265", unit: "2", start: "202012",
  }));
  const data = readSectionSidraRows(rows, definitions, true);
  if (panel.series?.length !== SECTION_IPCA_CATEGORIES.length) {
    throw new Error("Unexpected IPCA series in the published chart.");
  }
  const series = panel.series.map(trace => {
    const category = SECTION_IPCA_CATEGORIES.find(entry => entry.name === trace.name);
    if (!category) throw new Error("Unknown IPCA indicator.");
    const observations = data.get(sectionSidraSeriesKey("2265", category.code));
    return replaceSectionSidraPoints(trace, observations, true);
  });
  return series.every((trace, index) => trace === panel.series[index]) ? panel : { ...panel, series };
}

async function refreshSectionSnapshot(panel) {
  const url = Object.hasOwn(SECTION_SIDRA_URLS, panel.id) ? SECTION_SIDRA_URLS[panel.id] : null;
  if (!url) return panel;
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const deadline = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 12000);
  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal, cache: "no-store", credentials: "omit" });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("SIDRA data unavailable.");
    const rows = await response.json();
    return panel.id === "crop-production-area-yield"
      ? refreshSectionPamHistory(panel, rows)
      : refreshSectionFoodInflation(panel, rows);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(deadline);
  }
}

const sectionTraceColours = ["#22577a", "#b95335", "#387653", "#785e98", "#806327", "#53777b", "#994c70"];
const sectionTraceDashes = ["solid", "dash", "dot", "dashdot"];

function sectionExportSource(panel) {
  if (panel.exportSource) return panel.exportSource;
  return [...new Set(panel.sources.map(source => source.label.split(/ — | · |, /, 1)[0]))].join(" · ");
}

const earlyPresidentialTerms = [
  ["Médici", "1969-10-30", "1974-03-15", "#bcc4d1"],
  ["Geisel", "1974-03-15", "1979-03-15", "#dfb987"],
  ["Figueiredo", "1979-03-15", "1985-03-15", "#9ec6ae"],
];
const agriculturalLineStyles = {
  "crop-production-area-yield": [["#111", "solid"], ["#777", "solid"], ["#111", "dash"]],
  "soybean-and-maize-harvests": [["#111", "solid"], ["#777", "solid"], ["#444", "dash"]],
  "food-inflation": [["#111", "solid", 2], ["#777", "solid"], ["#111", "dash"], ["#777", "dash"]],
};

function agriculturalLineFigure(panel, view, width, exported = false) {
  const traces = view.series || panel.series;
  const historical = panel.series.filter(trace => !trace.name.endsWith(" (forecast)"));
  const styles = agriculturalLineStyles[panel.id];
  const frequency = panel.cropYear ? "crop-year" : panel.frequency || "annual";
  const series = traces.map(trace => {
    const observedLabel = trace.name.replace(/ \(forecast\)$/, "");
    const index = historical.findIndex(item => item.name === observedLabel);
    const [color, dash, strokeWidth = 1.5] = styles[index];
    return {
      spec: {
        label: dashboardText(trace.name), frequency, color, width: strokeWidth,
        dash: trace.dash || dash,
        hoverSuffix: panel.unit === "%" ? "%" : panel.cropYear ? dashboardText(" million tonnes") : "",
      },
      points: trace.points.filter(point => Number.isFinite(point[1])),
    };
  }).filter(trace => trace.points.length);
  const start = series.map(trace => trace.points[0][0]).sort()[0];
  const subtitle = dashboardText(view.subtitle || panel.subtitle);
  const plot = {
    id: panel.id,
    title: `${panel.roman}. ${dashboardText(panel.title)}`,
    subtitle: exported && view.label && !subtitle.includes(dashboardText(view.label)) ? `${dashboardText(view.label)} · ${subtitle}` : subtitle,
    source_caption: `${dashboardText("Source:")} ${dashboardText(panel.parallelSource)}.`,
    start, axis: {title: dashboardText(panel.unit), fit_data: true, ...(panel.cropYear ? {min: 0} : {})},
    reference_line: panel.id === "crop-production-area-yield" ? 100 : undefined,
    traces: series.map(trace => trace.spec),
    governments: panel.historicalPresidents ? [...earlyPresidentialTerms, ...GOVERNMENTS] : GOVERNMENTS,
    show_first_year: true, legend_mode: "inside", legend_preserve_ranges: true,
    legend_inside_max_height: true, mobile_legend_below: true, mobile_margins: {l: 48, r: 10},
    legend_below_align: "right", legend_mobile_side_by_side: true,
    president_legend: {columns: 2, position: "top-left"},
    legend_layout: {indicators: "top-right"},
  };
  const mobile = !exported && window.matchMedia("(max-width: 600px)").matches;
  const figure = exported ? buildExportFigure(plot, series) :
    figureFor(plot, series, width, {mobile, height: chartHeight(plot, {mobile})});
  return {figure: dashboardLocalizeFigure(figure), plot, series};
}

function sectionChartFigure(panel, view, width, exported = false) {
  panel = dashboardLocalizeFields(panel);
  view = dashboardLocalizeFields(view);
  const facets = view.facets || panel.facets || [{unit: view.unit || panel.unit, series: view.series || panel.series}];
  const compact = width < 440;
  const multiple = facets.length > 1;
  const traces = [];
  const footer = sectionExportSource(panel);
  const height = (multiple ? 155 * facets.length + 92 : 320) + (exported ? 76 : 0);
  const top = exported ? 76 : multiple ? 30 : 12;
  const bottom = exported ? 104 : compact ? 82 : 68;
  const legendOffset = -29 / (height - top - bottom);
  const layout = {
    width, height, paper_bgcolor: "#fff", plot_bgcolor: "#fff",
    font: {family: "Times New Roman, Times, serif", size: compact ? 10 : 12, color: "#222"},
    margin: {l: compact ? 48 : 63, r: compact ? 14 : 24, t: top, b: bottom},
    hovermode: "closest", showlegend: facets.some(facet => facet.series.length > 1),
    legend: {orientation: "h", x: 0, y: legendOffset, yanchor: "top", font: {size: compact ? 10 : 11}},
    barmode: panel.barmode || "group", annotations: [], shapes: [],
  };
  if (exported) {
    layout.title = {text: `${panel.roman}. ${panel.title}`, x: 0.04, font: {size: 19}};
    layout.annotations.push(
      {text: view.label || panel.subtitle, xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: 0, y: 1.065, xanchor: "left", showarrow: false},
      {text: `Source: ${footer}`, xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: 0, y: 0, yshift: -72, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", showarrow: false}
    );
  }
  const allX = facets.flatMap(facet => facet.series.flatMap(series => series.points.map(point => point[0])));
  const useDates = allX.every(value => /^\d{4}(?:-\d{2}(?:-\d{2})?)?$/.test(String(value)));
  const dateFormat = panel.frequency === "monthly" || allX.some(value => /^\d{4}-(?!01)\d{2}/.test(value)) ? "%b %Y" : "%Y";
  const cropYear = value => {
    const start = Number(String(value).slice(0, 4));
    return start + "/" + String(start + 1).slice(-2);
  };
  const xRange = multiple && useDates ? [allX.slice().sort()[0], allX.slice().sort().at(-1)] : undefined;
  const gap = multiple ? Math.min(.13, .24 / (facets.length - 1)) : 0;
  const span = (1 - (facets.length - 1) * gap) / facets.length;
  facets.forEach((facet, facetIndex) => {
    const suffix = facetIndex ? String(facetIndex + 1) : "";
    const xref = "x" + suffix;
    const yref = "y" + suffix;
    const bottom = (facets.length - 1 - facetIndex) * (span + gap);
    const unit = facet.unit || view.unit || panel.unit || "";
    layout["xaxis" + suffix] = {
      type: useDates ? "date" : "category", anchor: yref, range: xRange,
      showticklabels: facetIndex === facets.length - 1, nticks: compact ? 5 : 9,
      showgrid: false, showline: true, linecolor: "#b9b9b9", automargin: true,
    };
    layout["yaxis" + suffix] = {
      domain: [bottom, bottom + span], anchor: xref, nticks: multiple ? 4 : 6,
      title: {text: unit, standoff: 8, font: {size: compact ? 10 : 11}},
      gridcolor: "#e6e6e6", zerolinecolor: "#a4a4a4", automargin: true,
    };
    if (facet.title) layout.annotations.push({text: facet.title, xref: "paper", yref: "paper",
      x: 0, y: bottom + span, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "bottom", yshift: 3, showarrow: false});
    const highlight = view.highlight || panel.highlight;
    if (highlight && useDates) {
      layout.shapes.push({type: "rect", xref, yref: yref + " domain", x0: highlight.start, x1: highlight.end,
        y0: 0, y1: 1, fillcolor: "#e9bc69", opacity: 0.23, line: {width: 0}, layer: "below"});
    }
    facet.series.forEach((series, index) => {
      const color = series.color || sectionTraceColours[index % sectionTraceColours.length];
      const type = series.chartType || facet.chartType || view.chartType || panel.chartType || "scatter";
      const x = series.points.map(point => point[0]);
      const trace = {
        name: series.name, type, xaxis: xref, yaxis: yref,
        x, y: series.points.map(point => point[1]),
        showlegend: facet.series.length > 1, connectgaps: false,
        customdata: panel.cropYear ? x.map(cropYear) : undefined,
        hovertemplate: `${panel.cropYear ? "%{customdata}" : `%{x${useDates ? "|" + dateFormat : ""}}`}<br>%{y:,.2f} ${unit}<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>`,
      };
      if (type === "bar") {
        const anomaly = panel.id === "climate-temperature-anomalies" || panel.id === "climate-rainfall-anomalies";
        trace.marker = {color: anomaly ? trace.y.map(value => value < 0 ? "#3872a0" : "#b9523e") : color};
      }
      else {
        trace.mode = series.mode || (series.points.length < 18 ? "lines+markers" : "lines");
        trace.line = {color, width: 1.85, dash: series.dash || sectionTraceDashes[index % sectionTraceDashes.length]};
        trace.marker = {color, size: 4};
      }
      traces.push(trace);
    });
  });
  return dashboardLocalizeFigure({data: traces, layout, config: {displayModeBar: false, responsive: false, scrollZoom: false}});
}

function sectionStateGeometry(resources, width, mobile, exported) {
  const {libraries, topology} = resources;
  const boundaries = topology.objects.municipalities.geometries;
  const states = new Map();
  for (const geometry of boundaries) {
    const code = municipalCode(geometry).slice(0, 2);
    if (!states.has(code)) states.set(code, []);
    states.get(code).push(geometry);
  }
  const features = [...states].map(([id, geometries]) => ({
    type: "Feature", id, geometry: libraries.topojson.merge(topology, geometries),
  }));
  const dims = municipalDimensions(width, mobile, exported);
  const collection = {type: "FeatureCollection", features};
  const projection = libraries.d3.geoMercator();
  const fit = left => projection.fitExtent([[left + 6, dims.top + 6],
    [dims.width - dims.right - 6, dims.top + dims.mapHeight - 6]], collection);
  fit(dims.left);
  const path = libraries.d3.geoPath(projection).digits(2);
  const legend = municipalLegendPlacement(features.map(feature => path.bounds(feature)), dims, mobile, exported);
  if (legend.mode === "reserved-left") fit(legend.mapLeft);
  return {dims, legend, paths: features.map(feature => ({code: feature.id, path: path(feature)}))};
}

const sectionStateCodes = {
  RO: "11", AC: "12", AM: "13", RR: "14", PA: "15", AP: "16", TO: "17", MA: "21", PI: "22", CE: "23",
  RN: "24", PB: "25", PE: "26", AL: "27", SE: "28", BA: "29", MG: "31", ES: "32", RJ: "33", SP: "35",
  PR: "41", SC: "42", RS: "43", MS: "50", MT: "51", GO: "52", DF: "53",
};
const sectionStateNames = Object.fromEntries(MUNICIPAL_UFS.map(([abbr, name]) => [sectionStateCodes[abbr], [name, abbr]]));

async function sectionMapPNG(svg, name) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svg)], {type: "image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"}));
  try {
    const image = new Image();
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { image.onload = resolve; image.onerror = reject; image.src = url; });
    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = image.width * 2;
    canvas.height = image.height * 2;
    const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
    context.fillStyle = "#fff";
    context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    context.drawImage(image, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    const png = await new Promise(resolve => canvas.toBlob(resolve, "image/png"));
    if (!png) throw new Error("PNG export failed.");
    const pngUrl = URL.createObjectURL(png);
    const link = Object.assign(document.createElement("a"), {href: pngUrl, download: name + ".png"});
    document.body.append(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(pngUrl), 15000);
  } finally {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }
}

function sectionSnapshotCovers(baseline, candidate) {
  if (baseline.id !== candidate?.id || baseline.snapshotDate !== candidate.snapshotDate) return false;
  const expected = baseline.views || [baseline];
  const received = candidate.views || [candidate];
  return expected.length === received.length && expected.every((view, i) => {
    const next = received[i];
    if (view.id !== next?.id || view.series.length !== next.series?.length) return false;
    return view.series.every((trace, j) => {
      const series = next.series[j];
      if (trace.name !== series.name || series.points.length < trace.points.length ||
          series.points[0][0] !== trace.points[0][0] ||
          series.points.at(-1)[0] < trace.points.at(-1)[0]) return false;
      const step = baseline.frequency === "monthly" ? 1 : 12;
      return series.points.every(([date, value], index) =>
        /^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-01$/.test(date) && Number.isFinite(value) &&
        (index === 0 || monthIndex(date) - monthIndex(series.points[index - 1][0]) === step));
    });
  });
}

async function initializeSectionPanel(root) {
  const chart = root.querySelector("[data-section-chart]");
  const select = root.querySelector("[data-section-view]");
  const stateSelect = root.querySelector("[data-section-state]");
  const button = root.querySelector("[data-section-download]");
  const status = root.querySelector("[data-section-status]");
  const coverage = root.querySelector("[data-section-coverage]");
  const detail = root.querySelector("[data-section-detail]");
  const subtitle = root.querySelector("[data-section-subtitle]");
  const embedded = document.getElementById(root.dataset.sectionPanel + "-snapshot");
  let panel;
  if (embedded) panel = JSON.parse(embedded.textContent);
  else {
    const response = await fetch(root.dataset.sectionAsset);
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Data file unavailable.");
    panel = await response.json();
  }
  const embeddedPanel = panel;
  const sidraRefresh = panel.monthlySource === "SIDRA";
  const key = sidraRefresh ? `brazil-economy-section-sidra-v1-${panel.id}-${panel.snapshotDate}` : "";
  let checkedCycle = sidraRefresh ? monthlyUpdateCycle(new Date(panel.snapshotDate + "T12:00:00Z")) : "";
  if (sidraRefresh) {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key));
      if (saved && /^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-20$/.test(saved.cycle) &&
          saved.cycle >= checkedCycle && saved.cycle <= monthlyUpdateCycle() &&
          sectionSnapshotCovers(embeddedPanel, saved.panel)) {
        panel = saved.panel;
        checkedCycle = saved.cycle;
      }
    } catch (_) { /* The embedded snapshot is available when storage is unavailable. */ }
  }
  const map = panel.kind === "map";
  const states = panel.geography === "states";
  const names = states ? sectionStateNames : MUNICIPAL_SEED_ROWS;
  const library = await (map ? loadMunicipalLibraries() : loadPlotly());
  const views = panel.views || [panel];
  if (views.length > 1) {
    select.replaceChildren();
    for (const [index, view] of views.entries()) select.add(new Option(dashboardText(view.label), index));
    select.parentElement.hidden = false;
  }
  if (map && !states) {
    stateSelect.replaceChildren(new Option("Brazil — all states", "BR"));
    for (const [abbr, name] of MUNICIPAL_UFS) stateSelect.add(new Option(`${name} (${abbr})`, abbr));
    stateSelect.parentElement.hidden = false;
  }
  let selectedView = 0;
  let selectedState = "BR";
  let previousWidth = 0;
  let renderQueue = Promise.resolve();
  const currentView = () => (panel.views || [panel])[selectedView];
  function mapFigure(view, width, exported = false) {
    const values = view.values || panel.values;
    const year = view.year || panel.year || panel.referenceYear;
    const data = states ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(values).map(([code, value]) => [sectionStateCodes[code] || code, value])) : values;
    const mobile = width < 460;
    const field = {
      key: panel.id, title: dashboardText(panel.title), roman: panel.roman, unit: dashboardText(view.unit || panel.unit), decimals: panel.decimals ?? 1,
      subtitle: view.subtitle ? dashboardText(view.subtitle) : view.label ? `${dashboardText(view.label)} · ${year}` : dashboardText(panel.subtitle),
      legendUnit: dashboardText(view.unit || panel.unit), missingPattern: panel.blankZeroOrMissing ? "white" : "diagonal",
      zeroPattern: panel.blankZeroOrMissing ? "white" : undefined, missingLabel: "No observation",
      sectionMap: true, scale: view.scale || panel.scale, sourceLabel: "Source: " + sectionExportSource(panel),
      territoryPlural: states ? "states" : "municipalities",
      boundariesNote: view.scale || panel.scale
        ? "Boundaries: IBGE 2022. The colour scale has fixed limits."
        : states ? "Boundaries: IBGE 2022. Scale based on states with observations." : undefined,
      footerNote: panel.mapScaleNote || "Lighter to darker values. Very light grey marks missing data.",
    };
    if (panel.classCount) {
      const {classCount} = panel;
      Object.assign(field, {
        colourScale: "detailed-pubugn", classCount, legendDecimals: 2,
        classLowerBound: panel.classLowerBound,
        classUpperBounds: panel.classUpperBounds,
        classTopOpen: panel.classTopOpen,
        classBandCaption: dashboardText(panel.classBandCaption),
        classLegendTitle: classCount + " national bands",
        footerNote: "Light lavender to dark green shows lower to higher values. Very light grey marks missing data.",
        classDescription: dashboardText(panel.mapScaleNote) + dashboardText(" Light lavender to dark green shows lower to higher values. Very light grey marks missing data."),
      });
    }
    const geometry = states ? sectionStateGeometry(library, width, mobile, exported) :
      municipalGeometry(library.libraries, library.topology, names, selectedState, width, mobile, exported, field.classCount);
    return {field, year, ...buildMunicipalSVG(document, field, {year, values: data}, geometry, names, selectedState, exported)};
  }
  function redraw(force = false) {
    renderQueue = renderQueue.catch(() => {}).then(async () => {
      const width = Math.floor(chart.clientWidth);
      if (width < 120 || (!force && width === previousWidth) || !root.closest("details.macro-section-group")?.open) return;
      previousWidth = width;
      const view = currentView();
      subtitle.textContent = view.subtitle || panel.subtitle;
      if (map) {
        const figure = mapFigure(view, width);
        chart.replaceChildren(figure.svg);
        coverage.textContent = `${figure.year} · ${municipalNumber(figure.available, 0)} / ${municipalNumber(figure.total, 0)} ${figure.field.territoryPlural} with data`;
        detail.textContent = `Hover or tap the map to see a value.`;
      } else if (panel.parallelLine) {
        const {figure, plot, series} = agriculturalLineFigure(panel, view, width);
        root.style.setProperty("--macro-plot-top", `${figure.layout.margin.t}px`);
        chart.style.height = `${figure.layout.height}px`;
        await library.react(chart, figure.data, figure.layout, figure.config);
        if (window.matchMedia("(max-width: 600px)").matches) {
          for (const heading of root.querySelectorAll(".macro-plot-title, .macro-plot-subtitle")) {
            heading.style.paddingLeft = `${figure.layout.margin.l}px`;
            heading.style.paddingRight = `${figure.layout.margin.r}px`;
          }
        } else {
          for (const heading of root.querySelectorAll(".macro-plot-title, .macro-plot-subtitle")) {
            heading.style.removeProperty("padding-left");
            heading.style.removeProperty("padding-right");
          }
        }
        document.getElementById(`keys-${plot.id}`).replaceChildren();
        fillSidebar(plot, series);
        if (figure.legendInfo.inside) fillInsideBoxes(plot, figure.legendInfo);
        else fillPresidents(plot, figure.legendInfo);
      } else {
        const figure = sectionChartFigure(panel, view, width);
        chart.style.height = figure.layout.height + "px";
        await library.react(chart, figure.data, figure.layout, figure.config);
      }
      chart.setAttribute("aria-busy", "false");
      status.hidden = true;
      button.disabled = false;
    });
    return renderQueue;
  }
  function showError() {
    status.textContent = "Unable to render this view. Please try again.";
    status.hidden = false;
  }
  await redraw(true);
  select?.addEventListener("change", () => { selectedView = Number(select.value); void redraw(true).catch(showError); });
  stateSelect?.addEventListener("change", () => { selectedState = stateSelect.value; void redraw(true).catch(showError); });
  if (map) {
    const showDetail = event => {
      const title = event.target.closest?.("[data-municipality]")?.querySelector("title");
      if (title) detail.textContent = title.textContent;
    };
    chart.addEventListener("pointerover", showDetail);
    chart.addEventListener("click", showDetail);
  }
  button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    button.disabled = true;
    try {
      const view = currentView();
      const name = [panel.id, view === panel ? "" : view.id, map && selectedState.toLowerCase()].filter(Boolean).join("-");
      if (map) await sectionMapPNG(mapFigure(view, 1000, true).svg, name);
      else {
        const figure = panel.parallelLine ? agriculturalLineFigure(panel, view, 1000, true).figure :
          sectionChartFigure(panel, view, 1000, true);
        await library.downloadImage(figure, {format: "png", filename: name, width: 1000, height: figure.layout.height, scale: 2});
      }
    } catch (error) {
      status.textContent = "Unable to download the figure. Please try again.";
      status.hidden = false;
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
    }
  });
  registerSectionRedraw(panel, root, () => void redraw(true).catch(showError));
  if (sidraRefresh) {
    let inFlight = false;
    let lastAttempt = -Infinity;
    const refresh = async () => {
      const cycle = monthlyUpdateCycle();
      if (checkedCycle === cycle || inFlight || Date.now() - lastAttempt < 300000) return;
      inFlight = true;
      lastAttempt = Date.now();
      try {
        const next = await refreshSectionSnapshot(panel);
        if (!sectionSnapshotCovers(panel, next)) throw new Error("The SIDRA update is incomplete.");
        if (next !== panel) {
          const previous = panel;
          panel = next;
          try {
            await redraw(true);
          } catch (error) {
            panel = previous;
            await redraw(true);
            throw error;
          }
        }
        checkedCycle = cycle;
        try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({cycle, panel})); } catch (_) { /* Memory is sufficient. */ }
      } catch (_) { /* Preserve the last valid figure and retry in the same cycle. */ }
      finally { inFlight = false; }
    };
    registerRefresh(panel, refresh);
    void refresh();
  }
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") new ResizeObserver(() => void redraw().catch(showError)).observe(chart);
}

function bootSectionPanels() {
  const panels = document.querySelectorAll("[data-section-panel]");
  const activate = root => {
    const status = root.querySelector("[data-section-status]");
    void initializeSectionPanel(root).catch(() => {
      root.querySelector("[data-section-chart]").setAttribute("aria-busy", "false");
      status.textContent = "Data could not load. ";
      const retry = Object.assign(document.createElement("button"), {textContent: "Retry", type: "button"});
      retry.addEventListener("click", () => { status.hidden = true; activate(root); }, {once: true});
      status.append(retry);
      status.hidden = false;
    });
  };
  if (!("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
    panels.forEach(activate);
    return;
  }
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (!entry.isIntersecting) continue;
      observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      activate(entry.target);
    }
  }, {rootMargin: "420px 0px"});
  panels.forEach(panel => observer.observe(panel));
}


function boot() {
  setupDashboardLanguage();
  configureChartHeights();
  bootSectionPanels();
  installSectionNavigation();
  bootMunicipalMaps();
  const initialized = new Set();
  function start(plot) {
    if (initialized.has(plot.id)) return;
    initialized.add(plot.id);
    void initializePlot(plot);
  }
  if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") PLOTS.forEach(start);
  else {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
      for (const entry of entries) if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        const plot = PLOTS.find(item => `panel-${item.id}` === entry.target.id);
        if (plot) start(plot);
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    }, { rootMargin: "650px 0px" });
    PLOTS.forEach(plot => observer.observe(document.getElementById(`panel-${plot.id}`)));
    start(PLOTS[0]);
  }
}
